raw.description:
The Retail Community Manager at Vuori is a people connector who actively collaborates with our retail stores, local studios, influencers and businesses to spread brand awareness and create extraordinary experiences. They will support current stores with local events, in-store activations, product seeding initiatives, and will play an integral part of training teams on the community process.

What you'll get to do:

  • The Retail Community Manager will support both the Senior Manager of Community and Retail Marketing Manager in overseeing store community leads – reviewing and approving event proposals, supporting the team with resources and providing coaching.
  • Travel to stores when support or additional training is needed.
  • Attending bigger scale events when additional support is needed on ground at the store level.
  • Implementing company culture/values/mission as a living breathing part of the entire team.
  • Staff training and development including building and overseeing each store's strategy to ensure we are building brand awareness and upholding our roots in the community.
  • Grassroots sales and marketing strategy in the local communities.
  • Connection to new store teams that build relationships.
  • Ability to lead and manage community events.

Community

  • You will be responsible for the relationships, networks, and the stores community strategy in the area with the intention of growing our brand.
  • You seek and attend local experiences and events and are knowledgeable on the upcoming fitness trends and instructors in your local community.
  • You support the execution of community initiatives (events & experiences).
  • You support the retail stores and the marketing team by creating a community database of athletic influencers and identifying key relationships in the community.
  • You help connect the store teams with influencers and neighboring businesses to build brand awareness.
  • You are a great coach and support for our retail stores.
  • Flexible availability is expected to meet the needs of community events in store and off site which includes travel, some early starts and/or late finishes and weekends.
  • You will be in close communication with the stores to ensure the teams are in the know of all upcoming experiences and anything needed for events.

People

  • Ensure a positive experience in all interactions with potential candidates.
  • You are a people connector who loves to build pipelines of talent by creating great relationships with store teams.

Training

  • Deliver a training program to Store Managers and Community Leads including brand, culture, operations and community.
  • Organize and implement team building days that focus on company culture, building relationships and teamwork.

Who you are:

  • Thrives in a high energy fast paced retail environment.
  • Enjoys going to a variety of fitness classes and connecting with both instructors and clients about the brand.
  • Demonstrates the ability to multi-task and work under pressure but also knows how to adapt when needed.
  • Fosters great relationships by putting people first, communicating with honesty and kindness and allows others to do the same.
  • Has an entrepreneurial nature and knows how and when to innovate to get great results.

Our investment in you:

At Vuori, we’re proud to offer the following to our employees:

  • Health Insurance
  • Savings and Retirement Plan
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Generous Vuori Discount & Industry Perks
  • Paid Time Off
  • Wellness & Fitness benefits

The salary range for this role is $78,400 per year - $100,905 per year.

Vuori is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Vuori is re-defining what athletic apparel looks like: built to move and sweat in but designed with a casual aesthetic to transition into everyday life. We draw inspiration from an active coastal California lifestyle; an integration of fitness, creative expression and life. Our high energy fast paced retail environment is reflected in the clothes we make. We aim to inspire others to take on all aspects of their lives with clarity, enthusiasm and purpose…while having a lot of fun along the way. We are proud to be an outlet for opportunity and for personal growth and success.

Description

Location: Remote (U.S)

﻿About frame:

Frame is on a mission to build the future of Human Security in the AI era. With significant funding, a seasoned cybersecurity team building the right product, and a huge market opportunity, we are just getting started.

Our AI engine develops security awareness training and attack simulations that empower every employee to make smarter security decisions and eliminate human risk. Frame is trusted by leading global organizations on their journey to prevent AI-driven, human-centric attacks across email, voice, video, and beyond. We believe that security starts with humans as the strongest line of defense.

Join us as we build the engine that protects the human layer of every organization in the AI era.

﻿Who are we looking for?

We're looking for a creative, hands-on Channel Marketing Manager to drive partner engagement, joint marketing initiatives, and pipeline generation across our global partner ecosystem.

Your mission is to make Frame top of mind with partner sales reps, inspiring more of them to actively engage with Frame, introduce us to their customers, and generate new business opportunities.

Reporting into Channel Sales, this individual contributor will execute both to-partner and through-partner marketing programs, including partner communications, co-branded campaigns, demand generation, and joint customer-facing events.

You'll work closely with Channel Sales, Marketing, and our partners to turn marketing initiatives into measurable business opportunities.

﻿Key Responsibilities:

  • Partner Marketing & Engagement (To-Partner)
  • Execute marketing campaigns and communications that build awareness, engagement, and mindshare across our partner ecosystem.
  • Adapt and distribute Frame marketing content, product announcements, promotions, and sales enablement materials for partner audiences.
  • Support partner onboarding and activation through targeted communications, campaign kits, and marketing initiatives.

Joint Marketing & Demand Generation (Through-Partner)

  • Plan and execute co-branded marketing campaigns that help partners introduce Frame to their customers and prospects.
  • Coordinate joint email campaigns, webinars, social media, and other demand generation activities.
  • Collaborate with marketing and sales teams to drive customer engagement, qualified leads, and new pipeline opportunities.

Partner Events & Field Marketing

  • Own the planning and execution of joint partner events, including sponsorship events,conferences, lunch-and-learns, webinars, and workshops.
  • Manage event logistics, invitations, promotions, budgets, and partner coordination.
  • Work with Channel Account Managers and sales teams to drive customer attendance, post-event follow-up, and opportunity creation.

Program Management & Performance

  • Maintain a calendar of partner marketing campaigns, events, and activities aligned with Channel Sales priorities.
  • Collaborate with Frame's Marketing team to leverage existing campaigns, content, and creative resources.
  • Track campaign and event performance, partner engagement, lead generation, and pipeline contribution using HubSpot and other marketing tools.

﻿Success Metrics:

  • Increased partner engagement and participation in Frame marketing initiatives.
  • Consistent execution of joint campaigns and high-impact partner events.
  • Growth in partner-generated leads, qualified opportunities, and pipeline.
  • Strong alignment between Channel Sales, Marketing, and our partner ecosystem.

Requirements

﻿Required Skills & Experience:

  • 3+ years of experience in channel marketing, partner marketing, field marketing, or B2B demand generation.
  • Experience executing marketing campaigns and events, preferably in cybersecurity, SaaS, or enterprise technology.
  • Experience working with resellers, MSPs and other partner types.
  • Strong project management, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Experience with email marketing, digital campaigns, event management, and co-branded marketing materials.
  • Familiarity with HubSpot or similar CRM and marketing automation platforms.
  • A proactive, resourceful, and hands-on approach with the ability to manage multiple initiatives independently.s

﻿Benefits:

  • Medical, dental and vision insurance
  • Monthly connectivity reimbursement
  • Unlimited paid time off
  • 401(K) Retirement Savings Plan

﻿Why frame:

  • High Impact: Build and own processes from start to finish that directly impact our product and customers, affecting millions of people.
  • Early-Stage Advantage: Join at the ground floor of a category-defining company. The decisions you make today will shape how the world thinks about Human Security tomorrow.
  • Built to Win: Frame is backed by world-class investors, operating in a market undergoing a fundamental shift, and has the right team and product.
  • Competitive Salary and Meaningful Equity: Our success is your success. Everyone has a meaningful stake in the company.

Head of Continuous Improvement – Supply Chain

Location: Flexible – based at any of our UK manufacturing sites
Permanent, Full Time
We’re looking for an experienced Continuous Improvement leader to drive Operational Excellence across the Premier Foods Supply Chain. This is a high impact role where you’ll shape our CI strategy, build capability across our manufacturing sites and help teams turn data and insight into sustainable improvements in performance, waste and OEE.

What you’ll be doing:

You’ll own and lead our Supply Chain continuous improvement journey, setting the direction for Operational Excellence and ensuring our sites have the right tools, methodologies and support to deliver sustainable results.
Working in partnership with senior Supply Chain and manufacturing leaders, you’ll:
  • Lead our Supply Chain Continuous Improvement and Operational Excellence programme.
  • Develop and embed CI standards, tools and methodologies across our manufacturing network.
  • Drive loss reduction, OEE improvement and delivery of non-capex savings.
  • Coach teams in structured problem solving and root-cause analysis.
  • Partner with Manufacturing Directors and Factory General Managers to embed CI into daily ways of working
  • Build CI capability at every level, from shop floor through to senior leadership.
  • Share best practice and drive a strong, sustainable improvement culture

What we’re looking for:

You’ll be an experienced Continuous Improvement or Operational Excellence leader with a strong understanding of FMCG or process manufacturing. You’ll know how to turn complex performance data into clear priorities and, just as importantly, how to engage people in delivering change.

You’ll bring:

  • TPM, WCM or equivalent training and practical deployment experience.
  • A deep understanding of factory operations, OEE, waste and loss reduction.
  • The ability to lead through influence across a complex, multi-site, matrix organisation
  • Expert problem solving and root cause analysis capability.
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to turn insight into action.
  • Excellent influencing, relationship building and coaching skills.
  • The confidence to communicate effectively from shop-floor teams through to senior leadership.
  • Demonstrable experience of developing people and building sustainable CI capability.

Why join us?

This role offers the opportunity to influence performance across our entire UK supply chain network. You’ll have the platform to shape our Continous Improvement strategy, partner with senior leaders and build a consistent improvement culture that delivers measurable and lasting results.

At Premier foods we believe in inclusion, authenticity and individuality. We aim to ensure all existing and future colleagues are given equitable opportunities and are respected, valued and encouraged to bring their true authentic selves to work no matter who they are, what they look like, who they love or what they believe in. Our culture is one where everyone is welcome.

We're proud to be a Disability Smart employer and are committed to supporting disability inclusion throughout our recruitment process. If you experience any access issues or require reasonable adjustments at any stage, please let us know so we can ensure you have the support you need.

raw.description:
Description

About the Role:

We are looking for a highly skilled and strategic Senior Sales Engineer to join our growing US commercial team. In this role, you will serve as the primary technical trusted advisor and product expert for our prospective customers. You will partner closely with our Account Executives (AEs) to navigate complex enterprise sales cycles, architect solutions, and articulate the deep business value of our platform to both highly technical stakeholders and C-level executives.

As a senior member of the team, you will not only drive technical wins but also help shape our sales engineering processes, mentor junior team members, and act as a crucial bridge between our customers, Product, and Engineering teams.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Technical Ownership: Lead the technical discovery, solution architecture, and product demonstrations for enterprise prospects throughout the sales cycle.
  • Proof of Concept (PoC): Scope, manage, and execute successful, value-driven Evaluations and PoCs that clearly demonstrate ROI and technical alignment with customer requirements.
  • Strategic Partnership: Partner with Enterprise AEs to build comprehensive account strategies, identify technical blockers, and successfully overcome objections.
  • Executive Presence: Confidently present and articulate complex technical concepts to a wide range of audiences, from Security/DevOps Engineers to CIOs and CISOs.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the "voice of the customer" by providing structured feedback to Product and Engineering to help drive the product roadmap.
  • RFP & Security Questionnaires: Take ownership of answering complex technical sections of RFPs, RFIs, and security compliance questionnaires.
  • Ecosystem Champion: Stay ahead of industry trends, competitive landscapes, and emerging technologies to position our platform as the market leader.

Requirements

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience as a Sales Engineer, Solutions Architect, or Solutions Engineer in the B2B SaaS space (Experience in Cybersecurity or complex infrastructure tech is a major plus).
  • Track Record: Proven track record of managing and winning technical sales cycles with Fortune 500 / Enterprise-level accounts.
  • Network & Infrastructure Security: Deep understanding of enterprise network topologies (routing, firewalls, segmentation) and a solid grasp of attack surface management, vulnerability prioritization, and threat modeling.
  • Technical Depth: Strong understanding of cloud architecture (AWS, Azure, or GCP), APIs, enterprise security protocols, and modern software deployment models.
  • Communication Skills: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills; ability to tell a compelling story around technology and value rather than just listing features.
  • Problem Solver: A self-starter mindset with a consultative approach to solving complex customer business challenges.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical technical experience.

raw.description:
Short-Form Video Editor – Reels & Premium Brand Content | Remote

Position Type: Fractional, Remote
Function: Creative / Video Production

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Short-Form Video / Reels Editor to transform raw footage and existing brand assets into polished, premium short-form video content.

This is an execution-focused creative role, not a social media strategy or management position. You’ll receive footage, assets, and creative direction and be responsible for turning them into refined, brand-aligned Reels and short-form videos.

We’re specifically looking for someone whose work feels premium, intentional, and professionally produced—not the typical influencer or template-driven CapCut aesthetic.

What You’ll Own

Short-Form Video Editing

  • Edit raw footage into polished Reels and short-form videos
  • Create strong pacing and natural visual flow
  • Select the strongest footage and structure edits effectively
  • Trim and sequence clips with attention to rhythm and storytelling
  • Incorporate existing brand assets into finished videos
  • Prepare final videos for social platforms and short-form placements

Premium Visual Execution

  • Maintain a sophisticated, premium visual aesthetic
  • Apply professional color correction and color grading
  • Ensure transitions and effects complement rather than overpower the content
  • Maintain consistency with existing brand direction
  • Produce clean, intentional edits rather than heavily templated social content

Sound & Music

  • Select music that complements the brand and creative direction
  • Edit audio for clean, professional output
  • Balance dialogue, music, and other audio elements appropriately
  • Use sound intentionally to improve pacing and overall production quality

Creative Production

  • Work from provided footage, assets, and creative direction
  • Turn existing materials into finished, publication-ready content
  • Incorporate feedback efficiently
  • Manage multiple edits and revisions as needed
  • Maintain organized project files and final exports
  • Help maintain a backlog of completed short-form creative

Requirements

  • Professional experience editing short-form video, Reels, branded content, or commercial social content
  • Strong portfolio or reel demonstrating high-quality video editing
  • Excellent sense of pacing, rhythm, composition, and storytelling
  • Strong color correction and color-grading skills
  • Strong judgment around music and sound selection
  • Ability to create premium brand content without relying heavily on templates or trendy effects
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Ability to work independently from provided creative direction
  • Comfortable working in a fractional, remote capacity
  • Ability to consistently deliver polished creative on deadline

Preferred Skills

  • Experience producing content for premium, luxury, lifestyle, or design-conscious brands
  • Strong experience with professional video-editing software
  • Experience editing Instagram Reels and other vertical short-form formats
  • Understanding of typography and motion graphics for video
  • Experience working with existing brand systems and creative direction
  • Strong color-grading capabilities
  • Experience selecting and integrating music and sound into branded content

Tools & Technology

Adobe Premiere Pro | DaVinci Resolve | Final Cut Pro | After Effects | Professional Color-Grading Tools | Audio Editing Tools

Equivalent professional editing tools are also welcome.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Have a strong visual eye and can immediately recognize when an edit feels polished
  • Understand the difference between premium branded content and typical influencer-style editing
  • Know when to keep an edit clean rather than adding unnecessary effects
  • Have excellent instincts for pacing, music, and sound
  • Can elevate raw footage through editing and color
  • Work well from an established creative direction
  • Are highly execution-oriented and don’t need to own social strategy
  • Can consistently deliver refined, brand-ready work
  • Take feedback well and turn revisions around efficiently

What a Typical Project Looks Like

You’ll receive raw footage, existing creative assets, and direction for a piece of short-form content.

From there, you’ll select the strongest footage, build the edit, establish pacing, refine the color, select appropriate music and sound, incorporate brand elements, and deliver a polished final video ready to publish.

In short: we provide the footage, assets, and direction; you turn them into premium short-form content.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Quality and polish of finished videos
  • Consistency with the established brand aesthetic
  • Strength of editing and pacing
  • Quality of color grading
  • Effectiveness of music and sound selection
  • Turnaround time
  • Accuracy to creative direction
  • Efficiency incorporating revisions
  • Consistency across multiple pieces of content
  • Reliability of fractional creative support

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application & Portfolio/Reel Review
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Recruiter Interview
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re a Short-Form Video Editor or Reels Editor with a portfolio of polished, premium brand content and strong skills across editing, pacing, color grading, music, and sound, we’d love to see your work.

This is a fractional, remote, execution-focused role. We’re looking for someone who can take strong raw materials and turn them into exceptional finished creative.

raw.title: Landing Page Designer
raw.excerpt: COMPANY 🌱 WHAT YOU'LL DO 🎯 RYZE is a fast-growing DTC brand built on mushroom coffee.
raw.description:
COMPANY 🌱


WHAT YOU'LL DO 🎯

RYZE is a fast-growing DTC brand built on mushroom coffee. The website is where most of our revenue lands, and it runs on landing pages built for retention, retail, affiliates, sale moments and more. We have published more than 400 landing pages through our in-house page tool, Forge, and requests keep coming from every team.


This seat is about landing pages. You own the work that sits outside our CRO test pipeline: retention pages for existing subscribers, retail pages that support our store partners, affiliate and creator pages, and base templates for our review network. You also design the subscription portal and the flows subscribers use to manage their orders.


This starts as a contract of about 25 hours a week, with a path to full-time if the volume holds.


ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES

Landing Page Design

  • Design retention landing pages: win-back, failed-payment recovery, upgrade and loyalty pages, each designed for the customer who lands there.
  • Design retail landing pages that support our retail partners and send shoppers to the right product and store.
  • Design affiliate and creator pages built for a creator's audience that stay on brand and keep the path to the offer short.
  • Build base templates and themes for our review network sites -- each site has its own look and voice, separate from the RYZE brand.

Subscription Portal & Flows

  • Design the subscription portal and its flows: account, manage-subscription, swap, skip and cancellation flows.
  • Make flows clear for the customer and ensure they meet every legal requirement.

Process & System

  • Work from brief to approved, build-ready design -- every request goes through web-team intake in ClickUp with a due date and a design-build-QA flow.
  • Hand off every breakpoint and state with final copy placed and assets exported, so the builder doesn't need to come back with questions.
  • Work in Figma from the RYZE design system and the Forge section library. When a request produces a reusable pattern, add it so the next page starts faster.
  • Take on ad hoc design work: sales mockups, promo pages and one-off requests when the team needs a designer.

PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS

  • 3+ years designing landing pages or e-commerce web pages, with live pages you can show.
  • Strong Figma skills: you work from components, auto layout and a design system, and your files are clean enough for a developer to build without a meeting.
  • UX for flows, not only pages: experience designing multi-step flows such as account areas, checkouts or subscription management.
  • Range inside a brand and outside it: you can stay on brand for RYZE and also design a separate site with its own identity.
  • Mobile-first instincts -- most of our traffic is on phones and you design for that first.
  • Speed without sloppiness: you have handled a steady queue with real deadlines, several in flight at once, and kept the quality up.
  • Clear written English and reliable communication -- you flag a risk to a date early, not on the due date.

CORE COMPETENCIES

  • Landing page design: designs pages optimized for the specific customer and moment -- retention, retail, affiliate or creator -- not generic layouts
  • Figma systems fluency: works from components and design systems; files are build-ready and organized for handoff without a meeting
  • Flow and UX design: designs multi-step flows such as subscription portals and account management with clarity for the customer and compliance for legal
  • Multi-brand range: can maintain RYZE brand standards and design separate site identities for the review network simultaneously
  • Process discipline: manages a queue of requests with real deadlines, tracks status in ClickUp, and hands off complete files on time
  • Mobile-first thinking: designs for phone traffic first; desktop is secondary

WHAT WE OFFER 🌟

raw.description:
At Delta Faucet, we are committed to transforming everyday experiences with water through innovative products and exceptional service. As a leader in the plumbing industry, we take pride in our dedication to quality, sustainability, and customer satisfaction. We believe that diverse perspectives strengthen our mission to create solutions that inspire and elevate the lives of all our customers. We welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us on this journey toward inclusivity and excellence.

Your Role at Delta Faucet:

We are seeking a Director of eCommerce Channel Marketing to lead growth strategies for the Delta Faucet Company brands across Amazon and Wayfair. This leader will oversee retail media, organic search, content, digital shelf, and performance marketing, with accountability for revenue, profitability, market share, and the consumer experience.

The Director will lead a team and manage external agency partners while collaborating with Sales, Brand Marketing, Product, Analytics, Finance, and Creative teams. The ideal candidate is a strategic, data-driven leader who turns customer, consumer, competitive, and performance insights into clear priorities and measurable results.


What You Will Do

  • Develop and lead eCommerce marketing strategies for Amazon and Wayfair across the Delta Faucet Company brands.
  • Partner with Sales leadership to drive revenue growth, profitability, market share, and long-term brand health.
  • Lead paid media strategy, including budget allocation, campaign priorities, testing, optimization, and performance measurement.
  • Own organic search, content, digital shelf, ratings and reviews, and conversion strategies.
  • Connect paid and organic plans to improve visibility, traffic, conversion, and product performance.
  • Guide the optimization of product content, imagery, video, enhanced content, storefronts, and brand pages.
  • Establish performance scorecards and use consumer, customer, competitive, and financial insights to identify growth opportunities.
  • Partner with Sales and Finance to make investment decisions that balance growth and profitability.
  • Lead external media, content, data, and technology partners and hold agencies accountable for results.
  • Communicate channel performance, opportunities, and recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Lead, coach, and develop direct reports responsible for customer marketing, paid media, organic growth, content, and digital shelf.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Analytics, eCommerce, or a related field.
  • 10 or more years of relevant experience, including progressive leadership responsibility.
  • Strong experience in eCommerce, digital marketing, retail media, or omnichannel marketing.

raw.title: Mineral Economist
raw.excerpt: AECOM is seeking a Mineral Economist to join our West Region and support the economic evaluation and financial analysis of mining projects across a range of commodities and development stages.
raw.description:
AECOM is seeking a Mineral Economist to join our West Region and support the economic evaluation and financial analysis of mining projects across a range of commodities and development stages. In this role, you will contribute to high-impact advisory and technical studies by developing robust economic models, evaluating project viability, and translating complex technical inputs into clear, decision-focused financial insights. This position offers the opportunity to work closely with experienced economists, engineers, and geoscientists in a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment while supporting clients with investment decisions, project development strategies, and long-term value creation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Economic Analysis
  • Build, maintain, and update detailed financial and economic models to evaluate mining projects, including cash flow projections, NPV, IRR, and payback analyses.
  • Analyze capital and operating costs, commodity pricing assumptions, production schedules, and economic drivers to assess project performance.
  • Conduct sensitivity, scenario, and risk analyses to evaluate the robustness of project economics and identify key value drivers and risks.
  • Support economic comparisons of alternative mine plans, development options, and operating strategies.
  • Apply consistent assumptions, methodologies, and quality standards to ensure defensible and transparent economic analyses.
  • Project Support and Integration
  • Work closely with mining engineers, geologists, processing engineers, and environmental specialists to integrate technical inputs into economic and financial models.
  • Support economic evaluations for scoping studies, prefeasibility studies, feasibility studies, and life-of-mine assessments.
  • Contribute to advisory engagements, including project screening, option analysis, and strategic evaluations.
  • Assist with due diligence activities and independent reviews by supporting economic workstreams and analysis.
  • Support project teams in meeting schedule, quality, and client expectations.
  • Reporting and Communication
  • Prepare clear, well-structured client-facing reports, presentations, and technical memoranda summarizing economic analyses and findings.
  • Present economic results and insights to internal teams and clients under the guidance of senior staff.
  • Support the preparation of economic sections of technical studies and advisory deliverables.
  • Assist with documentation of assumptions, methodologies, and results to ensure transparency and auditability.
  • Collaborate with project managers and technical leads to ensure consistent messaging across deliverables.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Finance, Engineering, or a related discipline and 6+ years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience supporting economic evaluation and financial analysis of mining or natural resources projects.
  • Experience working in mining, natural resources, or a professional services or consulting environment.
  • Strong analytical, quantitative, and financial modeling skills with attention to detail.
  • Experience integrating technical project inputs into financial and economic assessments.
  • Ability to communicate economic concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

Additional information

  • Sponsorship will not be provided for this role.
  • THIS POSTING IS FOR A CURRENT VACANCY, AND AECOM INTENDS TO FILL THIS POSITION BY FEBRUARY 22, 2027

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

The Canonical Security Operations team is hiring for a Senior or Staff engineer. The Security Operations team is responsible for designing, building, and operating a world-class Security Operations Center, and the successful candidate will provide leadership, mentorship, expertise, and outstanding individual contributions towards those ends.

This role involves aspects of:

  • Traditional SOC duties - security monitoring, threat hunting, and response.
  • Security engineering - assessing and protecting Canonical platforms and products.
  • Software engineering - building custom tools and platforms.
  • Site reliability engineering - deploying, maintaining, and automating security tools.

We are looking for individuals with engineering and security experience, as well as a history of remarkable achievement. Senior security operations personnel with engineering experience and senior developers with security experience are equally well-suited to this role.

Beyond securing Canonical’s digital estate, this position represents a unique opportunity to contribute to the open source ecosystem. Team members may present at industry conferences, share threat intelligence with the wider community, or publish open source security software.

Junior positions are also available for less-experienced individuals with a compelling academic or professional background.

In this role, you will:

  • Provide operational and engineering leadership.
  • Implement and evolve Canonical’s Security Operations Center.
  • Design and develop security software and platforms.
  • Monitor for, identify, respond to, and remediate security incidents.
  • Assess and improve Canonical’s security controls.
  • Mentor early-career Security Operations engineers.
  • Plan and deliver work within Canonical's agile engineering framework.
  • Contribute to open source security.
  • Publish blog posts, whitepapers and conference presentations.

We are looking for:

  • An exceptional academic track record.
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path.
  • 10+ years of relevant professional experience
  • Professional cybersecurity experience, preferably working or leading a Security Operations Center.
  • Professional engineering experience.
  • An eagerness to contribute to open source security.
  • Proficiency in common scripting languages, such as Python and Bash.
  • Knowledge of Git, GitOps, Infrastructure-as-Code, and common orchestration platforms (e.g., Kubernetes)

Though optional, we value:

  • Familiarity with security frameworks such as the NIST CSF, CIS CSC, and ISO 27001
  • Knowledge of security architecture and market-leading security tools.
  • Experience in a security operations team or a security operations center.
  • Experience in offensive or defensive security teams with hands-on ability.
  • Experience with advanced persistent threats.
  • Proficiency in additional programming languages, such as Golang.

What we offer you:

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

Senior Data Engineer \ Associate Architect – Microsoft Fabric

Location: Remote (India)

Experience: 6-8 Years

Employment Type: Full Time

Company: indigoChart Technologies India Pvt. Ltd.

About indigoChart

indigoChart takes pride in delivering excellence by collaborating with decision-makers to execute on their Data Modernization Strategies.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Engineer\ Associate Data Architect to join our dynamic team and play a key role in designing and building the Microsoft Fabric data pipelines that power our customers' analytics use cases.

About the Role

We're looking for a skilled Senior Data Engineer\ Associate Data Architect with 6-8 years' experience to join our remote team and take ownership of designing, building, and operating data pipelines on the Microsoft Fabric platform. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced professional to make a significant impact in an innovation-driven environment.

You'll design, build, and own Lakehouse and Warehouse solutions on OneLake - working across ingestion, transformation, and delivery of clean, reliable data through the medallion pattern (Bronze to Silver to Gold) to Power BI and downstream applications.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys solving real data problems, writing solid code, and taking ownership of what they build in production.

Location

100% Remote, preferably based in Mumbai / Pune India , serving global clients with reasonable time-zone overlap.

Key Responsibilities

Data Pipeline Design & Development

  • Design and build Lakehouse and Warehouse solutions on Microsoft Fabric and OneLake, organized using the medallion pattern (Bronze → Silver → Gold).
  • Build ingestion pipelines using Fabric Data Factory pipelines and Data-flows Gen2 to bring data in from databases, files, APIs, and business applications.
  • Develop transformations, data quality checks, and automation in Python/PySpark using Spark notebooks in Fabric.
  • Implement ETL/ELT patterns including incremental load strategies and slowly changing dimensions, and model analytics-ready models consumable by semantic models.

Data & Platform Engineering

  • Deliver Gold-layer data to Power BI semantic models using Direct Lake mode for fast, scalable reporting.
  • Set up and manage Fabric workspaces and monitor capacity usage to keep pipelines performant and cost-efficient.
  • Promote work across Dev to Test to Prod using Fabric deployment pipelines, Git version control, and CI/CD.

Technical Ownership

  • Provide thought leadership by recommending the right technologies and solutions for a given use case, from the application layer to infrastructure.
  • Stand behind your recommendations and explain technical decisions clearly, both internally and to customers.
  • Explore new technologies to continually uncover better, more automated ways to solve data engineering problems.
​

Quality, Performance & Collaboration

  • Ensure performance, security, scalability, and robust data integration across all delivered pipelines, including SQL and Spark performance tuning.
  • Build error handling, logging, and monitoring into every pipeline so issues are caught and resolved before they reach users.
  • Follow the complete software development lifecycle — design, documentation, implementation, testing, and deployment.
  • Collaborate with and help fellow data engineers learn and grow, translating customer needs into dependable, production-ready solutions.

Requirements

What We're Looking For (Mandatory Skills)

  • 6-8 years of professional experience as a Data\Sr. Data Engineer, including hands-on experience building production data pipelines on Microsoft Fabric.
  • Hands-onMicrosoft Fabric experience: Lakehouse and Warehouse design, OneLake, medallion architecture, Data Factory pipelines, Data-flows Gen2, Spark notebooks, and Direct Lake mode with Power BI semantic models.
  • Strong SQL skills (must-have): complex querying, joins, window functions, performance tuning, and data modeling with star schemas, fact and dimension tables.
  • Strong Python / PySpark skills (must-have): writing transformations, data quality checks, and automation in notebooks; familiar with good software practices (functions, modules, testing, error handling).
  • Solid data engineering fundamentals: ETL/ELT design, incremental load strategies, slowly changing dimensions, data warehousing, error handling, and monitoring.
  • Experience with Fabric capacity monitoring, workspace setup, and deployment pipelines.
  • Version control (Git) and CI/CD experience for deploying pipeline code.
  • Experience working directly with stakeholders to translate business needs into data solutions.

Good to have:

  • Microsoft Certified: Fabric Data Engineer Associate (DP-700).
  • Experience with Azure data services such as ADLS Gen2, Azure SQL, and Azure Key Vault.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
  • 6-8 years of experience as a Data Engineer with Software Engineering skills and production experience on Microsoft Fabric and/or Databricks.
  • Strong analytical mindset with excellent troubleshooting, documentation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a startup environment that values speed, ownership, and innovation.

Benefits

Why indigoChart?

  • Remote-First Work Environment — work 100% remote from anywhere in India.
  • Collaborative culture that prizes autonomy, creativity, and transparency.
  • Competitive compensation, excellent benefits, and a generous PTO plan plus holidays.
  • Accelerated learning and professional development through advanced training and certifications.

At indigoChart, every team member contributes to shaping the future of data technology. If you're passionate about building secure, scalable, and intelligent data systems — we'd love to hear from you.

raw.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity

This is a unique opportunity to work directly with the Chief Global Commercialization Officer (CGCO) and help advance the Global Commercialization agenda during a period of significant growth and execution intensity. We are seeking an enterprise-minded Executive Director, CGCO Operations to provide dedicated strategic and operational support across the CGCO’s priorities, decisions and cross-functional initiatives.

This role reports directly to the CGCO and participates in the Commercialization Leadership Team (CLT) in support of leadership-team effectiveness. The role works closely with CLT members, the Vice President, Global Commercialization Effectiveness & Operations (VP CE&O), and other senior leaders to advance Global Commercialization critical priorities.

The position is a permanent organizational seat designed as an approximately 18-month rotational assignment. Incumbents will maintain the core responsibilities of the role while leading a defined set of priorities agreed with the CGCO. The assignment is intended both to strengthen CGCO & CLT effectiveness and to provide broad executive and enterprise leadership experience.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner directly with theCGCO to prioritize and advance the highest-impact strategic, organizational and operational topics across the Global Commercialization agenda including shaping the content and cadence of business reviews and key planning elements both regionally and across global functions.

    • Prepare & support key executive engagementsincluding leadership discussions, organizational communications and other critical CGCO forums.

  • Provide executive decision support and coordination across CLT & other key leadersby synthesizing complex information, stakeholder perspectives, risks and options into clear recommendations & concise executive materials including working across CLT stakeholders to facilitate and coordinate IR materials, messaging etc.

    • Connect interdependent work, identify gaps and resolve or escalate cross-functional issues that require CGCO attention.

  • Lead select strategic initiatives and special assignments that require senior-level ownership, rapid coordination or focused attention on behalf of the CGCO & CLT.

  • Support CLT effectiveness by helping ensure leadership discussions focus on the right issues and that decisions, commitments and follow-through are clear.

  • Build connectivity across the organization by partnering with regions, functions and other executive offices where priorities intersect.

  • Establish sustainable ownership by transitioning recurring processes or enduring capabilities to VP CE&O or the appropriate functional owner.

  • Ensure continuity across rotations through disciplined documentation and structured handover of priorities, relationships, decisions and open initiatives.

Who You Are

You are a highly trusted, enterprise-oriented leader who can quickly understand complex issues, exercise sound judgment and operate effectively with senior executives. You are comfortable working across a broad agenda, moving between strategy and hands-on execution, and influencing outcomes without relying on formal authority.

You bring clarity and momentum to ambiguous situations while respecting established accountabilities. You build strong relationships across functions and levels, communicate with precision, and know when to lead, facilitate, escalate or transition work to an enduring organizational owner.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

  • Demonstrated Executive Director-level capability and credibility working with senior executives and enterprise leadership teams.

  • Oncology or specialty pharma commercialization experience.

  • Significant experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives in fast-moving and ambiguous environments.

  • Strong strategic thinking and synthesis skills, with the ability to translate complexity into clear issues, options, decisions and actions.

  • Exceptional judgment and discretion when handling confidential, sensitive or time-critical topics.

  • Proven ability to influence without authority and drive alignment across diverse stakeholder groups.

  • Excellent executive communication skills, including concise written materials, presentations and leadership communications.

  • Strong relationship-building and collaboration skills across functions, regions and leadership levels.

  • Demonstrated ability to move between strategy and execution while maintaining focus on outcomes, ownership and follow-through.

  • Enterprise orientation and learning agility, with the ability to rapidly build context across unfamiliar business areas.

  • Bachelor’s degree with 15+ years of relevant experience in biotechnology, pharmaceutical, healthcare, commercialization, strategy, business operations, management consulting or a related field.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience supporting an executive leadership team or leading enterprise strategic initiatives in a strategy, operations, consulting or chief-of-staff-like capacity.

  • Experience across multiple commercialization disciplines, geographies or business functions.

  • Experience with launch readiness, portfolio strategy, organizational transformation, governance or operating-model development.

  • Advanced degree (MBA/MS/MPH/PharmD/PhD).

The base pay salary range for this full-time position for candidates working onsite at our headquarters in Redwood City, CA is listed below. The range displayed on each job posting is intended to be the base pay salary range for an individual working onsite in Redwood City and will be adjusted for the local market a candidate is based in. Our base pay salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Individual base pay salary is determined by multiple factors, including job-related skills, experience, market dynamics, and relevant education or training.

Please note that base pay salary range is one part of the overall total rewards program at RevMed, which includes competitive cash compensation, robust equity awards, strong benefits, and significant learning and development opportunities.

Revolution Medicines is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits unlawful discrimination based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin/ancestry, age, disability, marital status, medical condition, and veteran status.

Revolution Medicines takes protection and security of personal data very seriously and respects your right to privacy while using our website and when contacting us by email or phone. We will only collect, process and use any personal data that you provide to us in accordance with our CCPA Notice and Privacy Policy. For additional information, please contact .

Base Pay Salary Range
$252,000—$315,000 USD

We are aware of recent recruitment scams in which individuals or organizations falsely represent themselves as being affiliated with Revolution Medicines. These scams may appear as false job advertisements or unsolicited contacts through communication or chat platforms, email, phone, or text message.

Please note that Revolution Medicines does not extend unsolicited employment offers and will never ask candidates to provide financial information, purchase equipment, or pay fees as part of the hiring process. All legitimate communication from Revolution Medicines will come from an official @revmed.com email address.

About the role

The Cybersecurity Lead owns albo's information security at a technical level, across all of its companies, products and platforms: detecting and responding to attacks, securing our applications and cloud, and testing our defenses the way a real attacker would. Reporting to and working side by side with the CISO to deliver albo's security strategy, you will build and lead the cybersecurity team as albo moves from IFPE to SOFIPO, on the way to a banking license, in an increasingly hostile and fast threat landscape supercharged by AI.

What you’ll be doing at albo:

  • Lead all of Cybersecurity and the engineers who join the team. In 2027 the priorities are security operations (SecOps) and application security (AppSec); offensive security (OffSec) follows.
  • Run detection and incident response: bring critical log sources into the SIEM, make sure every alert has an owner, and lead investigations and post-mortems.
  • Share the around-the-clock detection on-call with the CISO, widening the rotation as the team grows.
  • Drive vulnerability management across code and infrastructure so findings are fixed within SLA, and embed security reviews before each release.
  • Work with Infra and Engineering to close the network, centralize administrative access and remove long-lived keys from money flows and CI.
  • Own offensive security: plan and oversee external pentests, manage vulnerability disclosure and validate that our controls work as intended.
  • Cover each cybersecurity function until a dedicated professional joins, and help hire and develop them.
  • Shape albo's security culture together with the CISO, coaching Engineering teams and growing security champions within them. Provide technical input and evidence for SOFIPO, IFPE and Banxico requirements, together with GRC.

About you and what type of skills you'll need:

  • +5 years of experience in Security Engineering, at least 2 of them leading teams or programs.
  • Deep expertise in security operations (detection and incident response) or application security, and working familiarity with the other as well as with offensive security.
  • Hands-on experience with SIEM, WAF, other security tools as well as cloud security.
  • Hands-on experience securing fintech or payments platforms in production.
  • A first-line leader who helps people perform and grow: mentoring, leading by example and setting a high bar.
  • Calm leadership under pressure: you can run an incident, rally teams that don't report to you and explain risk plainly to executives.
  • Familiarity with NIST CSF and ISO/IEC 27001; experience with Mexican financial regulation is a plus.
  • Fluent Spanish and professional English.
  • Certifications such as OSCP, GCIH or CISSP are a plus.
  • Customer Centricity: You're customer-obsessed, constantly thinking about improving the customer experience.
  • Hands-on: We’re looking for a comfortable and willing leader to be a hands-on contributor who is energized by rolling up their sleeves, making things happen, and enabling the team to do the same.
  • Done is better than perfect: As things change and move quickly, you are excited by the fast pace and opportunity to constantly learn and help your team learn.
  • Communication: Excellent ability to communicate internally and externally, quickly build relationships, and work cross-functionally.
  • Extreme ownership: You hold yourself accountable to a high bar. You are supremely organized and see what needs to happen to achieve goals.
  • Results & Data Driven: You understand the business metrics you are responsible for, and you demonstrate these insights to drive constant improvement.

raw.title: Short-Form Video Editor
raw.excerpt: Short-Form Video Editor – Reels & Premium Brand Content | Remote Position Type: Fractional, Remote Function: Creative / Video Production About the Role At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Short-Form Video / Reels Editor to transform raw footage and existing brand assets into polished, premium short-form video content.
raw.description:
Short-Form Video Editor – Reels & Premium Brand Content | Remote

Position Type: Fractional, Remote
Function: Creative / Video Production

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Short-Form Video / Reels Editor to transform raw footage and existing brand assets into polished, premium short-form video content.

This is an execution-focused creative role, not a social media strategy or management position. You’ll receive footage, assets, and creative direction and be responsible for turning them into refined, brand-aligned Reels and short-form videos.

We’re specifically looking for someone whose work feels premium, intentional, and professionally produced—not the typical influencer or template-driven CapCut aesthetic.

What You’ll Own

Short-Form Video Editing

  • Edit raw footage into polished Reels and short-form videos
  • Create strong pacing and natural visual flow
  • Select the strongest footage and structure edits effectively
  • Trim and sequence clips with attention to rhythm and storytelling
  • Incorporate existing brand assets into finished videos
  • Prepare final videos for social platforms and short-form placements

Premium Visual Execution

  • Maintain a sophisticated, premium visual aesthetic
  • Apply professional color correction and color grading
  • Ensure transitions and effects complement rather than overpower the content
  • Maintain consistency with existing brand direction
  • Produce clean, intentional edits rather than heavily templated social content

Sound & Music

  • Select music that complements the brand and creative direction
  • Edit audio for clean, professional output
  • Balance dialogue, music, and other audio elements appropriately
  • Use sound intentionally to improve pacing and overall production quality

Creative Production

  • Work from provided footage, assets, and creative direction
  • Turn existing materials into finished, publication-ready content
  • Incorporate feedback efficiently
  • Manage multiple edits and revisions as needed
  • Maintain organized project files and final exports
  • Help maintain a backlog of completed short-form creative

Requirements

  • Professional experience editing short-form video, Reels, branded content, or commercial social content
  • Strong portfolio or reel demonstrating high-quality video editing
  • Excellent sense of pacing, rhythm, composition, and storytelling
  • Strong color correction and color-grading skills
  • Strong judgment around music and sound selection
  • Ability to create premium brand content without relying heavily on templates or trendy effects
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Ability to work independently from provided creative direction
  • Comfortable working in a fractional, remote capacity
  • Ability to consistently deliver polished creative on deadline

Preferred Skills

  • Experience producing content for premium, luxury, lifestyle, or design-conscious brands
  • Strong experience with professional video-editing software
  • Experience editing Instagram Reels and other vertical short-form formats
  • Understanding of typography and motion graphics for video
  • Experience working with existing brand systems and creative direction
  • Strong color-grading capabilities
  • Experience selecting and integrating music and sound into branded content

Tools & Technology

Adobe Premiere Pro | DaVinci Resolve | Final Cut Pro | After Effects | Professional Color-Grading Tools | Audio Editing Tools

Equivalent professional editing tools are also welcome.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Have a strong visual eye and can immediately recognize when an edit feels polished
  • Understand the difference between premium branded content and typical influencer-style editing
  • Know when to keep an edit clean rather than adding unnecessary effects
  • Have excellent instincts for pacing, music, and sound
  • Can elevate raw footage through editing and color
  • Work well from an established creative direction
  • Are highly execution-oriented and don’t need to own social strategy
  • Can consistently deliver refined, brand-ready work
  • Take feedback well and turn revisions around efficiently

What a Typical Project Looks Like

You’ll receive raw footage, existing creative assets, and direction for a piece of short-form content.

From there, you’ll select the strongest footage, build the edit, establish pacing, refine the color, select appropriate music and sound, incorporate brand elements, and deliver a polished final video ready to publish.

In short: we provide the footage, assets, and direction; you turn them into premium short-form content.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Quality and polish of finished videos
  • Consistency with the established brand aesthetic
  • Strength of editing and pacing
  • Quality of color grading
  • Effectiveness of music and sound selection
  • Turnaround time
  • Accuracy to creative direction
  • Efficiency incorporating revisions
  • Consistency across multiple pieces of content
  • Reliability of fractional creative support

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application & Portfolio/Reel Review
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Recruiter Interview
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re a Short-Form Video Editor or Reels Editor with a portfolio of polished, premium brand content and strong skills across editing, pacing, color grading, music, and sound, we’d love to see your work.

This is a fractional, remote, execution-focused role. We’re looking for someone who can take strong raw materials and turn them into exceptional finished creative.

raw.title: Landing Page Designer
raw.excerpt: COMPANY 🌱 WHAT YOU'LL DO 🎯 RYZE is a fast-growing DTC brand built on mushroom coffee.
raw.description:
COMPANY 🌱


WHAT YOU'LL DO 🎯

RYZE is a fast-growing DTC brand built on mushroom coffee. The website is where most of our revenue lands, and it runs on landing pages built for retention, retail, affiliates, sale moments and more. We have published more than 400 landing pages through our in-house page tool, Forge, and requests keep coming from every team.


This seat is about landing pages. You own the work that sits outside our CRO test pipeline: retention pages for existing subscribers, retail pages that support our store partners, affiliate and creator pages, and base templates for our review network. You also design the subscription portal and the flows subscribers use to manage their orders.


This starts as a contract of about 25 hours a week, with a path to full-time if the volume holds.


ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES

Landing Page Design

  • Design retention landing pages: win-back, failed-payment recovery, upgrade and loyalty pages, each designed for the customer who lands there.
  • Design retail landing pages that support our retail partners and send shoppers to the right product and store.
  • Design affiliate and creator pages built for a creator's audience that stay on brand and keep the path to the offer short.
  • Build base templates and themes for our review network sites -- each site has its own look and voice, separate from the RYZE brand.

Subscription Portal & Flows

  • Design the subscription portal and its flows: account, manage-subscription, swap, skip and cancellation flows.
  • Make flows clear for the customer and ensure they meet every legal requirement.

Process & System

  • Work from brief to approved, build-ready design -- every request goes through web-team intake in ClickUp with a due date and a design-build-QA flow.
  • Hand off every breakpoint and state with final copy placed and assets exported, so the builder doesn't need to come back with questions.
  • Work in Figma from the RYZE design system and the Forge section library. When a request produces a reusable pattern, add it so the next page starts faster.
  • Take on ad hoc design work: sales mockups, promo pages and one-off requests when the team needs a designer.

PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS

  • 3+ years designing landing pages or e-commerce web pages, with live pages you can show.
  • Strong Figma skills: you work from components, auto layout and a design system, and your files are clean enough for a developer to build without a meeting.
  • UX for flows, not only pages: experience designing multi-step flows such as account areas, checkouts or subscription management.
  • Range inside a brand and outside it: you can stay on brand for RYZE and also design a separate site with its own identity.
  • Mobile-first instincts -- most of our traffic is on phones and you design for that first.
  • Speed without sloppiness: you have handled a steady queue with real deadlines, several in flight at once, and kept the quality up.
  • Clear written English and reliable communication -- you flag a risk to a date early, not on the due date.

CORE COMPETENCIES

  • Landing page design: designs pages optimized for the specific customer and moment -- retention, retail, affiliate or creator -- not generic layouts
  • Figma systems fluency: works from components and design systems; files are build-ready and organized for handoff without a meeting
  • Flow and UX design: designs multi-step flows such as subscription portals and account management with clarity for the customer and compliance for legal
  • Multi-brand range: can maintain RYZE brand standards and design separate site identities for the review network simultaneously
  • Process discipline: manages a queue of requests with real deadlines, tracks status in ClickUp, and hands off complete files on time
  • Mobile-first thinking: designs for phone traffic first; desktop is secondary

WHAT WE OFFER 🌟

raw.description:
AECOM is seeking a Mineral Economist to join our West Region and support the economic evaluation and financial analysis of mining projects across a range of commodities and development stages. In this role, you will contribute to high-impact advisory and technical studies by developing robust economic models, evaluating project viability, and translating complex technical inputs into clear, decision-focused financial insights. This position offers the opportunity to work closely with experienced economists, engineers, and geoscientists in a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment while supporting clients with investment decisions, project development strategies, and long-term value creation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Economic Analysis
  • Build, maintain, and update detailed financial and economic models to evaluate mining projects, including cash flow projections, NPV, IRR, and payback analyses.
  • Analyze capital and operating costs, commodity pricing assumptions, production schedules, and economic drivers to assess project performance.
  • Conduct sensitivity, scenario, and risk analyses to evaluate the robustness of project economics and identify key value drivers and risks.
  • Support economic comparisons of alternative mine plans, development options, and operating strategies.
  • Apply consistent assumptions, methodologies, and quality standards to ensure defensible and transparent economic analyses.
  • Project Support and Integration
  • Work closely with mining engineers, geologists, processing engineers, and environmental specialists to integrate technical inputs into economic and financial models.
  • Support economic evaluations for scoping studies, prefeasibility studies, feasibility studies, and life-of-mine assessments.
  • Contribute to advisory engagements, including project screening, option analysis, and strategic evaluations.
  • Assist with due diligence activities and independent reviews by supporting economic workstreams and analysis.
  • Support project teams in meeting schedule, quality, and client expectations.
  • Reporting and Communication
  • Prepare clear, well-structured client-facing reports, presentations, and technical memoranda summarizing economic analyses and findings.
  • Present economic results and insights to internal teams and clients under the guidance of senior staff.
  • Support the preparation of economic sections of technical studies and advisory deliverables.
  • Assist with documentation of assumptions, methodologies, and results to ensure transparency and auditability.
  • Collaborate with project managers and technical leads to ensure consistent messaging across deliverables.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Finance, Engineering, or a related discipline and 6+ years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience supporting economic evaluation and financial analysis of mining or natural resources projects.
  • Experience working in mining, natural resources, or a professional services or consulting environment.
  • Strong analytical, quantitative, and financial modeling skills with attention to detail.
  • Experience integrating technical project inputs into financial and economic assessments.
  • Ability to communicate economic concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Security engineering - assessing and protecting Canonical platforms and products.
  • Software engineering - building custom tools and platforms.
  • Site reliability engineering - deploying, maintaining, and automating security tools.

We are looking for individuals with engineering and security experience, as well as a history of remarkable achievement. Senior security operations personnel with engineering experience and senior developers with security experience are equally well-suited to this role.

Beyond securing Canonical’s digital estate, this position represents a unique opportunity to contribute to the open source ecosystem. Team members may present at industry conferences, share threat intelligence with the wider community, or publish open source security software.

Junior positions are also available for less-experienced individuals with a compelling academic or professional background.

In this role, you will:

  • Provide operational and engineering leadership.
  • Implement and evolve Canonical’s Security Operations Center.
  • Design and develop security software and platforms.
  • Monitor for, identify, respond to, and remediate security incidents.
  • Assess and improve Canonical’s security controls.
  • Mentor early-career Security Operations engineers.
  • Plan and deliver work within Canonical's agile engineering framework.
  • Contribute to open source security.
  • Publish blog posts, whitepapers and conference presentations.

We are looking for:

  • An exceptional academic track record.
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path.
  • 10+ years of relevant professional experience
  • Professional cybersecurity experience, preferably working or leading a Security Operations Center.
  • Professional engineering experience.

  • Proficiency in common scripting languages, such as Python and Bash.
  • Knowledge of Git, GitOps, Infrastructure-as-Code, and common orchestration platforms (e.g., Kubernetes)

Though optional, we value:

  • Familiarity with security frameworks such as the NIST CSF, CIS CSC, and ISO 27001
  • Knowledge of security architecture and market-leading security tools.
  • Experience in a security operations team or a security operations center.
  • Experience in offensive or defensive security teams with hands-on ability.

  • Recognition rewards

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
