raw.description:
This is a remote position.

Senior Data Engineer \ Associate Architect – Microsoft Fabric

Location: Remote (India)

Experience: 6-8 Years

Employment Type: Full Time

Company: indigoChart Technologies India Pvt. Ltd.

About indigoChart

indigoChart takes pride in delivering excellence by collaborating with decision-makers to execute on their Data Modernization Strategies.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Engineer\ Associate Data Architect to join our dynamic team and play a key role in designing and building the Microsoft Fabric data pipelines that power our customers' analytics use cases.

About the Role

We're looking for a skilled Senior Data Engineer\ Associate Data Architect with 6-8 years' experience to join our remote team and take ownership of designing, building, and operating data pipelines on the Microsoft Fabric platform. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced professional to make a significant impact in an innovation-driven environment.

You'll design, build, and own Lakehouse and Warehouse solutions on OneLake - working across ingestion, transformation, and delivery of clean, reliable data through the medallion pattern (Bronze to Silver to Gold) to Power BI and downstream applications.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys solving real data problems, writing solid code, and taking ownership of what they build in production.

Location

100% Remote, preferably based in Mumbai / Pune India , serving global clients with reasonable time-zone overlap.

Key Responsibilities

Data Pipeline Design & Development

  • Design and build Lakehouse and Warehouse solutions on Microsoft Fabric and OneLake, organized using the medallion pattern (Bronze → Silver → Gold).
  • Build ingestion pipelines using Fabric Data Factory pipelines and Data-flows Gen2 to bring data in from databases, files, APIs, and business applications.
  • Develop transformations, data quality checks, and automation in Python/PySpark using Spark notebooks in Fabric.
  • Implement ETL/ELT patterns including incremental load strategies and slowly changing dimensions, and model analytics-ready models consumable by semantic models.

Data & Platform Engineering

  • Deliver Gold-layer data to Power BI semantic models using Direct Lake mode for fast, scalable reporting.
  • Set up and manage Fabric workspaces and monitor capacity usage to keep pipelines performant and cost-efficient.
  • Promote work across Dev to Test to Prod using Fabric deployment pipelines, Git version control, and CI/CD.

Technical Ownership

  • Provide thought leadership by recommending the right technologies and solutions for a given use case, from the application layer to infrastructure.
  • Stand behind your recommendations and explain technical decisions clearly, both internally and to customers.
  • Explore new technologies to continually uncover better, more automated ways to solve data engineering problems.
​

Quality, Performance & Collaboration

  • Ensure performance, security, scalability, and robust data integration across all delivered pipelines, including SQL and Spark performance tuning.
  • Build error handling, logging, and monitoring into every pipeline so issues are caught and resolved before they reach users.
  • Follow the complete software development lifecycle — design, documentation, implementation, testing, and deployment.
  • Collaborate with and help fellow data engineers learn and grow, translating customer needs into dependable, production-ready solutions.

Requirements

What We're Looking For (Mandatory Skills)

  • 6-8 years of professional experience as a Data\Sr. Data Engineer, including hands-on experience building production data pipelines on Microsoft Fabric.
  • Hands-onMicrosoft Fabric experience: Lakehouse and Warehouse design, OneLake, medallion architecture, Data Factory pipelines, Data-flows Gen2, Spark notebooks, and Direct Lake mode with Power BI semantic models.
  • Strong SQL skills (must-have): complex querying, joins, window functions, performance tuning, and data modeling with star schemas, fact and dimension tables.
  • Strong Python / PySpark skills (must-have): writing transformations, data quality checks, and automation in notebooks; familiar with good software practices (functions, modules, testing, error handling).
  • Solid data engineering fundamentals: ETL/ELT design, incremental load strategies, slowly changing dimensions, data warehousing, error handling, and monitoring.
  • Experience with Fabric capacity monitoring, workspace setup, and deployment pipelines.
  • Version control (Git) and CI/CD experience for deploying pipeline code.
  • Experience working directly with stakeholders to translate business needs into data solutions.

Good to have:

  • Microsoft Certified: Fabric Data Engineer Associate (DP-700).
  • Experience with Azure data services such as ADLS Gen2, Azure SQL, and Azure Key Vault.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
  • 6-8 years of experience as a Data Engineer with Software Engineering skills and production experience on Microsoft Fabric and/or Databricks.
  • Strong analytical mindset with excellent troubleshooting, documentation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a startup environment that values speed, ownership, and innovation.

Benefits

Why indigoChart?

  • Remote-First Work Environment — work 100% remote from anywhere in India.
  • Collaborative culture that prizes autonomy, creativity, and transparency.
  • Competitive compensation, excellent benefits, and a generous PTO plan plus holidays.
  • Accelerated learning and professional development through advanced training and certifications.

At indigoChart, every team member contributes to shaping the future of data technology. If you're passionate about building secure, scalable, and intelligent data systems — we'd love to hear from you.

Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity

This is a unique opportunity to work directly with the Chief Global Commercialization Officer (CGCO) and help advance the Global Commercialization agenda during a period of significant growth and execution intensity. We are seeking an enterprise-minded Executive Director, CGCO Operations to provide dedicated strategic and operational support across the CGCO’s priorities, decisions and cross-functional initiatives.

This role reports directly to the CGCO and participates in the Commercialization Leadership Team (CLT) in support of leadership-team effectiveness. The role works closely with CLT members, the Vice President, Global Commercialization Effectiveness & Operations (VP CE&O), and other senior leaders to advance Global Commercialization critical priorities.

The position is a permanent organizational seat designed as an approximately 18-month rotational assignment. Incumbents will maintain the core responsibilities of the role while leading a defined set of priorities agreed with the CGCO. The assignment is intended both to strengthen CGCO & CLT effectiveness and to provide broad executive and enterprise leadership experience.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner directly with theCGCO to prioritize and advance the highest-impact strategic, organizational and operational topics across the Global Commercialization agenda including shaping the content and cadence of business reviews and key planning elements both regionally and across global functions.

    • Prepare & support key executive engagementsincluding leadership discussions, organizational communications and other critical CGCO forums.

  • Provide executive decision support and coordination across CLT & other key leadersby synthesizing complex information, stakeholder perspectives, risks and options into clear recommendations & concise executive materials including working across CLT stakeholders to facilitate and coordinate IR materials, messaging etc.

    • Connect interdependent work, identify gaps and resolve or escalate cross-functional issues that require CGCO attention.

  • Lead select strategic initiatives and special assignments that require senior-level ownership, rapid coordination or focused attention on behalf of the CGCO & CLT.

  • Support CLT effectiveness by helping ensure leadership discussions focus on the right issues and that decisions, commitments and follow-through are clear.

  • Build connectivity across the organization by partnering with regions, functions and other executive offices where priorities intersect.

  • Establish sustainable ownership by transitioning recurring processes or enduring capabilities to VP CE&O or the appropriate functional owner.

  • Ensure continuity across rotations through disciplined documentation and structured handover of priorities, relationships, decisions and open initiatives.

Who You Are

You are a highly trusted, enterprise-oriented leader who can quickly understand complex issues, exercise sound judgment and operate effectively with senior executives. You are comfortable working across a broad agenda, moving between strategy and hands-on execution, and influencing outcomes without relying on formal authority.

You bring clarity and momentum to ambiguous situations while respecting established accountabilities. You build strong relationships across functions and levels, communicate with precision, and know when to lead, facilitate, escalate or transition work to an enduring organizational owner.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

  • Demonstrated Executive Director-level capability and credibility working with senior executives and enterprise leadership teams.

  • Oncology or specialty pharma commercialization experience.

  • Significant experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives in fast-moving and ambiguous environments.

  • Strong strategic thinking and synthesis skills, with the ability to translate complexity into clear issues, options, decisions and actions.

  • Exceptional judgment and discretion when handling confidential, sensitive or time-critical topics.

  • Proven ability to influence without authority and drive alignment across diverse stakeholder groups.

  • Excellent executive communication skills, including concise written materials, presentations and leadership communications.

  • Strong relationship-building and collaboration skills across functions, regions and leadership levels.

  • Demonstrated ability to move between strategy and execution while maintaining focus on outcomes, ownership and follow-through.

  • Enterprise orientation and learning agility, with the ability to rapidly build context across unfamiliar business areas.

  • Bachelor’s degree with 15+ years of relevant experience in biotechnology, pharmaceutical, healthcare, commercialization, strategy, business operations, management consulting or a related field.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience supporting an executive leadership team or leading enterprise strategic initiatives in a strategy, operations, consulting or chief-of-staff-like capacity.

  • Experience across multiple commercialization disciplines, geographies or business functions.

  • Experience with launch readiness, portfolio strategy, organizational transformation, governance or operating-model development.

About the role

The Cybersecurity Lead owns albo's information security at a technical level, across all of its companies, products and platforms: detecting and responding to attacks, securing our applications and cloud, and testing our defenses the way a real attacker would. Reporting to and working side by side with the CISO to deliver albo's security strategy, you will build and lead the cybersecurity team as albo moves from IFPE to SOFIPO, on the way to a banking license, in an increasingly hostile and fast threat landscape supercharged by AI.

What you’ll be doing at albo:

  • Lead all of Cybersecurity and the engineers who join the team. In 2027 the priorities are security operations (SecOps) and application security (AppSec); offensive security (OffSec) follows.
  • Run detection and incident response: bring critical log sources into the SIEM, make sure every alert has an owner, and lead investigations and post-mortems.
  • Share the around-the-clock detection on-call with the CISO, widening the rotation as the team grows.
  • Drive vulnerability management across code and infrastructure so findings are fixed within SLA, and embed security reviews before each release.
  • Work with Infra and Engineering to close the network, centralize administrative access and remove long-lived keys from money flows and CI.
  • Own offensive security: plan and oversee external pentests, manage vulnerability disclosure and validate that our controls work as intended.
  • Cover each cybersecurity function until a dedicated professional joins, and help hire and develop them.
  • Shape albo's security culture together with the CISO, coaching Engineering teams and growing security champions within them. Provide technical input and evidence for SOFIPO, IFPE and Banxico requirements, together with GRC.

About you and what type of skills you'll need:

  • +5 years of experience in Security Engineering, at least 2 of them leading teams or programs.
  • Deep expertise in security operations (detection and incident response) or application security, and working familiarity with the other as well as with offensive security.
  • Hands-on experience with SIEM, WAF, other security tools as well as cloud security.
  • Hands-on experience securing fintech or payments platforms in production.
  • A first-line leader who helps people perform and grow: mentoring, leading by example and setting a high bar.
  • Calm leadership under pressure: you can run an incident, rally teams that don't report to you and explain risk plainly to executives.
  • Familiarity with NIST CSF and ISO/IEC 27001; experience with Mexican financial regulation is a plus.
  • Fluent Spanish and professional English.
  • Certifications such as OSCP, GCIH or CISSP are a plus.
  • Customer Centricity: You're customer-obsessed, constantly thinking about improving the customer experience.
  • Hands-on: We’re looking for a comfortable and willing leader to be a hands-on contributor who is energized by rolling up their sleeves, making things happen, and enabling the team to do the same.
  • Done is better than perfect: As things change and move quickly, you are excited by the fast pace and opportunity to constantly learn and help your team learn.
  • Communication: Excellent ability to communicate internally and externally, quickly build relationships, and work cross-functionally.
  • Extreme ownership: You hold yourself accountable to a high bar. You are supremely organized and see what needs to happen to achieve goals.
  • Results & Data Driven: You understand the business metrics you are responsible for, and you demonstrate these insights to drive constant improvement.

Sumsubis the first AI-powered trust infrastructure for compliance operations at scale. It connects identity and business verification, fraud prevention, transaction monitoring, and risk workflows, helping teams reduce manual work and enter new markets.

Sumsub is recognized as a Great Place To Work® in the US and rated 4.4 out of 5 on Glassdoor. Our 1,000+ people around the world back it up, too: 92% are proud to be Sumsubers, and 90% say their work is interesting and challenging.

Now we are looking for a Customer Support Operator to join our team!

L1 Customer Support Specialist
We’re looking for a Customer Support Specialist to help business clients use Sumsub’s identity verification and compliance platform.
This role is for someone who enjoys working with complex products, investigating problems and finding clear answers. You’ll support businesses that rely on Sumsub in their daily operations, troubleshoot issues and involve other teams when needed.

What you’ll be doing

  • Provide support to B2B clients via Intercom, from how-to questions to integration troubleshooting.

  • Help clients understand and use the platform, its features and settings.

  • Investigate issues by asking the right questions, reviewing available information and following troubleshooting steps.

  • Explain solutions and technical concepts clearly to different audiences.

  • Escalate issues that require engineering or specialist teams, with clear context and investigation results.

  • Keep customer conversations and troubleshooting steps well documented.

  • Use product documentation and internal knowledge resources to find accurate answers.

  • Work with colleagues across teams and share recurring customer issues and feedback.

  • Keep up with product changes and continuously develop your technical knowledge.

What we’re looking for

  • Experience in B2B customer support, preferably supporting business clients using a software product or platform.

  • Experience working with complex digital products and the ability to learn new systems and workflows quickly.

  • Experience investigating customer issues, not just answering routine questions.

  • Familiarity with Intercom or similar customer support tools, and willingness to learn Intercom.

  • Basic understanding of APIs, including requests and responses, JSON and common HTTP status codes.

  • Comfortable working with logs, browser developer tools and basic SQL queries.

  • Ability to follow technical documentation and collect useful information for troubleshooting.

  • Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to explain complex topics simply and professionally.

  • Attention to detail, analytical thinking and ownership of customer issues.

  • Ability to manage multiple conversations and priorities.

Nice to have

  • Experience in fintech, payments, identity verification, compliance or another regulated industry.

  • Basic knowledge of KYC or AML processes.

  • Experience supporting a SaaS platform with integrations or technical configurations.

  • Familiarity with Postman.

What We Offer:

  • Remote-first, trust-based culture. Work from the place that works best for you. No mandatory office days, no attendance trackers. In some locations, we provide offices or coworking spaces, but the choice is yours.

  • Extra time off. Your birthday is a holiday here. Add to that 10 personal days each year, seven sick days without paperwork, and extra time to enjoy Christmas and New Year. Time to rest is part of the deal.

  • Work that matters.Our mission is to build a digital world that is secure, accessible and inclusive for everyone. From fighting fraud to making online services easier and safer to use, your work will have a real impact on how people experience trust online.

  • Compensation.We offer fair and transparent pay, benchmarked to the market.

  • Truly global.We work across continents and time zones, with teammates and customers from all over the world. You will run campaigns that cross borders, cultures, and languages, and see your ideas land worldwide.

  • Growth built in. Clear goals, open feedback and personal development plans. We support your progress with learning opportunities and by covering role-specific events, from design conferences to marketing forums.

  • Team offsites. Sometimes just Slack is not enough. That is why we meet in person a few times a year. Trips are fully covered, so you can meet, collaborate, and recharge together.

  • Getting you set up. We make sure you have access to the tools and hardware you need to do your work well.

  • Friendly by design.Our logo is a dog for a reason. We keep things human, open and kind. We welcome individuality, quirks and different perspectives, because that is what makes our work smarter and more fun.

We’re looking for an experienced Game UI/UX Artist to join iLogos Game Studios and create engaging, visually distinctive interfaces for an upcoming stylized multiplayer shooter.

We're especially interested in artists who combine strong game UI/UX expertise, creative visual design, and hands-on AI-assisted workflows to deliver polished, production-ready interfaces.

We're developing a 16-player F2P multiplayer FPS / mini battle royale in Unity, featuring a dark, whimsical visual style inspired by Tim Burton, with the strong silhouettes and visual readability of Team Fortress 2.

The game takes place in an atmospheric amusement park filled with eccentric characters, stylized weapons, and unusual environments.

Our goal is to create a distinctive, immersive UI that complements the game's gothic-inspired aesthetic while ensuring excellent readability during fast-paced mobile gameplay.

What we’re looking for:

  • 3+ years of professional experience in game UI/UX design, preferably for mobile F2P games.

  • Strong portfolio featuring game UI for shooters, action games, or other fast-paced gameplay experiences.

  • Proven experience designing HUD elements with strong readability and usability.

  • Proficiency in Figma and Adobe Photoshop.

  • Experience designing F2P monetization interfaces, including stores, offers, bundles, currencies, and reward systems.

  • Strong skills in stylized game UI, beyond standard flat or product-oriented interface design.

  • Understanding of Unity UI integration requirements, including prefabs, anchors, safe areas, slicing, and responsive layouts.

  • Excellent understanding of visual hierarchy, composition, typography, color, and usability.

  • Strong hands-on experience with generative AI tools for UI art, icons, and visual asset creation.

  • Ability to demonstrate independently developed or customized AI workflows, including style consistency, manual refinement, and production-ready results.

Nice to have:

  • Experience creating UI animations, transitions, and interactive effects.

  • Hands-on experience implementing UI directly in Unity UI (uGUI).

  • Familiarity with Unity URP and mobile performance considerations.

  • Experience with dark fantasy, gothic, or whimsical game interfaces.

  • Previous experience working on multiplayer shooters or battle royale games.

What the role is about:

    • In-game HUD: weapons, ammo, zone indicators, kill feed, and other gameplay elements.

    • Menus and navigation: main menu, settings, and progression screens.

    • Monetization UI: in-game store, special offers, bundles, chests, and rewards.

  • Develop intuitive UX flows, wireframes, and layouts optimized for mobile devices and different screen resolutions.

  • Ensure excellent readability and usability during fast-paced gameplay.

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Opportunity to shape the UI/UX of a distinctive stylized multiplayer game.

  • Opportunity to contribute to the studio's AI-assisted art pipelines.

raw.description:
Title: Amharic Consecutive Interpreter – On-Demand
Location: Remote
Job Type: Independent Contractor

A Reviver Amharic Consecutive Interpreter plays a crucial role in facilitating effective communication between individuals who speak different languages. Consecutive interpreters listen to a speaker in one language and render their speech into another language after a brief pause.

As an Amharic consecutive interpreter, you will bridge language gaps, ensuring clarity and understanding in various over-the-phone situations.

Responsibilities

  • Provide consecutive interpretation services during phone calls, meetings, conferences, interviews, and other interactions.

  • Listen carefully to the speaker in the source language and convey the message accurately in the target language.

  • Maintain professionalism, confidentiality, and cultural sensitivity throughout the interpretation process.

  • Respect HIPAA requirements and comply with Reviver's protocols, policies, and industry best practices as required by our clients.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of interpretation experience or at least 3,000 hours of active interpretation experience.

  • Native or near-native proficiency in Amharic and strong proficiency in English.

  • Proof of English language proficiency at the Technical Proficiency level on the national ILR scale or equivalent.

  • Successful completion of a Mock Call assessment.

  • Updated resume demonstrating relevant interpretation experience.

  • Criminal background check in English.

  • Technical infrastructure to support interpretation assignments, including a laptop, stable internet connection, and a compatible headset.

Professional Standards

Reviver's evaluation process adheres to interpreting standards established by:

  • International Medical Interpreters Association (IMIA)

  • The National Certification Commission for Healthcare Interpreters (CCHI)

  • National Council on Interpreting in Health Care (NCIHC)

raw.title: Cybersecurity Analyst
raw.excerpt: About Netrio Netrio is a leading managed services provider delivering IT and cybersecurity solutions to small and mid-market organizations across North America.
raw.description:
About Netrio

Netrio is a leading managed services provider delivering IT and cybersecurity solutions to small and mid-market organizations across North America. Our services include managed IT, cybersecurity, cloud and infrastructure, network and communications, software and automation, and professional services.

Netrio's cybersecurity team helps clients identify and manage risk, improve their security posture, meet regulatory and contractual requirements, and build sustainable cybersecurity programs. Our services include cybersecurity assessments, governance, risk and compliance, vCISO advisory, regulatory compliance support, vendor risk management, penetration testing, incident response readiness, and security consulting.

About the role

Netrio is seeking a Cybersecurity Analyst to support our cybersecurity consulting team on assessment, governance, risk, and compliance engagements for our clients. This is an entry-level position, well suited to recent graduates and early-career professionals who want to build a career in cybersecurity consulting.

This role requires curiosity, analytical ability, clear written and verbal communication, and strong organizational skills. The Cybersecurity Analyst will work closely with Cybersecurity Consultants, project managers, and technical teams, with growing exposure to client stakeholders, to gather information, assess cybersecurity environments, document findings, and support the delivery of cybersecurity projects and ongoing client programs.

Success in this position starts with dependable execution of assigned work and a strong desire to learn. The ideal candidate is eager to build new skills, takes initiative on the tasks they are given, keeps their work organized, asks questions early, and clearly communicates progress and roadblocks to the team. Over time, analysts are expected to take on increasing ownership and responsibility.

What you'll do

  • Support cybersecurity assessments against recognized security frameworks, standards, and regulatory requirements under the guidance of senior team members.
  • Collect and organize technical and non-technical information through documentation review, system evidence, and client questionnaires, and participate in client interviews and working sessions.
  • Analyze collected information to identify gaps, risks, and observations, and map them to applicable framework controls.
  • Draft assessment results, observations, risks, recommendations, and supporting evidence in a clear and professional manner for review by senior team members.
  • Track assigned tasks, outstanding information requests, and deadlines, and keep project documentation and evidence organized.
  • Communicate progress, questions, and potential delays to consultants and project managers in a timely manner.
  • Assist with ongoing client programs such as vCISO advisory, regulatory compliance support, vendor risk management, and incident response readiness, including vendor risk assessments, security questionnaires, and policy and procedure reviews.
  • Learn Netrio’s methodologies, tools, and deliverables, and actively seek feedback to grow technical and consulting skills.
  • Work collaboratively with consultants, project managers, and technical teams, and ask for help or escalate issues early when needed.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field. Recent graduates are encouraged to apply.
  • 0 to 2 years of experience in cybersecurity, IT, risk, audit, or compliance. Internships, co-ops, academic projects, and lab work all count.
  • Foundational understanding of cybersecurity concepts such as risk management, access control, and network security, and awareness of frameworks such as the NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0.
  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to document findings clearly and professionally.
  • Good verbal communication skills and comfort working with colleagues and, over time, client stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with close attention to detail.
  • Ability to stay organized, manage assigned tasks and deadlines, and ask for help when needed.
  • Curiosity and a genuine willingness to learn.

Preferred:

  • A relevant entry-level certification, or one in progress, such as CompTIA Security+ or ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity (CC).
  • Internship, co-op, or hands-on project experience in cybersecurity, IT, audit, or GRC.
  • Exposure to additional frameworks and regulations, such as CIS Controls, ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, or PCI DSS.
  • Familiarity with incident response concepts, vulnerability management, or security tools through coursework, home labs, or competitions such as CTFs.
  • Exposure to third-party risk management (TPRM) processes or platforms.
  • Experience in a client-facing or customer service role, or in an MSP or professional services environment.

How This Position Impacts Others

  • The Cybersecurity Analyst supports consultants and builds strong working relationships with colleagues and, over time, customers.
  • Helps to make our clients more secure by gathering accurate information and documenting findings that drive improvements to their policies, configurations, cyber controls, and other elements of a healthy and mature cybersecurity posture.
  • Consistently producing on-time, quality work increases client loyalty, sets your consultants and Program Manager up for success, and allows business leaders to focus on the strategy and vision of the team.
  • Assists the team in supporting the delivery of new and existing client business.

Our cybersecurity analysts are curious, eager to learn, and team players who ask good questions and step outside their comfort zone. This allows them to grow as individuals, build a path toward becoming a Cybersecurity Consultant, and contribute to the overall success of the team and Netrio.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field

raw.description:
Position Type: Full-Time | Remote
Working Hours: 9:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time, Monday–Friday

About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented Senior Bookkeeper / Accounting Operations Specialist to manage financial records and support accounting operations. You will be responsible for keeping the books accurate, reconciling 10+ accounts, managing vendor and customer payments, tracking trip profitability, and maintaining accurate financial and booking records. You will also help improve systems, reporting, and automation to reduce manual work. The role requires strong Xero, Excel and Google Sheets experience, along with the ability to work independently and handle confidential financial information.

Key Responsibilities

Accounting & Reconciliation

  • Perform monthly and quarterly reconciliations across 10+ bank, credit card, HubSpot and accounting accounts.
  • Review and categorize expenses in Xero.
  • Identify duplicate payments, missing transactions, unusual charges, and discrepancies.
  • Maintain accurate financial records and supporting documentation.

Payments & Vendor Management

  • Track vendor and customer payments, outstanding balances, and payment status.
  • Coordinate domestic and international payments, including foreign currency transactions.
  • Manage payments through platforms such as Convera (GlobalPay).
  • Work with vendors, operators, and internal teams to resolve payment issues.

Trip Profitability & Reporting

  • Track gross and net margins by trip or flight.
  • Monitor trip-related costs including aircraft, catering, transportation, and other operational expenses.
  • Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual expense and financial reports.
  • Maintain vendor variance and fixed-cost reports.
  • Provide management with clear reporting on expenses, margins, and payments.

CRM & Systems Management

  • Keep HubSpot deal stages and booking information up to date.
  • Maintain accurate trip details, pricing, invoicing, and payment status.
  • Reconcile HubSpot data with Xero and other financial records.
  • Organize financial documents and shared accounting folders.

Process Improvement

  • Build and maintain Excel and Google Sheets templates, dashboards, and reporting tools.
  • Use formulas, pivot tables, and data validation to improve reporting.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive accounting and reporting tasks.
  • Improve processes to reduce manual work and prevent errors.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 3+ years of experience in bookkeeping, accounting operations, or financial analysis.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Xero, including reconciliation, expense coding, and reporting.
  • Experience reconciling 10+ accounts on a monthly and quarterly basis.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets skills, including XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, SUMIFS, pivot tables, and data validation.
  • Experience handling international payments and foreign currency transactions.
  • Strong understanding of financial reporting and account reconciliation.
  • Fluent English with strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to handle confidential financial information.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Availability during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Convera GlobalPay and international payment workflows.
  • Experience with HubSpot or a similar CRM.
  • Experience in private aviation, charter, luxury travel, or hospitality.
  • Experience working with U.S.-based companies and USD accounting.
  • Experience building automated reports or workflows.
  • Xero Advisor Certification.
  • Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

Remote & Availability Requirements

  • Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated, secure workspace.
  • Must be available during 9:00 AM–5:00 PM ET, Monday–Friday.
  • Occasional after-hours, weekend, or holiday availability is required for urgent matters such as operator payments, declined cards, or vendor issues affecting active flights.
  • Must be reachable by phone and able to respond promptly during urgent situations.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 90 days, you will be expected to learn the company's systems and vendor network, reconcile all 10+ accounts, align HubSpot records with the books, complete a monthly close, and deliver trip-level margin reporting.

Over time, you will help make the accounting and reporting process faster, more accurate, and more automated while providing leadership with reliable financial information for business decisions.

Interview Process

  1. AI Screening
  2. Client Interview
  3. Offer Stage

raw.title: IT Enterprise NOC Manager
raw.excerpt: At VC3, we don’t just solve IT problems — we own them.
raw.description:
At VC3, we don’t just solve IT problems — we own them. We serve hundreds of municipalities and organizations across the United States and Canada, bringing IT to the people who need it most. We believe in earning trust, having a growth mindset, and delivering excellence every single time.

We're a team of doers, builders, and tech whisperers who live by 4 core values:
Go Beyond | Own It | Be Curious| Serve as One
We pride ourselves on making IT personal, making IT easy, and getting IT right. And it all starts with our talented team that is committed to raising the bar.
The Impact you will have:

The Enterprise Service Manager owns the proactive health and availability of client infrastructure VC3 manages: patching, vulnerability scanning, scheduled maintenance, network device updates, and the standards and records behind them. The goal is fewer incidents and less ticket noise, not faster reaction to them. We want a leader who strengthen the team: clear standards, clean queues, data-driven reporting, and a culture people want to be part of.

Event and Alert Management:
  • Own event and alert management end to end: triage, response, remediation within SLA, and escalation, across all shifts.
  • Own the staffing model for alert response, including overflow to Service Delivery and offshore analysts when volume spikes, under agreed runbooks and handoff rules.
  • Keep alerts accurate and actionable, each tied to a runbook, and retire noise.
  • Partner with Automation to auto-remediate the highest-volume alert types.
  • Review every missed or late alert that caused client impact, and close the gap.
  • Ensure CJIS client alerts are handled only by CJIS-cleared, US-based staff.

What you will be doing:

  • Lead, hire, coach, and review NOC staff; manage schedules, utilization, and on-call for 24/7 coverage.
    Lead a multi-shift team, including an overnight manager, and plan 24/7 coverage within CJIS requirements.
  • Track and report SLA performance; keep the backlog current, prioritized, and time-entered in real time.
  • Act as escalation point for client incidents, major infrastructure issues, and escalations from Service Delivery. communicate clearly with clients and internal teams.
  • Take ownership of major incidents, ensuring coordination of resolving parties, effective communication to stakeholders, and post-incident reviews.
  • Proactively manage capacity and ensure the staff requisition process is followed in a timely manner.
  • Present operational performance, trends, and improvement plans to senior management in a clear and concise way.
  • Work autonomously, making independent decisions, prioritizing work, and allocating resources to meet objectives without extensive oversight.
  • Own OS and application patching for servers and workstations, plus network device updates: schedules, maintenance windows, approvals, and exceptions.
  • Run and maintain vulnerability scanning tools so scans cover every managed asset on schedule.
  • Report patch compliance by client, OS, and severity.
  • Run recurring hygiene and lifecycle work: firmware, end-of-life OS and hardware, certificate and warranty expirations.
  • Manage capacity and thresholds so problems are caught before they cause outages.
  • Lead root cause analysis (RCA) on recurring incidents and turn findings into preventive tasks or automation.
  • Ensure monitoring tools and other standard tools are deployed and functioning on every managed endpoint.
  • Track uptime and performance of client network infrastructure.
  • Tune monitoring and alerts so they are accurate and actionable.
  • Coordinate with vendors and carriers to resolve network issues.
  • Write and maintain NOC standards, runbooks, and documentation, aligned with VC3 toolset governance.
  • Keep asset and configuration records accurate in ConnectWise and IT Glue.
  • Partner with the Automation and Toolset teams to automate remediation and remove manual, repetitive work.
Shift Coordination:
  • Coordinate with Service Delivery on overnight resource coverage, scheduling, and staffing to support 24/7 operations.
  • Define and maintain the handoff process between shifts, covering open work, in-progress maintenance, and active escalations.
  • Review overnight activity with Service Delivery and close gaps in coverage or handoff.
Additional Responsibilities:
  • Collaborate across all VC3 departments to maximize overall customer satisfaction.
  • Maintain accurate and up to date documentation through the change management processes.
  • Ensure quality administrative results from your team. For example, real-time time entry, timely submission of timesheets and expenses, frequent and business appropriate customer communications, and overall presentability.
  • Be a leader within the company, attending staff events, participating in meetings, encouraging a positive morale and holding all employees accountable. Set the example to follow for customer service.
  • Attend training & team meetings as required.
  • Additional duties as required
Performance Deliverables:
Each employee’s performance is tracked through both leading and lagging key performance metrics. The Enterprise Service Manager is evaluated on both team and corporate goals. These deliverables are expected to have improvement plan in first 60 days.
  • SLA Performance – SLAs met and reported monthly.
  • Patching – Managed workstations, servers, and network devices maintained in an N-1 state (no more than one release behind current), reportable and trackable.
  • NOC-Generated Ticket Volume – Clear downward trend in duplicate and unactionable tickets.
  • Repeat Incidents – Recurring issues on the same assets on a clear downward trajectory.
  • Tool and Record Coverage – Monitoring tools and other standard tools healthy everywhere; asset records accurate.
  • Utilization: This is a measure of the time spent working on utilized work types, (Billable time on SRs) versus non-utilized work types, (Sick time, Admin time). Vacation, Break, meeting and training time are excluded from this calculation.

The tools you bring:

  • 8+ years relevant technical experience supporting server, network, and endpoint environments, ideally at an MSP.
  • 8+ years relevant management or leadership experience, including hiring, coaching, and performance management, OR completion of VC3 leadership academy and 5+ years of leadership experience at VC3.
  • Proven ownership of a patching program with measurable compliance results.
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring tools (Kaseya, NinjaOne, ConnectWise, N-able or similar), including building policies or automation in them.
  • Experience with budgeting, headcount planning, and vendor cost analysis.
  • Experience in managing and working with the following technologies:
    • Windows Server
    • Cloud environments including Microsoft 365
    • Virtualization (Hyper-V, VMware)
    • Routing and Switching
    • Firewalls
    • Network device firmware
  • Experience running RCA, SLA reporting, and capacity or threshold management.
  • Demonstrable experience in incident, problem, and change management.
  • Comfort working from data: building reports, setting targets, and explaining trends to leadership.
  • Clear written and verbal communication with clients, vendors, carriers, and internal teams.
  • Preferred: ITIL foundation or similar process background.
  • Preferred: Scripting or automation (PowerShell or similar).
  • Preferred: Experience running vulnerability scanning tools.
  • Preferred: Experience with ConnectWise PSA and IT Glue.
  • Preferred: Microsoft, Cisco, or similar industry certifications.

What's in it for you:

  • Flexibility– We’re remote-first, but not remote-only. Some roles include an onsite component, depending on team needs. We aim to give you the flexibility to do your best work, plus company-paid time off to help you thrive in work and in life.
  • Well-being & Support - Caring for our team goes beyond the workday. We offer a range of benefits to support your overall well-being, from mental health and leave support through our Employee and Family Assistance Program, to financial wellness through company-matched 401(k)/RRSP plans. Whether it’s today’s needs or tomorrow’s goals, we’ve got you covered.
  • Grow with Us – Whether you’re just getting started or ready to take the next step, we are committed to investing in your growth. We offer structured development through our Leadership Academy, monthly learning sessions, mentorship programs, learning reimbursements, internal career fairs, job shadowing, and personalized career-pathing to support internal mobility.
  • People-First Culture – We live our values, support each other, and create a space where everyone belongs. We have a common goal of doing work that matters, with autonomy, recognition, and a mission to serve those who serve.
  • Transparent Leadership – From open communication to clear company goals, our leaders are involved, and our managers are here to support your growth every step of the way.
Applicant selected will be subject to a criminal and department of motor vehicles background checks and must meet Criminal Justice Information Systems (CJIS) requirements post-employment
Thank you for your interest in VC3. We appreciate all applications; however, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.
Learn more about VC3 by visiting our website and follow us on LinkedIn to stay informed!

raw.description:
At Solventum, we improve lives by helping healthcare professionals do their best work. Join a team using innovation and insight to make a real impact on the future of healthcare. All roles listed are with Solventum, and we’re committed to protecting your personal information—learn more in our Privacy Policy

Job Description:

Director, Digital Health & Customer Platforms - Remote

3M Health Care is now Solventum

At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.

We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.

The Impact You’ll Make

We are seeking a Director, Digital Health & Customer Platforms to lead the strategy, modernization, development, and evolution of Solventum’s digital ordering, customer, patient, and connected-care capabilities.

This leader will own the Express platform and shape the future of how customers order Solventum solutions, how Solventum connects with healthcare systems and technology partners, and how patients and providers engage with digital capabilities throughout the therapy journey. The role encompasses digital ordering, customer platforms, healthcare interoperability, patient engagement, remote patient monitoring, data-enabled experiences, partner integrations, workflow automation, and emerging digital technologies.

The opportunity extends beyond improving today’s platforms. You will help create simpler, faster, more automated and connected experiences that increasingly integrate with the systems and workflows customers, providers, and patients already use. You will lead the development organization responsible for delivering these capabilities and translate business needs into technology roadmaps, development priorities, budgets, and investment decisions.

Our vision is to meet customers, providers, and patients where they are, whether through Express, integrated hospital workflows, EHR/EMR ecosystems, partner technologies, patient-facing applications, remote patient monitoring, or future connected digital experiences.


How you will make an impact

  • Set the digital platform strategy: Own the multiyear vision, roadmap, and investment priorities for Express and the broader portfolio of digital ordering, customer platform, patient engagement, remote patient monitoring, interoperability, and connected-care capabilities.
  • Transform the customer experience: Simplify complex ordering and service processes, reduce duplicate entry and administrative burden, and create intuitive digital experiences for customers across acute, post-acute, and home-care settings. Identify opportunities to automate workflows, eliminate repetitive work, and improve the overall experience of doing business with Solventum.
  • Advance patient engagement and remote patient monitoring: Lead digital capabilities that support patients throughout the therapy journey, including patient-facing applications, remote patient monitoring, patient communication and engagement, therapy support, and digitally enabled interactions between patients and care teams.
  • Connect with clinical workflows: Advance integration with hospital systems, EHR/EMR platforms, interoperability networks, and healthcare technology ecosystems, enabling ordering, documentation, therapy management, and other interactions to increasingly occur within customers’ existing clinical and administrative workflows.
  • Lead healthcare interoperability and partner integrations: Establish the strategy for APIs, integrations, healthcare data exchange, and technology partnerships that connect Solventum solutions with health systems, external platforms, and the broader healthcare ecosystem.
  • Develop data-enabled capabilities: Establish how customer, ordering, patient, therapy, device, and partner data can be used responsibly to improve workflows, experiences, operational performance, decision-making, and future digital solutions.
  • Navigate the reimbursement landscape: Maintain a strong understanding of healthcare reimbursement, payer requirements, DME workflows, documentation requirements, revenue-cycle dependencies, and evolving reimbursement models. Ensure digital solutions support clinical and customer workflows while enabling the documentation and operational requirements necessary for reimbursement.
  • Shape the technology strategy: Maintain a forward-looking understanding of the healthcare technology landscape, including digital health, EHR/EMR platforms, interoperability, remote monitoring, patient engagement, AI, automation, data platforms, and emerging technologies. Evaluate build, buy, and partner opportunities and translate changes in the technology landscape into actionable business strategies.
  • Lead product and software development: Lead and develop the teams responsible for delivering customer and patient digital capabilities. Translate business strategy and customer needs into clear product requirements, development priorities, and technology roadmaps while balancing speed, quality, regulatory requirements, cybersecurity, technical sustainability, and business value.
  • Prioritize business needs and manage investment: Establish portfolio priorities across business units and stakeholders and translate those needs into development roadmaps, budgets, resource allocation, and investment decisions. Make trade-offs based on customer and patient impact, strategic value, business benefit, development capacity, technical complexity, regulatory requirements, and available funding.
  • Accelerate automation: Apply workflow automation, intelligent decisioning, APIs, data, and AI to reduce manual processing, improve speed and accuracy, eliminate repetitive work, and enable greater straight-through processing.
  • Create connected experiences across the continuum of care: Connect digital ordering, patient engagement, remote monitoring, interoperability, data, and other digital services to support the patient and customer journey from hospital initiation and ordering through discharge, home therapy, monitoring, service, documentation, and ongoing therapy management.
  • Drive measurable outcomes: Establish and manage KPIs spanning order cycle time, customer effort, patient engagement, digital adoption, automation, interoperability, platform reliability, operational efficiency, development performance, and overall business impact.
  • Lead across the enterprise: Partner across technology, R&D, operations, commercial, marketing, clinical, customer service, regulatory, privacy, cybersecurity, reimbursement, finance, and external technology partners to translate business priorities into an integrated digital roadmap.
  • Build a high-performing team: Lead and develop digital product, platform, integration, and software development talent while creating clear accountability for customer, patient, technology, and business outcomes. Establish an operating model that connects strategy, product ownership, development, implementation, lifecycle management, and continuous improvement.

Your Skills and Expertise

To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:


  • Bachelor’s degree AND 7+ years of experience in digital product management, healthcare technology, digital health, digital commerce/ordering, customer platforms, connected care, interoperability, or enterprise digital transformation.

AND


In addition to the above requirements, the following are also required:

  • Experience leading a significant digital product, platform, development organization, or technology portfolio.
  • Modernizes business-critical healthcare workflows and develops or manages patient-facing digital solutions, including patient engagement, remote patient monitoring, connected devices, and digitally enabled therapy management, while meeting operational and regulatory requirements.
  • Applies knowledge of digital product management, platform strategy, software development, APIs and integrations, interoperability, automation, data, AI, healthcare reimbursement, payer requirements, DME fulfillment, and revenue-cycle processes.
  • Develops and manages multiyear technology and product roadmaps, budgets, investment priorities, development capacity, and portfolio trade-offs, and evaluates technologies, vendors, partnerships, and build-versus-buy options.
  • Leads multidisciplinary and cross-functional teams to translate customer, patient, clinical, commercial, and operational requirements into technology priorities, development plans, investment decisions, and measurable outcomes.

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

  • Masters degree from an accredited institution
  • Experience in MedTech, healthcare technology, digital health, healthcare services, DME, or another regulated industry.
  • Experience with hospital clinical and administrative workflows and EHR/EMR ecosystems.
  • Experience with healthcare interoperability, healthcare data exchange, APIs, digital ordering, partner integrations, and connected-care workflows.
  • Experience with remote patient monitoring, connected therapy, patient engagement platforms, patient-facing applications, or digitally enabled therapy management.
  • Experience with reimbursement, payer, DME, documentation, and revenue-cycle workflows.
  • Experience leading or partnering directly with software development and technical teams, including prioritizing development capacity against business requirements and available funding.
  • Experience applying automation, intelligent decisioning, data, or AI to complex operational and healthcare processes.
  • Experience evaluating and establishing strategic technology partnerships to extend internal capabilities and accelerate business strategy.

What Success Looks Like

Success is bigger than adding features to a platform. It is creating a connected digital ecosystem that makes it easier for customers to do business with Solventum, integrates Solventum into the healthcare workflows where care is delivered, supports patients throughout their therapy journey, and connects ordering, interoperability, data, patient engagement, remote patient monitoring, and digital services into a cohesive experience.

Success also means ensuring that business priorities drive technology investments, that development resources and budgets are focused on the highest-value opportunities, and that Solventum continues to evolve as healthcare technology, reimbursement models, interoperability, customer expectations, and patient needs change.

Ultimately, it is creating the simplest, fastest, and most connected experience for customers, providers, partners, and patients, whether that experience happens in Express, within a hospital or EHR workflow, through an integrated technology partner, through a patient-facing application or remote monitoring experience, or through the next generation of connected digital capabilities.


Work location: Remote - USA

Travel: May include up to 10% domestic/international

Relocation Assistance: May be authorized

Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).

Supporting Your Well-being 

Solventum offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, Solventum regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope. 

Responsibilities of this position include that corporate policies, procedures and security standards are complied with while performing assigned duties.

Solventum is committed to maintaining the highest standards of integrity and professionalism in our recruitment process. Applicants must remain alert to fraudulent job postings and recruitment schemes that falsely claim to represent Solventum and seek to exploit job seekers.

Please note that all email communications from Solventum regarding job opportunities with the company will be from an email with a domain of @solventum.com. Be wary of unsolicited emails or messages regarding Solventum job opportunities from emails with other email domains.

Please note, Solventum does not expect candidates in this position to perform work in the unincorporated areas of Los Angeles County.Solventum is an equal opportunity employer. Solventum will not discriminate against any applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

At T-Mobile, we invest in YOU! Our Total Rewards Package ensures that employees get the same big love we give our customers. Employees enjoy multiple wealth-building opportunities through our annual stock grant, employee stock purchase plan, 401(k), and access to free, year-round money coaches. That’s how we’re UNSTOPPABLE for our employees!

raw.description:
Join a team that shares your calling

At MultiCare, you’re more than just a job title — you’re part of a team built on trust that cares for each other, our patients and our communities. Belonging here means living our mission and values every day. If your purpose and passions align with ours, you’ll find a place to grow, do meaningful work and build a career you love in a community that feels like home.

FTE: 1.0, Shift: Day, Schedule: Day

Position Summary

The Enterprise Pricing Architect leads the development, maintenance, and optimization of enterprise pricing strategies for $20B+ of hospital and professional services gross revenue. This role analyzes charge structures, reimbursement methodologies, and market competitiveness to advance organizational financial objectives. By collaborating closely with senior Revenue Integrity, Payer Contracting, Finance, and Operational leadership, the Architect ensures pricing decisions optimize reimbursement and support strategic objectives. The Architect also ensures that system algorithms and fee schedules are accurately configured, and regulatory compliance is maintained. The ideal candidate combines advanced analytical skills with strong business acumen and the ability to translate complex financial data into actionable recommendations for executive audiences.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop, maintain, and implement a comprehensive pricing strategy for hospital and professional services that aligns with organizational goals, industry benchmarks, and payer reimbursement methodologies. Lead annual pricing reviews, recurring rate updates, and charge structure evaluations, ensuring pricing decisions support financial sustainability, competitive market positioning, and margin integrity.
  • Utilizing SQL, Epic Clarity, and advanced Excel techniques, build complex analytical models to extract, analyze, and interpret gross and net revenue impacts on pricing, factoring in specific payer reimbursement rates, pricing elasticity, competitor pricing, and cost, as necessary.
  • Conduct benchmarking using state databases, commercial pricing tools, and peer comparisons to evaluate market competitiveness; identify pricing outliers, inconsistencies, or opportunities for strategic adjustment; and recommend pricing refinements that balance competitiveness, reimbursement, and patient affordability.
  • Develop executive-level reports for each business unit to guide strategic decision-making and partner with Finance teams to incorporate future price changes into the budgeting process.
  • Support compliance with CMS and state-level price transparency requirements by provisioning data and overseeing pricing data accuracy for public-facing tools; collaborate with internal and external audit teams; and monitor regulatory changes impacting pricing, reimbursement, and charge strategy.
  • Collaborate with clinical and operational stakeholders on new service evaluations, program expansions, and budget variance assessments.
  • Partner with Revenue Integrity to ensure Epic fee schedules and algorithms result in expected pricing, auditing performance and facilitating changes as needed.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare or Business Administration required, with a concentration in accounting, finance or other related field highly preferred.
  • Minimum five (5) years of experience in healthcare financial analysis, revenue integrity, pricing, reimbursement, or related analytical roles in a healthcare setting required.
  • Hands-on experience with hospital/physician pricing, CDM management, or reimbursement modeling strongly preferred.
  • Systems experience and proficiency with Epic, SQL, Microsoft Outlook, PowerPoint, Word, and advanced Excel techniques.

Partnering with patients, families and neighbors across the Pacific Northwest for more than 140 years.

Growth and education

Generous PTO, Code Lavender and Employee Assistance Programs to help you maintain balance and feel cared in your work and life.

Living our values

Respect, integrity, kindness and collaboration guide how we care for patients, communities and each other.

Belonging for all

Resource Groups and outreach programs help ensure every team member feels safe, seen, heard and valued.

Pacific Northwest lifestyle

Work and live where natural beauty, adventure and strong community connections are part of everyday life.

Pay and Benefit Expectations

We provide a comprehensive benefits package, including competitive salary, medical, dental and retirement benefits and paid time off. As required by various pay transparency laws, we share a competitive range of compensation for candidates hired into each position. The pay scale is $101,545.60 - $146,140.80 USD. More than 1.8 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using the Docusign AI-native IAM platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

What you'll do

The Core+ Support Expert - eSign is the internal voice for our customer base, with accountability and responsibility to deliver on our customers’ needs. This role is the liaison between customers and all functional areas within Docusign to resolve technical support inquiries. Working with resources across Docusign, the Core+ Support Expert expedites the resolution of complex technical issues to empower customers to achieve the highest value and adoption of our software.

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Technical Support Manager.

raw.description:
Overview of Position


The Director, SEC Reporting leads the Company’s SEC reporting processes, including quarterly Forms 10-Q, annual Form 10-K, and Benefit Plan financial statements. The role is responsible for the execution and oversight of external financial reporting, ensuring compliance with SEC and U.S. GAAP requirements and maintaining strong disclosure controls and reporting processes. The Director partners across Accounting, FP&A, Legal, Investor Relations, Compensation & Benefits, Tax, Financial Controls, and external audit, while leading and developing the SEC Reporting team.


What will my duties and responsibilities be in this job?


SEC Reporting & Financial Close | 50%

  • Lead SEC reporting activities associated with the quarterly and annual consolidated U.S. GAAP reporting close, including Forms 10-Q, 10-K, and Benefit Plan financial statements.
  • Oversee the preparation, review, and filing of SEC reports and related disclosures for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with SEC and U.S. GAAP requirements.
  • Coordinate reporting activities across business segments and corporate functions; establish deliverables, deadlines, and reporting requirements.
  • Review disclosure support, resolve reporting issues with stakeholders and external auditors, and oversee quarterly XBRL tagging, review, and filing.
  • Review earnings materials, including the financial supplement and earnings release, for consistency, accuracy, and appropriate support.

Technical Accounting, Controls & Governance | 15%

  • Partner with Accounting Policy and other technical accounting stakeholders to assess disclosure impacts of new standards and significant or unusual transactions.
  • Partner with the Financial Controls team to maintain effective SOX and disclosure controls and support remediation where needed.
  • Synthesize complex reporting matters and communicate implications and recommendations to senior Finance leadership and key stakeholders.

Stock-Based Compensation Accounting | 15%

  • Oversee accounting, forecasting, reporting, and disclosures for the Company’s stock-based compensation plans.
  • Partner with Compensation & Benefits, FP&A, Tax, and third-party administrators to ensure accurate expense, EPS calculations, and disclosures.
  • Assess and communicate the accounting and reporting implications of plan changes and new compensation initiatives.

People Leadership & Talent Development | 10%

  • Lead, develop, and coach the SEC Reporting team; establish clear accountabilities, prioritize work, and strengthen technical capability across reporting cycles.
  • Provide timely performance feedback, support development and succession planning, and foster a collaborative, high-accountability team culture.
  • Allocate resources and maintain continuity during high-volume quarterly and annual reporting cycles.

Process Improvement & Strategic Initiatives | 10%

  • Drive improvements in reporting quality, efficiency, automation, documentation, and control sustainability.
  • Partner with the AVP, SEC Reporting & Investment Accounting, on strategic initiatives, complex reporting matters, executive requests, and other external reporting priorities.

Number of Direct Reports

  • 2 direct reports, a Senior Accountant and a Lead Accountant

What are the requirements needed for this position?


  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or a related field.
  • Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible accounting and financial reporting experience.
  • Demonstrated experience leading SEC reporting processes for a publicly traded company, including Forms 10-Q and 10-K.
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP, SEC reporting, XBRL, SOX, and disclosure control requirements.
  • Prior experience leading and developing accounting professionals.
  • Strong technical accounting, analytical, written communication, stakeholder management, and judgment skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines during accelerated reporting cycles.

Travel

  • 5% travel expected for in-person meetings or conferences.

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

  • CPA certification
  • Insurance or financial services industry experience.
  • Public accounting experience supporting SEC registrants.
  • Experience with Workiva or a comparable SEC reporting and XBRL platform.

raw.description:
We are looking for a VAT Manager who wants to do more than just file returns. This role is designed for someone who wants to shape, transform, and ultimately own the indirect tax landscape in a truly international environment. You will start by strengthening and in‑housing VAT compliance and evolve into a global leadership role covering VAT/GST worldwide.


This is a unique opportunity to shape and centralize indirect tax processes in an international environment and act as a key advisor to the business on global indirect tax matters.


In this role, you will report to the Senior Tax Expert and be part of the Global Tax Department.


You Will Make an Impact By:


Short-Term Focus – VAT Compliance & Transformation


  • Prepare and file periodic VAT returns across multiple jurisdictions, including driving the progressive in-housing, centralization and stabilization of compliance processes
  • Support year-end VAT reporting and reconciliations together with our external tax advisors
  • Manage additional filings such as EC Sales Lists, Intrastat, and similar obligations
  • Review and optimize VAT-relevant end-to-end processes (e.g. O2C, P2P, intercompany flows, logistics)
  • Identify gaps, mitigate risks, and implement sustainable solutions
  • Develop policies, guidelines, and practical checklists to ensure compliance and consistency together with audit readiness
  • Support VAT audits and manage requests from tax authorities, ensuring timely, accurate, and well-documented responses across all jurisdictions

Mid- to Long-Term – Global Ownership


  • Take ownership of VAT/GST and indirect tax matters globally (excluding the US)
  • Act as the central point of contact for all indirect tax topics across the organization
  • Drive centralization, standardization and automation of indirect tax processes
  • Ensure indirect tax compliance in international projects and business initiatives
  • Provide expert guidance to cross-functional stakeholders (Finance, Legal, Supply Chain, IT)

Business Partnering & Risk Management


  • Review contracts and agreements to identify and mitigate indirect tax risks
  • Support business decisions with clear and practical tax advice
  • Embed indirect tax considerations into global operations

Skills You Bring:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Tax, Law, Economics, or a related field.
  • Strong 5+ years’ experience in VAT / indirect tax (in-house or Big 4)
  • Solid knowledge of European VAT; exposure to global VAT/GST is a strong advantage
  • Knowledge of ERP systems such as SAP and indirect tax determination processes
  • Proven experience in supporting tax technology, automation, or transformation initiatives as well as compliance, process improvement, and risk management
  • Ability to take ownership and operate in an international, fast-paced environment
  • Strong communication skills and a proactive, solution-oriented mindset
  • Fluency in English; German is a plus

Why Join Us:


  • Own the Global Agenda – Step into a role with true international scope from day one, shaping indirect tax strategy across multiple jurisdictions (not just one market)
  • Create Impact, Not Reports – Move beyond compliance: build, in-house, and transform VAT/GST processes across the organization and leave a visible footprint
  • Strategic Seat at the Table – Work directly with senior stakeholders and act as a go-to expert influencing key business and supply chain decisions
  • From Specialist to Global Lead – Clear pathway to full ownership of global indirect tax (ex-US) – a role rarely available at this level
  • Transformation Instead of Routine – Lead centralization, automation, and optimization initiatives, not just BAU filings
  • International Exposure That Matters – Collaborate with global teams and work on cross-border projects, system implementations, and business transformations
  • High-Caliber Environment – Join a globally operating, innovation-driven organization with strong technical expertise and a collaborative culture

  • Competitive Compensation – Enjoy a fair and transparent salary structure and an annual bonus. We will share all the details with you before the first interview.
  • Flexibility & Work-Life Balance – Benefit from flexible working hours (starting between 6 and 10) and a hybrid or remote work setup.Professional Growth & Development – Take your career to the next level with our Internal Training Center and online Language Courses in the office.
  • Inclusive & Supportive Culture – Join a team that values diversity, collaboration, and open communication. We foster an environment where your ideas matter.
  • Health & Well-being – We care about your health! Access private health insurance, life insurance, Multisport Card contribution, wellness programs, mental health support, and weekly yoga sessions.
  • Extra Perks & Benefits – Enjoy a yearly vacation allowance, Christmas shopping cards, team-building activities, and annual company events.
  • Workspace & Tools – Work in a modern office equipped with everything you need, including ergonomic workstations, modern tools, and collaborative spaces.

raw.description:
Role Overview

Genus PLC has an exciting opportunity. We are looking for a North America Tax & Treasury Manager (remote - USA).

The North America Tax & Treasury Manager will lead tax accounting, compliance, governance, and advisory activities across the company’s U.S. and Canadian operations. We are seeking an experienced professional with a strong corporate tax accounting background, a solid finance and accounting foundation, and 5+ years of proven corporate tax experience, including strong practical knowledge of U.S. federal and state income tax. This role will oversee corporate income and indirect tax deliverables, coordinate with external advisers and tax authorities, support year-end tax provisions and audits, and provide accurate reporting to Group Tax.

The position will also support regional treasury activities, including cash forecasting, banking administration, access controls, and wire-approval processes. Approximately 85% of the role is focused on tax and 15% on treasury, making this an excellent opportunity for an experienced corporate tax professional interested in expanding their treasury exposure.

This position will be based remotely within the United States and will require approximately 10% domestic and international travel. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship.

The salary range for this position is $134,965 - $165,073 USD annually. The salary provided is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels. Genus considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role, function and associated responsibilities, a candidate's work experience, location, education/training, and key skills.

You Will

  • Own the North America year-end tax provision process, including current and deferred tax calculations, state and provincial provisions, tax packs, return-to-provision analysis and audit support.
  • Coordinate US and Canadian corporate income tax compliance with external advisers, including preparation of PBC information, review of federal, state and provincial returns, extensions, elections, filings, payments and refunds.
  • Manage North American indirect tax compliance, reviewing US and Canadian sales and use tax calculations, and filing the returns supported by Avalara software.
  • Oversee or support other tax filings and obligations, including property taxes, Canadian T4A reporting and US 1099 governance, working with Accounts Payable, Global Accounting Services Team, HR and external providers as required.
  • Monitor changes in US and Canadian tax law; assess business impact, communicate relevant developments and maintain appropriate tax controls and documentation.
  • Manage tax authority correspondence, inquiries and audits, prepare or coordinate responses and engage external advisers on where necessary on complex matters.
  • Partner with Group Tax and North American Finance on tax strategy, transfer pricing information requests, business initiatives, forecasts and the timely provision of information required for Group reporting.
  • Prepare regular short- and medium-term treasury cash forecasts for North America, explain material variances and provide visibility of expected tax, operational and financing cash flows to the Group Treasury team.
  • Administer North American banking access and controls, including user security, access reviews, token management, authorized signatory records, wire approval workflows and coordination with banks and internal stakeholders.

Requirements

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Taxation, Business Administration with an accounting concentration, or a closely related field.
  • 5+ years of corporate tax experience, with strong practical knowledge of U.S. federal and state income tax.
  • Experience with Canadian corporate and/or indirect tax matters.
