Lessen’s technology platform provides data-driven insights that unlock key growth opportunities for the entire real estate ecosystem—including investors, owners, managers, and service providers. The company leverages a network of over 30,000 vetted, qualified vendors (Lessen Affiliates) serving clients with over 1 million properties and completing more than 3.5 million work orders annually across an expanding range of services. Lessen, LLC is a venture-backed, privately held company with offices in Scottsdale and Chicago.
Lessen is seeking an experienced Capital Projects Estimator to lead cost planning, budgeting, benchmarking, and preconstruction activities for new club developments.

In this role, you will provide cost guidance throughout the project lifecycle, from design concepts through construction, bidding, and project completion. Working closely with the Capital Planning & Projects, Commercial Facilities, Finance, Vendor Sourcing, and external partners, you will develop project budgets, prepare cost estimates, evaluate contractor pricing, identify potential cost risks, and recommend cost-saving opportunities.

The Capital Projects Estimator will play a key role in making informed decisions that balance project goals, quality standards, and financial objectives on behalf of Lessen’s customer base. The ideal candidate has experience estimating commercial interior construction projects and a strong understanding of design-focused environments such as Banking, Retail, Healthcare, or Fitness spaces.

What You'll Do:

  • Build Cost Models & Estimates: Develop thorough conceptual, schematic, and full construction-document cost estimates broken down by trade and division.
  • Own Preconstruction Planning: Spot cost exposures during site due diligence, flag constructability issues in architectural drawings, and evaluate alternative materials or systems early.
  • Lead Bid Management: Prepare comprehensive bidding packages. Review contractor proposals, bid-leveling analyses, and participate in final contract negotiations.
  • Manage Financial Risk: Run cost-risk assessments at key milestones to protect Lessen and it’s clients from unexpected inflation, site condition surprises, or long-lead delivery delays.
  • Maintain Our Cost Database: Build out historical cost data tracking key metrics by region, club square-footage, and trade to continuously improve our future estimate accuracy.
  • Audit Change Orders: Support field Project Managers by independently auditing contractor change-order proposals for scope accuracy and fair market pricing.

What You'll Need:

  • 7+ years of commercial construction estimating or preconstruction experience, with a heavy emphasis on high-end commercial interiors.
  • Full-scope technical mastery: Expert knowledge of structural, architectural, MEP.
  • Advanced commercial fundamentals: Mastery of quantity takeoffs, bid leveling, material pricing trends, regional labor market conditions, and contractual negotiations.
  • Analytical and financial modeling skills.
  • A Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, Quantity Surveying, or a related field (or equivalent field-proven experience).

    Preferred Experience

  • Prior experience estimating Banking, Retail, Healthcare, or Fitness build outs.
  • Advanced proficiency with Excel and estimating software.
  • Professional certification like a CPE (Certified Professional Estimator) or CCP (Certified Cost Professional).
Why Lessen:

· Health, Dental, Vision, Life, Disability options
· 401K retirement savings plan
· Paid vacation, federal and floating holidays
· Maternity/Paternity Pay
· Career advancement opportunities
· All the tools you'll need to be successful

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.

Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

Job Description

Biostatistician – Real-World Evidence (RWA)

Role Overview

We are seeking a biostatistician with strong experience in real-world data (RWD) with observational study design and safety study experience in addition to RWA CMH experience. This role will support evidence generation across multiple therapeutic areas. This role will focus on the design, analysis, and interpretation of observational studies using EMR and claims data to inform: clinical development, HEOR, regulatory strategy, and market access.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and execute real-world evidence (RWA) studies using EMR and claims data; Conducting data specs, SAP and protocol with key research objectives

  • Develop and apply robust statistical methodologies, including:

  • Causal inference methods (e.g., propensity score methods, weighting, matching; GLM or GLMM, MMRM; survival analysis; random forest)

  • Trial emulation frameworks

  • External control arm development and borrowing strategies

  • Perform data analysis using healthcare coding systems (e.g., ICD, NDC)

  • Conduct sample size estimation and power calculations for observational and hybrid study designs

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with stakeholders across:

  • HEOR

  • Market Access

  • Regulatory

  • Clinical Development

  • Translate complex analytical results into clear, actionable insights, e.g. powerpoint or study report for decision-making

  • Support methodological innovation in RWE, including integration of machine learning approaches where appropriate

Required Qualifications

  • M.S. or Ph.D. in Biostatistics, Statistics, Epidemiology, or related field

  • ≥5 years of experience in RWA/RWD analytics (industry or equivalent)

  • Strong experience with EMR and/or claims data

  • Proficiency in healthcare coding systems (e.g., ICD, NDC)

  • Programming expertise in at least one of: SAS, R, or Python

  • Working knowledge with SQL logic and OMOP data structures

  • Solid understanding of:

  • Causal inference methods

  • Observational study design

  • Sample size and power considerations

  • Some examples: Independently write cohort definitions in SQL logic; Debug data issues e.g., time zero alignment, exposure gaps; Understand concept mapping (ICD ↔ SNOMED ↔ RxNorm); Translate statistical estimand → censoring rule and data extraction logic

  • RWE CMH Experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Ph.D. strongly preferred

  • Experience in one or more therapeutic areas:

  • Diabetes

  • Cardiovascular disease

  • Metabolic disorders

  • Familiarity with:

  • Trial emulation methodologies

  • External control borrowing / hybrid designs

  • Basic machine learning methods applied to RWD

  • Demonstrated ability to work across multiple therapeutic areas (TAs) in a fast-paced environment

  • Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills

  • Advanced (nice-to-have, not always required)

  • Build reusable cohort pipelines

  • Optimize queries for large-scale databases

  • Work across multiple CDMs (OMOP, Sentinel, PCORnet)

Core Competencies

  • Analytical rigor and methodological depth

  • Cross-functional collaboration

  • Ability to operate with agility across diverse projects and therapeutic areas

  • Clear and effective scientific communication

 


At  Syneos Health, we believe in providing an environment and culture in which Our People can thrive, develop and advance. We reward and recognize our people by providing valuable benefits and a quality-of-life balance. The benefits for this position may include a company car or car allowance, Health benefits to include Medical, Dental and Vision, Company match 401k, Eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and individual performance, and flexible paid time off (PTO) and sick time. Because certain states and municipalities have regulated paid sick time requirements, eligibility for paid sick time may vary depending on where you work. Syneos complies with all applicable federal, state, and municipal paid sick time requirements.

$80,600.00 - $145,000.00

The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high of the Syneos Health range for this position. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

CACI is hiring Business Systems Analyst Interns to join our growing Financial Management Business Transformation (FMBT) Interfaces, Data Cleanse, and Conversion (ID&C) program. Our staff members implement financial system interfaces, perform complex data cleanse activities, and migrate data from legacy systems to Momentum Financials (a COTS product) across the Department of Veteran Affairs (VA). As an intern, you will have the opportunity to learn about the different aspects of the VA FMBT ID&C program, expand your skillset, partner with experienced technical resources, and collaborate with other summer interns.   • Collaborate with other analysts to understand the organization’s business processes and legacy system data and processes.
  • Provide functional support for testing. Develop test scenarios and documentation, and perform validation testing for interfaces and/or conversion requirements. Monitor, track, and troubleshoot application operation and data, analyzing incidents and working with the technical team to resolve issues.

Required:

Desired:

  • Previous internship/co-op or other work experience, leadership and teamwork capabilities, interpersonal communication skills, and activities (professional/community/extracurricular).
  • Knowledge of Agile methodologies.
-

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

The Media Group at NBCU supports a powerhouse collection of consumer-first brands including Peacock, NBC, Bravo, NBC Sports, and NBCU International. We’re always looking for ways to innovate faster, accelerate our growth and consistently offer the very best in consumer experience. But most of all, we’re backed by a culture of respect. We embrace authenticity and inspire people to thrive.

The Analyst, Technology Compliance and Assurance will join the Technology Governance and Operational Intelligence team, supporting programs and initiatives across technology compliance, assurance, business continuity, and operational resilience.

In this role, you will partner with engineering, technology operations, cybersecurity, and business teams to assess technical controls, identify risk, support continuity and resilience planning, and improve the processes and technologies used to manage compliance and assurance activities.

You will have the opportunity to work across a broad technology environment, investigate complex issues, analyze data and technical evidence, and help translate compliance and resilience requirements into practical solutions. This role is well suited for someone who is technically curious, analytical, comfortable learning new technologies, and motivated to take ownership of work from initial research through completion.

Job Responsibilities

  • Support technology compliance and assurance activities across SOX, SOC 2, PCI DSS, and other applicable regulatory, security, and internal control requirements.
  • Evaluate technical control implementations and supporting evidence, identify gaps or inconsistencies, and partner with stakeholders to develop practical remediation approaches.
  • Research and interpret technical compliance requirements and translate them into actionable processes, controls, procedures, and operational guidance.
  • Analyze compliance findings, risks, and remediation activities and develop reporting that provides visibility into compliance posture, trends, and progress.
  • Partner with engineering, cybersecurity, technology operations, and business teams on control implementation, assessment, remediation, and continuous improvement.
  • Support reviews of third-party assurance documentation, including SOC reports and security documentation.
  • Support business continuity and operational resilience activities, including business impact analyses, technical continuity planning, recovery strategy assessments, and annual program activities.
  • Identify business and technology dependencies, recovery requirements, and operational risks and help ensure continuity documentation remains accurate and complete.
  • Assist with the development and execution of tabletop and continuity exercises, including scenario research, exercise design, stakeholder coordination, facilitation support, and tracking of improvement opportunities.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify compliance and continuity processes, reduce manual effort, improve data quality, and increase operational efficiency.
  • Support the development, configuration, testing, and ongoing improvement of LogicGate workflows and applications supporting compliance and business continuity programs.
  • Research and evaluate technologies and automation opportunities that improve compliance monitoring, evidence collection, data analysis, reporting, and program execution.
  • Analyze program data to identify trends, discrepancies, risks, and improvement opportunities and develop dashboards and reports that provide actionable insights.
  • Independently manage assigned initiatives and deliverables, establish and track milestones, resolve issues, and communicate risks, dependencies, or delays.
  • Develop clear documentation, standard operating procedures, process guidance, FAQs, and other materials supporting compliance and continuity programs.
  • Support the Compliance Compass communications program by researching technology and compliance topics and translating requirements into clear, practical guidance for technology teams.
  • Prepare presentations, reports, and communications for technical teams, business stakeholders, and leadership.
  • Bachelor's degree in information technology, computer science, cybersecurity, information systems, engineering, business, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
  • 2+ years of relevant experience in technology, IT operations, software development, cybersecurity, technology compliance, risk management, operational resilience, or a related discipline.
  • Demonstrated technical aptitude and foundational knowledge of software applications, infrastructure, cloud technologies, software development, cybersecurity, or IT operations.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with demonstrated ability to investigate issues, evaluate information, identify inconsistencies, and develop practical recommendations.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage assignments, organize priorities, and follow through on deliverables.
  • Experience using Excel, Power BI, or comparable analytical and reporting tools to organize, reconcile, analyze, and present data.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate technical concepts, findings, and requirements to technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Ability to learn unfamiliar technologies, business processes, compliance requirements, and software tools quickly.

Skills & Experience We Are Looking For

  • Hands-on experience or demonstrated familiarity with cloud platforms, software development environments, source code management, CI/CD pipelines, or infrastructure technologies such as AWS, GCP, GitHub, Jenkins, or Kubernetes.
  • Experience assessing or implementing technical controls associated with SOX, SOC 2, PCI DSS, ISO 27001, or comparable control frameworks.
  • Experience supporting business continuity planning, business impact analyses, disaster recovery, technology recovery, or operational resilience programs.
  • Experience with workflow automation, scripting, data analysis, reporting, or visualization using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Excel.
  • Experience with governance, risk, and compliance platforms such as LogicGate or comparable workflow and GRC technologies.
  • Graduate coursework or an advanced degree in cybersecurity, computer science, information systems, engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Relevant professional certifications such as CISA, Security+, CISSP, CBCP, or comparable technology, security, audit, or resilience certifications.
  • Experience working in digital media, streaming, direct-to-consumer, or other technology-intensive environments.
  • Intellectual curiosity and a strong interest in understanding how technologies, systems, and processes work.
  • An analytical and investigative approach, including the ability to assess the quality of information, recognize discrepancies, identify underlying issues, and reach well-supported conclusions.
  • A self-directed and accountable working style, with the initiative to take ownership of assignments and drive them through completion.
  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate, well-organized work.
  • Adaptability and resourcefulness when learning new tools or working across unfamiliar technical or business subject matter.
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to build productive relationships across technical and business teams.
  • A practical, improvement-focused mindset that balances compliance and control objectives with operational efficiency.

Eligibility Requirements

raw.description:
Job Description

A bit about this role:

The Program Manager for UM Operations is a high-impact, hands-on leader responsible for driving consistency, workforce readiness, regulatory compliance, and operational efficiency across the Utilization Management (UM) department.

This role combines advanced UM expertise, program management, and data-driven decision-making to build and lead programs that help UM teams perform at their best. The Program Manager will lead a team, partner closely with UM leadership and the UM OPS Quality Team, and ensure UM programs meet Regulatory Guidelines and CMS Regulations.

This is a fast-paced, high-change environment requiring someone who thrives on operational challenges, can manage multiple priorities simultaneously, and is comfortable building and scaling programs during rapid growth.


Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:

Program Leadership & Team Management:

  • Lead section, priorities, and standards that support consistent, compliant operations across UM.
  • Serve as the single point of accountability for program outcomes and report results to UM leadership.

Training Program Development:

  • Build, implement, and manage the UM training program, establishing consistent curriculum and standards across all UM teams.
  • Design and develop role-based training content for clinical and non-clinical UM staff and Medical Directors, using adult learning principles.
  • Create and maintain training materials, job aids, e-learning, and a central training library that reflects current policies, criteria, and regulatory requirements.
  • Translate SOPs, medical policies, regulatory requirements, and system changes into clear, practical training.

Onboarding & Ongoing Education:

  • Oversee onboarding for all new UM hires, including orientation, classroom training, supervised nesting, and readiness sign-off before independent work.
  • Establish role-based competency and readiness standards and partner with operational leaders on new-hire progress.
  • Manage recurring monthly education and ad hoc education for new policies, regulatory changes, system releases, and criteria updates.
  • Partner with the UM OPS Quality Team to deliver re-education for staff with poor quality performance and confirm improvement.
  • Track attendance, completion, and attestation to support audit and accreditation readiness.

Inter-Rater Reliability (IRR) Program:

  • Build and manage the UM IRR program for clinical reviewers and Medical Directors, including methodology, case development, scoring, and passing standards.
  • Administer IRR assessments on schedule, oversee remediation and retesting, and use results to guide education priorities.
  • Ensure IRR processes and documentation meet accreditation, state, and CMS requirements, and present results to UM leadership and committees.

Reporting, Analytics & Continuous Improvement:

  • Build dashboards and reports that measure program effectiveness, including time to productivity, IRR results, education completion, and impact on quality and turnaround times.
  • Analyze program, IRR, and quality data to identify gaps and opportunities for improvement across UM.
  • Lead initiatives to streamline UM workflows, quality decision making, reduce administrative burden, and improve consistency.

Technology & AI Enablement:

  • Partner with Quality, Data Science, and Engineering to support adoption of AI/LLM-assisted workflows, including human-in-the-loop review and responsible use.
  • Use AI and learning technology to scale program delivery and improve efficiency.
  • Manage the tools and systems used to schedule, track, and report program activity.

Cross-Functional Partnership:

  • Partner with UM leaders to identify needs and reduce the time leaders spend building and delivering training.
  • Work closely with the UM OPS Quality Team to turn audit findings into action while keeping training and auditing independent.
  • Collaborate with Compliance, Medical Directors, Pharmacy, Clinical Policy, and HR/Talent on regulatory updates, policy changes, and hiring plans.

Required skills and experience:

  • Active, unrestricted RN or LVNlicense with 5+ years of UM experience (inpatient, outpatient, post-acute, or appeals).
  • 2+ years of experience in clinical education, or UM training.
  • People leadership experience.
  • In-depth knowledge of UM processes, medical necessity criteria, accreditation standards, Regulatory Guidelines, and CMS Regulations.
  • Strong communication, facilitation, analytical, and project management skills.

Desired skills and experience:

  • Experience building or managing a training program, including onboarding and IRR or competency assessments.
  • Knowledge of Medicare Advantage and Medicaid managed care UM requirements.
  • Experience with LMS platforms and AI/LLM-enabled workflows in a healthcare environment.


Salary Range: $73,000-$115,000

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Our Total Rewards package includes:

  • Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium

  • Generous paid time off

  • $100 monthly mobile or internet stipend

  • Stock options for all employees

  • Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles

  • Parental leave program

  • And more....

raw.description:
Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Analyst to support a large-scale data migration initiative involving the transition from ADP to Workday HCM and Workday Payroll. This individual will own data analysis, profiling, cleansing, mapping, validation, and reconciliation activities throughout the migration lifecycle.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with HRIS and payroll data conversions, strong knowledge of ADP and Workday data structures, and advanced analytical skills using SQL, Excel, and preferably Python.

This role will work closely with HR, Payroll, the Workday implementation partner, and Data Engineering teams to ensure data accuracy, integrity, and completeness across mock conversions, payroll parallel testing, cutover, and post-implementation hypercare.

Key Responsibilities

1. Data Profiling, Cleansing & Mapping

  • Profile and analyze source data from ADP to identify data quality issues, inconsistencies, missing values, and duplicates.
  • Perform data cleansing, standardization, and transformation activities to prepare source data for Workday migration.
  • Develop and maintain detailed source-to-target mapping documents between ADP and Workday HCM and Payroll.
  • Create and manage code crosswalks for organizational structures, employee attributes, payroll codes, earnings, deductions, taxes, and other payroll-related elements.
  • Partner with HR, Payroll, and Data Engineering teams to resolve data gaps and define transformation rules.

2. Data Migration & Reconciliation

  • Own data validation and reconciliation activities across multiple mock conversion cycles.
  • Reconcile converted data using control totals, record counts, field-level validations, and business rule checks.
  • Validate migrated data directly within Workday using Workday Report Writer and standard reporting capabilities.
  • Identify, investigate, and resolve discrepancies between ADP source data and Workday converted data.
  • Maintain detailed reconciliation reports, document exceptions, and track issues through resolution.

3. Payroll Parallel Testing & Validation

  • Support and analyze 2–3 payroll parallel cycles to validate payroll conversion accuracy.
  • Perform employee-level and pay-component-level comparisons between ADP and Workday payroll results.
  • Analyze payroll variances and partner with Payroll SMEs to identify root causes and recommend corrective actions.
  • Validate converted payroll balances, gross and net pay, earnings, deductions, taxes, garnishments, and leave balances.
  • Track payroll discrepancies, document findings, and coordinate resolution with Payroll, Workday implementation, and engineering teams.
  • Prepare payroll reconciliation and parallel testing sign-off packages.

4. Reporting, Documentation & Stakeholder Management

  • Develop and maintain data profiling reports, source-to-target mapping workbooks, reconciliation reports, and data quality dashboards.
  • Build and maintain Power BI dashboards to track migration progress, data quality metrics, reconciliation status, outstanding issues, and readiness for cutover.
  • Work closely with HR, Payroll, Workday implementation partners, and Data Engineering teams to coordinate migration activities.
  • Provide regular status updates on data quality, conversion progress, risks, and outstanding dependencies.
  • Support final data validation, production cutover, and post-go-live hypercare activities.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation and audit trails for migration decisions, data issues, and sign-offs.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, Senior Data Analyst, or Data Migration Analyst.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting HRIS, HCM, or Payroll data migration and conversion projects.
  • Hands-on experience working with ADP and Workday HCM and/or Workday Payroll data.
  • Strong understanding of HR and payroll data structures, including employee records, compensation, earnings, deductions, taxes, garnishments, and leave balances.
  • Advanced SQL skills for data extraction, profiling, validation, reconciliation, and analysis.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including complex formulas, pivot tables, lookups, and data comparison techniques.
  • Experience developing source-to-target mapping documents, code crosswalks, and data transformation rules.
  • Experience validating mock conversions, payroll parallel results, and migration outputs.
  • Familiarity with Workday Report Writer and Workday reporting capabilities.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to perform root-cause analysis.
  • Experience handling confidential employee, payroll, and other sensitive HR data with appropriate security and data privacy practices.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Python for data profiling, cleansing, automation, and reconciliation.
  • Experience with Power BI dashboard development and data visualization.
  • Direct experience with Workday HCM and Workday Payroll implementations.
  • Experience supporting multiple mock conversion cycles and 2–3 payroll parallel runs.
  • Familiarity with Workday EIBs, integrations, and data loading processes.
  • Experience working with Workday implementation partners and cross-functional Data Engineering teams.
  • Knowledge of payroll controls, financial reconciliation, and audit requirements.
  • Experience supporting enterprise-wide HR and payroll transformation initiatives.

WHY JOIN US

Matrix is a global, dynamic, and fast‑growing technology services and consulting company with over 17,000 employees worldwide. Founded in 2001, Matrix has grown through significant organic expansion and strategic acquisitions, executing some of the largest and most impactful technology projects in the market.

We specialize in the design, development, and implementation of advanced technologies, software solutions, and digital products. Our services include infrastructure and consulting, IT outsourcing and offshore delivery, training and assimilation programs, and acting as a trusted implementation and delivery partner for the world’s leading software vendors.

With deep expertise across both the private and public sectors—spanning Finance, Telecom, Healthcare, Hi‑Tech, Education, Defense, and Security—Matrix serves a strong customer base in Israel alongside a continuously expanding global client portfolio.

At Matrix, our people are at the heart of our success. We are a community of talented, creative, and dedicated professionals who are passionate about innovation and excellence. We actively attract, develop, and retain top talent, recognizing that every employee’s contribution is critical to our continued growth and future success.

Matrix’s success is built on a challenging and engaging work environment, competitive compensation and benefits, and meaningful career development opportunities. We foster a diverse, inclusive culture that encourages collaboration, continuous learning, and growth—together.

Join the winning team. Be challenged, grow your career, and enjoy the journey in a highly respected global organization.

raw.description:
About Tires-Easy

Every day, Tires-Easy ships more than 10,000 tires across the United States, changing how people shop for tires and reshaping the $60B replacement tire market through a faster, smarter approach to automotive e-commerce. We pair deep coverage of top-name and budget-friendly brands with a nationwide drop-ship network, and we use technology, automation, and AI to make every step faster and easier for our customers.

Our leadership team comes from outside traditional tire retail, and it shows. We operate in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment with a strong emphasis on operational excellence, accountability, and disciplined growth. Decisions take days, not quarters. We’re building a team that owns results, sees its impact quickly, and drives execution at scale. If you’re curious, action-oriented, and ready to help build a fast-growing business, apply now.

About the role

Lead the day-to-day security program for Tires Easy, protecting customer data, company information, and systems. You'll combine hands-on engineering with practical governance across cloud infrastructure, employee systems, software delivery, and AI tools.

You'll work directly with the VP of Technology to set priorities and enable responsible, scalable AI use. The focus is rigorous internal controls and readiness for a future audit, with the opportunity to shape how security works across the company.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with no direct reports. You'll report to the VP of Technology, who leads Data, AI, Infrastructure, and IT and holds final authority for technology risk acceptance. You'll work with IT and engineering partners to implement controls.

Key responsibilities

  • Develop the security roadmap and maintain the risk register with the VP of Technology; report on control effectiveness and escalate risk-acceptance decisions
  • Partner with the VP of Technology to assess third-party software and AI vendors, recommend approvals, and define practical rules for data handling, permissions, and responsible AI use
  • Define AWS security requirements with the platform engineer, who implements and operates cloud controls
  • Set identity and access requirements and verify implementation with IT: SSO, MFA, onboarding, offboarding, and access reviews
  • Coordinate endpoint protection with IT, including device controls, threat triage, and response
  • Lead vulnerability and software supply-chain risk management with engineering: scanning coverage, remediation priorities, and patch timelines
  • Maintain and exercise incident-response plans, coordinating investigation, escalation, and post-incident improvements
  • Maintain controls aligned with SOC 2 and ISO/IEC 27001 through internal assessments, evidence collection, and remediation tracking
  • Train teams on security and responsible AI use, including how to handle sensitive data and evaluate tool access
  • Partner with software and platform engineers to implement and test AI access controls, connector permissions, logging, and safeguards against data exposure

What success looks like in the first six months

  • Establish an agreed security roadmap and risk register, with clear control owners and escalation to the VP of Technology
  • Complete priority internal control assessments, document evidence, and drive remediation of the highest-priority gaps
  • Put a repeatable AI and third-party software review process into use, and exercise incident-response plans with IT and engineering

Eligibility requirements

  • At least 50% overlap with Pacific Time working hours
  • Available for occasional after-hours support for security incidents
  • Fluent in speaking, reading, and writing English
  • Reliable high-speed internet access for remote work

Skills & experience

  • Substantial experience in security engineering or a related field, typically 7+ years, including ownership of security programs or major cross-functional workstreams
  • 5+ years of experience supporting audits such as SOC 2 or ISO/IEC 27001
  • 2+ years of experience leading audits such as SOC 2 or ISO/IEC 27001
  • 5+ years of experience driving security posture improvements and making security recommendations to leadership
  • Experience implementing and testing controls aligned with SOC 2 or ISO/IEC 27001, and maintaining evidence of their effectiveness
  • Strong AWS security experience across identity, logging, encryption, and threat detection
  • Hands-on experience with identity and device management, endpoint detection and response, and cloud collaboration security
  • Experience securing CI/CD and the software supply chain, including dependency, container image, and secret scanning
  • Working knowledge of security risks in AI and LLM systems, including prompt injection, data exfiltration, and risks involving connector permissions and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations
  • Experience using AI tools to automate security work, with careful handling of sensitive data and independent verification of results
  • Able to assess third-party software, write practical policies, explain risk to business leaders, and design controls engineers can adopt
  • Independent and self-motivated, with the ability to lead implementation across IT and engineering without direct management authority
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent experience

Our current environment

AWS, Google Workspace, Rippling, and SentinelOne, alongside internal software and AI tools. Experience with comparable identity, device, and endpoint security platforms is welcome.

Nice to have

  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or AWS Security Specialty
  • Familiarity with ISO/IEC 42001 or the NIST AI Risk Management Framework
  • Experience applying PCI DSS in e-commerce environments
  • Building or maturing a security program across a growing organization

You will regularly investigate problems involving system instability, blue screens, driver conflicts, failed components, performance issues, Windows errors, and PCs that do not boot or display properly. You will own each case through its full lifecycle, from initial diagnosis through resolution, repair, or escalation to another internal team.

Most customer communication is handled through email. Because you will not have the computer in front of you, you must be able to gather useful information, interpret diagnostic results, and guide customers of varying technical skill levels through troubleshooting safely and clearly.

Scheduled troubleshooting calls are also available to customers. New representatives will not begin taking calls immediately, but prior experience providing technical support by phone with or without screen share is a strong advantage.

Job Duties:

  • Investigate and resolve customer-reported hardware, software, stability, and performance issues affecting Windows PCs
  • Communicate with customers primarily through email, with scheduled troubleshooting calls added after training and onboarding
  • Ask targeted questions that distinguish between hardware failures, software conflicts, configuration problems, and user-environment issues
  • Review and interpret diagnostic information such as crash dumps, Windows Event Viewer entries, reliability history, temperatures, hardware-monitoring data, and stress-test results
  • Guide customers through remote troubleshooting, including driver installation or removal, BIOS changes, Windows repair procedures, hardware reseating, component testing, and operating-system reinstallation
  • Troubleshoot common issues involving graphics cards, memory, storage drives, processors, motherboards, cooling, power delivery, networking, peripherals, and Windows
  • Determine when additional troubleshooting is appropriate and when a component replacement, repair, or full-system return is the correct next step
  • Document symptoms, troubleshooting performed, test results, and conclusions thoroughly within the ticketing system
  • Escalate urgent, unusual, safety-related, or unresolved issues with a clear summary of the situation and work already completed
  • Collaborate with other support representatives, repair technicians, quality-control staff, and operations teams to resolve customer issues
  • Stay current on supported hardware, Windows updates, driver releases, known product issues, and internal support procedures
  • Perform other related duties as assigned

Required Skills/Abilities:

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience building, repairing, or troubleshooting Windows desktop PCs
  • Practical understanding of desktop computer components and how failures in one component may present as symptoms elsewhere in the system
  • Experience diagnosing Windows crashes, freezes, boot failures, driver problems, hardware instability, and performance issues
  • Ability to independently interpret diagnostic results and explain the reasoning behind a recommended next step
  • Familiarity with Windows tools and procedures such as, Event Viewer, Device Manager, Windows crash dumps or bug-check information, System File Checker and DISM, Safe Mode and Windows Recovery Environment. Driver installation and clean removal, Disk Management, Windows installation, and reset procedures
  • Familiarity with PC diagnostic and testing utilities such as DDU, MemTest86, HWiNFO or HWMonitor, and hardware stress-testing software
  • Comfortable navigating BIOS/UEFI, updating firmware, clearing CMOS, enabling or disabling XMP/EXPO, changing boot settings, and identifying relevant hardware settings
  • Strong written communication skills, including the ability to provide complete instructions without overwhelming or talking down to the customer
  • Strong analytical judgment and the ability to troubleshoot methodically rather than cycling through unrelated fixes
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both experienced PC enthusiasts and customers with little or no technical knowledge
  • Excellent organization and ticket-documentation habits
  • Willingness to participate in monitored troubleshooting calls for training and quality assurance

Education and Experience:

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Associates degree in computer science, information technology, electronics, or a related field preferred
  • Two or more years of experience in customer-facing technical support, desktop repair, system integration, or a related position
  • Experience supporting custom-built or gaming desktop PCs
  • Experience troubleshooting issues involving BIOS settings, memory profiles, graphics drivers, thermals, storage health, and system stability
  • Experience interpreting Windows crash dumps or tools such as WhoCrashed or WinDbg
  • Experience with structured hardware testing, including CPU, memory, GPU, VRAM, storage, and power testing
  • Experience providing technical support through scheduled telephone calls, video calls, or screen-sharing sessions
  • Familiarity with ticketing systems and remote customer-support workflows
  • CompTIA A+, Microsoft, or other relevant technical certifications preferred

Physical Demands:

Employee Benefits:

1 Dash is seeking an experienced QuickBooks and accounting professional to help us test, evaluate, and improve an accounting-focused software platform currently under development.

This is not a traditional bookkeeping position.

We are looking for someone who understands how businesses actually use QuickBooks and accounting software and can apply that experience from a product and workflow perspective.

You will spend approximately four hours per day actively working inside our software, creating realistic accounting scenarios, testing workflows, identifying problems or inefficiencies, and recommending improvements to our development team.

Your accounting expertise will directly influence how the product is designed and how its accounting functionality works.

## What You'll Do

Your primary responsibility will be to act as an accounting and QuickBooks subject-matter expert for our software development team.

You will:

- Spend approximately 4 hours per day actively testing the software
- Create realistic businesses, transactions, accounts, customers, vendors, invoices, payments, expenses, and other accounting scenarios
- Evaluate how the software handles common accounting workflows
- Compare workflows and functionality with QuickBooks and accounting best practices
- Review the current accounting structure and recommend better ways to organize or configure the system
- Identify missing accounting features or functionality
- Identify workflows that are unnecessarily complicated or confusing
- Look for accounting situations that could create inaccurate financial reporting
- Test new features and updates released by the development team
- Document bugs, accounting issues, and unexpected behavior
- Recommend functional and workflow improvements
- Explain accounting requirements to developers who may not have an accounting background
- Work directly with our development and leadership teams to prioritize improvements
- Help determine how accounting information should be presented to business owners who may not be accounting experts

## Examples of What You May Review

You may be asked to test and provide recommendations regarding:

- Chart of Accounts structure
- Bank and credit card transactions
- Transaction categorization
- Bank reconciliation
- Accounts receivable
- Accounts payable
- Invoicing and payments
- Customer credits and refunds
- Vendor bills and expenses
- Deposits
- Transfers
- Journal entries
- Recurring transactions
- Financial reporting
- Profit & Loss statements
- Balance Sheets
- Cash-flow reporting
- General Ledger activity
- Sales tax workflows
- Month-end accounting procedures
- Accounting controls and audit trails
- User permissions and accounting controls
- QuickBooks import/export or integration workflows
- Overall ease of use for small-business owners

## What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate has strong hands-on QuickBooks experience combined with a solid understanding of accounting principles.

You should be comfortable looking at a software workflow and saying:

*"This technically works, but this isn't how an accountant or business owner would expect it to work. Here's how we should change it."*

### Preferred Qualifications

- 5+ years of hands-on accounting or bookkeeping experience
- Advanced QuickBooks Online experience
- Strong understanding of GAAP and general accounting principles
- Experience managing books for multiple businesses or clients
- Experience with month-end close and financial statement preparation
- Strong understanding of real-world small-business accounting workflows
- Ability to identify accounting errors and unusual financial results
- Comfortable learning and testing new software
- Able to clearly document problems and recommended solutions
- Comfortable communicating directly with software developers

**QuickBooks ProAdvisor certification is strongly preferred.**

CPA certification is welcome but not required. Practical QuickBooks and accounting experience is more important for this position.

## What Makes This Role Different

This position sits between accounting and software product development.

You will not simply be entering transactions or reconciling accounts. You will be helping determine how accounting software should work.

We want someone who enjoys asking questions such as:

- Is there a better way to handle this transaction?
- Would this workflow make sense to an accountant?
- Would a small-business owner understand this?
- What happens if the user makes a mistake?
- Does this transaction flow correctly through the financial statements?
- What accounting functionality are we missing?
- How does QuickBooks handle this, and could we make the experience better?

Your recommendations will be reviewed directly by our development team and may become part of the product.

## Schedule

This is a part-time position requiring approximately 4 hours per day.

We are looking for someone who can consistently dedicate focused time to testing the platform rather than occasionally reviewing features.

## Ideal Candidate

This role would be especially well suited for an experienced QuickBooks ProAdvisor, accountant, senior bookkeeper, fractional controller, or accounting consultant who enjoys technology and would like to help shape the development of a new software platform.

If you have ever used accounting software and thought, "There has to be a better way to do this," this may be an excellent fit.

Please provide a loom video stating why you would be a good candidate for this role.

raw.excerpt: Description Who We Are Come join the company at the center of how the world adopts AI securely.
raw.description:
Description

Who We Are

Come join the company at the center of how the world adopts AI securely. Cyera’s mission is to give enterprises the confidence to embrace AI safely — deciding exactly what it can see and do as it reaches deeper into the business. We started by solving the hardest problem in data security: finding and securing data faster and more precisely than anyone thought possible. That foundation is now the essential AI trust infrastructure for the Fortune 1000. We’re hiring mission-driven talent to put those leaders at the center of our story.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We’re looking for a Solution Architect, Agentic Security to be the technical and strategic bridge between Cyera and the enterprises deploying AI agents in production. You’ll help security, IAM, and AI platform teams answer three questions: which agents exist, what they are allowed to access, and how to govern and stop them when something goes wrong.

This is a field role across pre-sales and post-sales: shape the deal architecture, prove it in a POC against real agent workloads, then own deployment and rollout with live customers. You’ll work closely with Sales, Product, Research, executive leadership, and founders. Because this category is being defined right now, you’ll also turn what you learn in the field into the patterns, reference architectures, and point of view the rest of the market follows.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Agentic discovery and threat modeling: Lead technical discovery across agent frameworks, AI platforms, MCP servers, and the identities and data they touch. Map how agents authenticate, what tools and data they reach, where delegation chains run, and where prompt injection or over-permissioned access creates real exposure.
  • Solution architecture: Design end-to-end architectures that align Cyera capabilities to the customer’s AI adoption program: agent inventory and ownership, least-privilege access for agents and their tools, runtime policy and guardrails, auditability, and kill-switch and revocation paths.
  • Demos and deep dives: Deliver technically rigorous demos and workshops that make agentic risk concrete for AI platform engineers, IAM and security architects, and CISOs alike. Show the attack path, then show the control.
  • Technical strategy for strategic deals: Partner with Sales leadership on high-impact pursuits. Build bespoke prototypes and POCs against live agent workloads, define evaluation criteria, and run evaluations to a clear decision.
  • Deployment and adoption: Own technical rollout with new customers, from first integrations to production policy, and close the loop on capabilities in use.
  • Field-to-product feedback loop: Translate what agents are actually doing in customer environments into problem statements Product and Research can act on. Track protocol and framework changes (MCP, A2A, agent SDKs) and their security implications for the roadmap.
  • Partner enablement: Equip AI platform, cloud, and services partners with patterns and enablement materials to accelerate joint wins.
  • Artifacts and thought leadership: Produce reference architectures, threat models, playbooks, and reusable assets for GTM and CS. Represent Cyera externally through talks, workshops, and written POV on agentic security.

Requirements

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 6+ years of technical depth from customer-facing, engineering, or product roles in security, identity, or cloud infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience building with or securing LLM applications or AI agents: you have wired an agent to tools, read the traces, and know where it breaks.
  • Working knowledge of how agents authenticate and are authorized: OAuth 2.x and token delegation, API keys and secrets, service accounts, and workload identity.
  • Ability to explain AI-specific threats (prompt injection, tool poisoning, excessive agency, data exfiltration through agents) and the controls that address them, to both engineers and executives.
  • Proven experience designing architectures, building POCs, and producing crisp technical collateral such as reference designs, threat models, and playbooks.
  • Comfort partnering cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and R field-oriented, with strong customer empathy and a bias for action.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and presentation skills; confident leading strategic conversations and aligning diverse stakeholders.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with agent frameworks and platforms such as LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Amazon Bedrock Agents, or Google Vertex AI Agent Builder.
  • Depth in agent protocols: MCP (servers, transports, authorization) and A2A, including how identity and trust propagate across agent-to-agent and agent-to-tool calls.
  • Background in IAM/PAM, non-human identity governance, or secrets management; familiarity with SPIFFE/SPIRE or cloud-native workload identity.
  • Data security experience: classification, DLP, or data access governance, and how it applies to RAG pipelines and agent data access.
  • Cloud and platform fluency across AWS, Azure, or GCP, plus Kubernetes and infrastructure-as-code.
  • A public track record: conference talks, published research, open-source contributions, or vulnerability disclosures in AI or identity security.

What success looks like

  • First 90 days: You run the agentic security demo and discovery motion independently, own technical execution on at least two active POCs, and ship your first reusable asset (a reference architecture or threat model for a common agent deployment pattern).
  • First year: You are the technical lead on our largest agentic security deals, have converted POCs into production deployments, have brought recurring field problems to Product as roadmap-ready problem statements, and are a recognized external voice on securing AI agents.

COMPENSATION INFORMATION:

Compensation Range: $200,000-$250,000.

The range represents total compensation, and may include incentive for sales roles, equity or benefits, as applicable.

This compensation range represents Cyera’s good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of posting, and Cyera may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. The final salary for this position will be determined in Cyera’s sole discretion, consistent with applicable law, and based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to the employee’s work experience, skills, and qualifications for the role, as well as the needs of Cyera’s business and other operational considerations.

Final compensation will vary based on seniority and relevance of experience, location, and position requirements.

This role may be eligible for potential merit increases based on factors such as individual or company performance, time in role, and other discretionary factors.

BENEFITS - Why Cyera?

  • Ability to work remotely, with office setup reimbursement
  • Competitive salary
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Paid holidays and sick time
  • Health, vision, and dental insurance
  • Life, short and long-term disability insurance

You’ll also contribute to establishing a robust supply chain so that we can continually produce the vehicles our customers want.

In this position...

Ford Motor Company is looking for an experienced electronics manufacturing Technical Specialist to support our Global Core Electrical STA team. This global team is composed of Technical Experts, Managers, and Manufacturing Engineers who assist the suppliers as they grow with Ford Motor Company.

Ford Motor Company is growing our manufacturing expertise in electronics and electrical distribution systems (EDS). Our supplier business partners, are a very important part of this growth. The Supplier Technical Assistance (STA) organization supports our Global suppliers with Manufacturing Technical expertise as they invest and grow their business to support ours.   • Keep abreast of technical developments and advancements in electronic manufacturing methods.

  • Collaborate with peers in Product Development, STA and throughout the company.

You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply!

As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including:

Direct for an app 22,000 people open every day

Shortsis our vertical drama app: 22k daily active users and 227k downloads a month across app and web. Every week, you'll take two validated scripts and turn them into two complete series. No festival, no waiting: within days, you'll see which cliffhanger kept people watching.

Why we're hiring

Luni builds B2C mobile apps used by millions, including 🎬 Shorts, our vertical drama app, alongside ⭐️ Astro Club and 🖨️ Scanner. Most of our revenue comes from in-app subscriptions in the US.

On Shorts, our freelance writers deliver validated scripts. We need a director to turn them into episodes with Shorts Studio, our in-house AI production tool.

What you'll direct

Every week: 2 series of 15 episodes, about 1:30 each.

  • Turn a validated script into images in Shorts Studio: characters, sets, shot breakdown, generation and take selection.

  • Make the director's calls: framing, pace, acting direction, and throwing away the bad takes.

  • Edit each episode with the right pace and continuity, and end it on a cliffhanger.

  • Deliver on time, take feedback and adjust.

Who you'll work with

AJ, Product Manager on Shorts, is your main contact: he sets priorities and reviews your episodes. You'll also work directly with our writers, who are freelancers like you.

Who you are

  • You have an interest in serialized storytelling. You consume microdramas (ReelShort, DramaBox, Shorts), serialized novels and web series, and you can explain what keeps audiences coming back for more.

  • You have a visual training, formal or not. You studied film, television or editing (or you’re still studying), or you taught yourself and have work to show. A school project counts.

  • You’re into AI video. You’ve tried AI image or video generation and understand what to look for.

  • You deliver. You meet your deadlines without being chased. At 30 episodes a week, that matters.

  • You work in English. Our scripts and most of our audience are English-speaking.

What you get

  • Rate: paid per delivered episode, invoiced monthly.

  • Full remote: work from wherever you want.

  • Tools: free access to Shorts Studio and AI generation credits.

  • Learning: you'll learn AI video production on a real product, with real audiences and real numbers.

  • A director’s credit on real series:full vertical series, directed by you from script to release, watched by audiences around the world. A portfolio most directors take years to build.

How we hire

  1. 45-min screening call with Louise (Talent Acquisition Manager)

  2. 1-hour call with AJ, Product Manager on Shorts

  3. Case study: you direct one episode from a real script

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We look at your work, not your CV. We're an equal opportunity employer.

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Job Description:


This role is focused on growing existing account presence and identifying and developing whitespace opportunities across two sensitive Government agencies headquartered in Northern Virginia. The role includes supporting the expansion of HPE’s presence through strategic pipeline development, competitive displacement, capture acceleration, and early pursuit shaping.

The ideal candidate is a strategic seller with a proven track record of developing new opportunities within large federal organizations, navigating complex federal acquisition environments, and orchestrating cross-functional teams to support transformational opportunities.

Reporting to theManager, Client Support, as theProduct Support Specialist(aka Financial Support Specialist), you are part of our Support team. Acting as the first line of response, you will be responsible for communicating with our clients in an open, helpful, and engaging manner to find the right solution for them.

Your passion for providing exceptional service contributes to our high level of client satisfaction. In addition, you will work with various teams to resolve various support concerns, escalate issues, and serve as an ambassador for our product.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

At Multiview, being creative with great communication and problem-solving skills is important, but equally so are having a passion for driving client success and the desire to be a contributing member of our culture, where the genuine care of people is our compass.

The successful candidate will be a highly motivated team player who is an excellent communicator, a self-starter and someone who can meet the demands of a fast-paced growing technology company while maintaining a positive attitude in a technical customer support function.

The starting salary for this role is $55,000.00 CAD. The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

If this sounds like you, read on!

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

  • Provide outstanding client service throughout the support process.
  • Identify, investigate, and troubleshoot incoming inquiries to provide the appropriate solutions and alternatives to achieve client satisfaction.
  • Effectively document support incidents and escalate them as necessary.
  • Manage and update the help desk ticketing system with descriptions of support incidents, conversations, and correspondence with clients.
  • Manage multiple support channels including telephone and e-mail.
  • Support the roll-out of new product releases to Multiview’s existing client base.
  • Proactively assist in growing our Client Portal content by developing impactful documents, videos, and how-to guides
  • Actively participate in continually improving support processes and team initiatives
  • Demonstrate Multiview’s core values, building and advancing the reputation of the company and its clients.

Key Relationships:

  • Manager and Senior Manager, Client Support
  • Client Support Team
  • Clients

Work Environment:

  • Work independently with minimal supervision
  • Extensive collaboration with team members and other departments
  • Remote work

COMPETENCIES PORTFOLIO:

  • Client Obsessed– This role influences 100% of all client experiences who purchase Multiview Financial Software. You must have excellent interpersonal and customer service skills and are comfortable building rapport with our clients to develop trust and confidence in our products and services.
  • Work Smart– You must be proactive in anticipating and resolving problems client problems using strong analytical and problem-solving skills to meet our client’s expectations and the requirements of the job.
  • Stronger Together– You collaborate with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders and team members to determine the problems to solve and deliver the best solutions to our clients with exceptional client service skills.
  • People First– You demonstrate high levels of emotional intelligence and empathy towards all stakeholders, both internal and external
  • Believe in Better– You question the status quo while you seek, accept, and complete tasks using your own initiative. You ask “why” a lot and communicate clearly and efficiently when getting to the root of the problems.

KNOWLEDGE, EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS REQUIREMENTS:

  • A degree, diploma, certification, or equivalent in business, accounting or relevant experience
  • Experience Level:1 – 2 yearsin customer support or an accounting role
  • Demonstrated skills in client escalation, conflict resolution and negotiation.
  • Demonstrated excellence in presenting to an executive-level audience, both written and verbal
  • Excellent client service, interpersonal and relationship-building skills.
  • Excellent multi-tasking, organizational, time management and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent team-building skills, to work well within a team environment.
  • Self-sufficient, resourceful, and able to work well with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to demonstrate a high degree of professionalism.
  • Innovative thinker with a growth mindset.
  • Demonstrated level of technical proficiency with Microsoft Office at the Intermediate or Advanced levels
  • Willingness to be coached, mentored, and driven to reach your fullest potential.
  • Experience demonstrating Multiview’s core values, building, and advancing the reputation of the company and its clients.
  • Ability to travel minimally within Canada and the US

WHAT WE WOULD LOVE TO SEE?

  • Prior ERP or Multiview Financial Software experience
  • Knowledge of accounting and financial management practices
  • Prior experience working in the SaaS/Software industry.

Experience comes in many forms, many skills are transferable, and passion goes a long way. If your experience is this close to what we are looking for, consider applying. We know that diversity of thought makes for the best problem-solving and creative thinking, which is why we are dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team and encouraging everyone to apply.

ABOUT US:

Multiview builds powerful, easy-to-use financial applications for clients across North America. As a leader in the ERP/Financial Software industry, we partner with sophisticated clients across multiple industries to End Month End™

We are extremely proud of the company we have built. Bringing together professionals with diverse backgrounds, talents, and expertise is vital to making our company stronger. Our people-first culture is our biggest advantage, and we are excited to share that commitment with you!

WHY JOIN MULTIVIEW?

At Multiview, you can make an impact that matters in a way that you never thought possible. With endless opportunities at every turn, and a company culture built to empower and develop our people to be the best they can be, Multiview is THE Software Company for you to learn, grow, create, connect, and lead. We do this by taking care of our employees first.

We strongly believe that a great job should keep you happy both at work and in life and we encourage that by offering:

  • Competitive Compensation
  • 4 weeks vacation to start, additional paid time off to supplement work-life balance, wellness, and mental health days.
  • Company paid competitive Benefits including Extended Health, Dental, Vision and more.
  • Continuous growth opportunities, and leadership development

APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS:

Please submit your resume, and a cover letter describing, why you are a unique fit for this position by applying to this posting.

We thank all applicants for expressing their interest in Multiview; however, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Multiview is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible candidate experience. If you require accommodation during the recruitment and selection process, please let us know. We will work with you to meet your needs.

ACCESSIBILITY & DIVERSITY:

Multiview promotes a diverse, inclusive, and accessible workplace. By embracing diversity, we are building a more effective organization that empowers our employees to be the best that they can be. We know that diversity of thought makes for the best problem-solving and creative thinking, which is why we are dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team and encouraging everyone to apply.

raw.description:
Bids & Proposals Manager

We’re looking for a Bids & Proposals Manager to coordinate high-quality submissions across our Ground Investigation business. You’ll bring together our estimating, business development, technical and delivery teams to produce clear, persuasive proposals that demonstrate the value of our services.

You’ll also own our opportunity tracker, ensuring every opportunity is captured, followed up and accurately reported—from the first enquiry through to the final outcome.

What you’ll do

  • Lead bid coordination: Manage bid programmes, contributors, reviews and deadlines, ensuring submissions are complete, approved and delivered on time.
  • Produce compelling proposals: Draft and edit responses, develop clear win themes and coordinate technical input, case studies and supporting evidence.
  • Own the opportunity tracker: Capture opportunities from every source, maintain accurate values, dates, ownership and status, and actively resolve missing, duplicated or outdated information.
  • Make bid/no-bid decisions happen: Arrange reviews, secure and record authorised decisions, and follow actions through to completion. Involve the Head of Major Projects in complex, cross-division and over-£500,000 opportunities.
  • Manage incoming enquiries: Oversee the shared enquiry mailbox, ensuring enquiries are acknowledged, allocated and progressed to a clear response.
  • Connect teams: Work closely with Estimating, Business Development and specialist colleagues, keeping contributors informed and coordinating cross-division submissions.
  • Improve performance: Report on the pipeline, gather client feedback, analyse bid outcomes and improve our templates, processes and proposal quality.
  • Support successful handovers: Ensure delivery teams receive the commitments, assumptions and key information behind successful bids.

The opportunity

This role gives you direct involvement in how SOCOTEC’s Ground Investigation business wins work. You’ll work with senior leaders and technical specialists, influence the quality of our proposals and improve the information that guides our growth.

Your development plan will support your progression in bid strategy, proposal writing, commercial awareness and specialist-service knowledge.

What you’ll bring

You’ll have experience in bids, proposals, PQQs or tender coordination, with the ability to manage competing deadlines and bring together contributions from different teams.

We’re looking for someone who combines strong writing skills with attention to detail and a proactive approach. You’ll be comfortable challenging incomplete information, chasing actions constructively and maintaining a reliable opportunity tracker.

You’ll also bring:

  • Clear communication and confident stakeholder management.
  • Experience preparing well-structured, client-focused submissions.
  • Strong organisation, document control and data-checking skills.
  • Confidence using Microsoft Office, shared mailboxes and systems such as SharePoint, Microsoft Lists or similar platforms.

Experience in ground investigation, construction, engineering or technical services would be valuable. We also welcome candidates with strong, transferable bid experience from other sectors. Relevant practical experience is recognised alongside formal qualifications.

Why SOCOTEC?

Join a thriving community of over 2,000 industry professionals who are passionate about making a real difference. At SOCOTEC UK, we're not just delivering services - we're shaping the future of testing, inspection, and certification across the nation.

What sets us apart? Our people. We've built our reputation on attracting exceptional talent like you and empowering them to deliver excellence at every turn. Our comprehensive range of TIC services means you'll have the opportunity to work on diverse, challenging projects that truly matter.

In this role, you won't just be another employee - you'll be a key player in our continued success story. Your expertise will directly contribute to our mission of building a safer, more sustainable world, while you grow your career alongside some of the industry's finest professionals.

Your Career, Your Way

Build a traditional career path or explore opportunities across multiple disciplines - all within SOCOTEC. Your choice, your direction.

Work Your Way

Local, national, or global projects. Office-based, remote, or hybrid. We offer the flexibility that empowers you to perform at your best.

Committed to Your Growth

From day one, you'll have access to comprehensive training, mentorship, and development programs. We support every step of your professional journey. #YouGrowWeGrow

Think you've got what it takes to add value to our success? We would love to hear from you and look forward to receiving your application.

Building a safer and more sustainable world is the core mission we set out to achieve at SOCOTEC, it is at the heart of everything that we do. We are committed to acting as a key player in society, investing in innovative solutions to ensure social and environmental concerns are at the forefront of all of our business operations.

About Infrastructure

SOCOTEC’s Infrastructure team delivers essential technical services that ensure the safety, quality and compliance of major construction and civil engineering projects across the UK. We provide independent construction materials testing to verify strength, durability and performance of key materials; foundations and pile testing to confirm ground stability; specialist structures and pavements assessment and analysis; and integrated geotechnical and structural monitoring that delivers real time data throughout project lifecycles. Our experts use industry leading methods and advanced technology to support infrastructure projects from initial site investigation through construction and long term performance, helping clients manage risk, meet regulatory standards and build safer, more resilient assets.

What's in it for you?

Your expertise deserves recognition. Alongside a competitive salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package including 25 days holiday (with the option to buy more), an electric car scheme (where applicable), employee recognition programmes, family-friendly support, exclusive retail discounts, employee assistance programmes, and an enhanced company pension. SOCOTEC UK & Ireland are proud to be Disability Confident accredited.

EDB provides a data and AI platform that enables organizations to harness the full power of Postgres for transactional, analytical, and AI workloads across any cloud, anywhere. Serving more than 1,500 customers globally and as the leading contributor to the vibrant and fast-growing PostgreSQL community, EDB supports major government organizations, financial services, media and information technology companies. EDB’s data-driven solutions enable customers to modernize legacy systems and break data silos while leveraging enterprise-grade open source technologies. For more information, visit www.enterprisedb.com

Account Executive – AI, Analytics & Data Platform

Location: India

Reports to: VP & GM of Sales

You will engage with senior technology, data, and business leaders to understand their data and AI strategies, identify opportunities for modernization, and position EDB's solutions as a strategic part of their technology ecosystem.

This is a consultative, high-value sales role for someone who understands how modern enterprises are evolving their databases, analytics, AI infrastructure, and cloud environments.

  • Develop and execute territory and account strategies to achieve and exceed annual revenue targets.
  • Build a strong pipeline of new business across strategic enterprise accounts.
  • Identify opportunities involving PostgreSQL modernization, ClickHouse/real-time analytics, AI workloads, cloud data platforms, and database infrastructure.
  • Engage senior executives including CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, Chief AI/Data Officers, VPs of Engineering, Data, Analytics, Infrastructure, and Application Development.
  • Lead consultative discovery to understand customers' business objectives, technology environments, data architecture, and AI initiatives.
  • Translate complex technical capabilities into compelling business value and ROI.
  • Position EDB against competing database, analytics, cloud, and data platform solutions.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships across technical, business, procurement, and executive stakeholders.
  • Lead complex enterprise opportunities involving technical evaluations, proof-of-concepts, security reviews, procurement, legal, and executive approvals.
  • Partner closely with Solutions Engineering, Professional Services, Customer Success, Marketing, Product, and Partners to develop and close opportunities.
  • Develop accurate forecasts and maintain strong pipeline and opportunity discipline in the CRM.
