Employer work visa sponsorship and support are not provided for this role. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States at hire and must maintain authorization to work in the United States throughout their employment with our company.


Associate Application Security Engineer

We are seeking an Associate Application Security Engineer to strengthen the security of our APIs through dynamic application security testing (DAST), and to improve DevSecOps efficiency using AI-assisted analysis and automation. You will work cross-functionally with engineering, platform, and product teams to reduce risk, streamline security operations, and improve developer experience through scalable security practices.


Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with engineering, platform, and product teams to embed security into day-to-day delivery and SDLC workflows.
  • Configure, run, and maintain authenticated DAST scans of REST and GraphQL APIs, using API definitions (OpenAPI, GraphQL schemas), API client collections (such as Bruno), and recorded or live traffic to maximize endpoint and authorization coverage.
  • Integrate API security testing into the Harness unified pipeline and related CI/CD workflows, so APIs are tested automatically before release and builds can be gated on new Critical or High findings.
  • Build AI-powered workflows, including agentic IDE and MCP server integrations, to automate triage and prioritization of API security findings, generate security test cases from API specifications, and support remediation through standardized playbooks.
  • Improve scan accuracy by tuning scan policies and custom test cases to reduce false positives, and maintaining authentication configurations so scans reach authenticated endpoints.
  • Support response to zero-day events by running targeted scans and using API and asset inventories to identify affected APIs and services.
  • Create and maintain runbooks, playbooks, and documentation for recurring findings, remediation steps, and operational processes.
  • Support the security exemption/exception process, including documentation, approvals, and expiry/renewal tracking.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Cybersecurity/Engineering  (or equivalent experience).
  • Strong knowledge of web/app security fundamentals (e.g., OWASP  Top 10 concepts).
  • Experience with API security platforms or enterprise DAST tools, such as Harness (Traceable), Invicti, or similar.
  • Familiarity with Git and modern development workflows (PRs, CI/CD).
  • Strong proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, etc.)
  • Experience with writing unit tests, producing user documentation, and informative demos.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS/Azure, including security fundamentals (e.g., authentication and authorization, networking, logging/monitoring) and supporting security in cloud-based environments.
  • Experience using agentic AI systems in engineering/security workflows, including integrating AI agents with MCP servers to enable assisted/automated remediation (or similar)
  • Ability to operate effectively in a high-performing, collaborative environment, working closely with development and partner teams across the organization.

Expected Compensation

$96,000 - $162,000

The base salary range shown reflects the full range for this role from minimum to maximum. At athenahealth, base pay depends on multiple factors, including job-related experience, relevant knowledge and skills, how your qualifications compare to others in similar roles, and geographical market rates. Base pay is only one part of our competitive Total Rewards package - depending on role eligibility, we offer both short and long-term incentives by way of an annual discretionary bonus plan, variable compensation plan, and equity plans.

About athenahealth

Our vision:In an industry that becomes more complex by the day, we stand for simplicity. We offer IT solutions and expert services that eliminate the daily hurdles preventing healthcare providers from focusing entirely on their patients — powered by our vision to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.

Our company culture:Our talented  employees — or athenistas, as we call ourselves — spark the innovation and passion needed to accomplish our vision. We are a diverse group of dreamers and do-ers with unique knowledge, expertise, backgrounds, and perspectives. We unite as mission-driven problem-solvers with a deep desire to achieve our vision and make our time here count. Our award-winning culture is built around shared values of inclusiveness, accountability, and support.

Our DEI commitment:Our vision of accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all requires addressing the inequities that stand in the way. That's one reason we prioritize diversity, equity, and inclusion in every aspect of our business, from attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce to maintaining an inclusive environment for athenistas, our partners, customers and the communities where we work and serve.

What we can do for you:

Along with health and financial benefits, athenistas enjoy perks specific to each location, including commuter support, employee assistance programs, tuition assistance, employee resource groups, and collaborative  workspaces  — some offices even welcome dogs.

We also encourage a better work-life balance for athenistas with our flexibility. While we know in-office collaboration is critical to our vision, we recognize that not all work needs to be done within an office environment, full-time. With consistent communication and digital collaboration tools, athenahealth enables employees to find a balance that feels fulfilling and productive for each individual situation.

In addition to our traditional benefits and perks, we sponsor events throughout the year, including book clubs, external speakers, and hackathons. We provide athenistas with a company culture based on learning, the support of an engaged team, and an inclusive environment where all employees are valued.

Learn more about our culture and benefits here: athenahealth.com/careers

raw.description:
About Cogstate

At Cogstate, we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.

Our digital cognitive assessments are trusted by researchers, clinicians, and pharmaceutical partners around the world, helping to drive breakthroughs in neuroscience and improve outcomes for people living with neurological conditions. Founded on decades of cognitive science and backed by rigorous validation, Cogstate’s assessments are used in more than 150 countries and over 2,000 clinical trials.

Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. Whether we’re supporting a multinational Alzheimer’s trial or developing tools to bring cognitive testing into routine care, our work is meaningful, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

At Cogstate, we’re not just imagining the future of brain health - we’re building it.

About the Clinician Network

By joining the Cogstate Clinician Network, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute your clinical expertise to research studies around the world.

Depending on your background, scales experience, and therapeutic area expertise, we may have an opportunity for you immediately - or it may take some time before a study opens that is the right fit.

Cogstate is continuing to grow and expand our clinical research initiatives, so new projects and opportunities are always on the horizon.

All applicants to the Clinician Network are kept in our active pipeline, and you’ll also receive our monthly Clinician Network newsletter, which shares updates and upcoming openings.

About the Role

Cogstate Clinicians are clinical psychologists or neuropsychologists responsible for delivering remote clinical interviews and cognitive assessment batteries to subjects with preclinical dementia, enrolled in a pharmaceutical clinical trial.

Cogstate provides all consultants with comprehensive, fully compensated training on general Cogstate operational policies, study-specific procedures, customized clinical interviewing skills and virtual cognitive assessment prior to performing remote scale administrations. Regular supervision and ongoing recalibration of clinical skill set will be provided.

*These are contract position.

*They are fully remote.

*Hired employee will work on an as needed basis based on their schedule.

- VINELAND/VABS Administration Experience Required
- Spanish Fluency Required

Key Responsibilities

Central Rating

  • Remotely administering semi-structured clinical interview assessments and cognitive battery of tests to study subjects and caregivers.
  • Remotely delivering computerized and traditional cognitive assessments via a tele-health platform.
  • Scoring completed scale administrations.
  • Participating in regular clinical skill recalibration activities.

Central Monitoring

  • Providing reviews of completed neuropsychological test batteries for central monitoring of data to ensure accuracy in administration and scoring and contribute to the overall success of a clinical trial.
  • Reviewing response forms and recordings of remote scale administrations and offering feedback to raters via email and telephone communications.

Qualifications & Expertise

  • MA/MS in Psychology or equivalent
  • ≥25 administrations of study scales or similar semi-structured clinical interviews
  • Experience working with pediatric populations with neurodevelopmental delays
    • Rare disease experience is a plus, including Angelman syndrome, Phelan-McDermid syndrome, Fragile X syndrome, or similar disorders
  • Vineland/VABS administration experience
  • Formal training in clinical interviewing and cognitive assessment, including experience working with pediatric populations and caregivers
  • Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience with direct clinical interviewing and psychological assessment in clinical research industry, academic or clinical settings
  • Direct experience with cognitive/behavioral/functional assessment of neurological/psychiatric populations
  • Ability to meet deadlines, being highly organized and methodical, with attention to detail to ensure delivery
  • Proficiency with MS Office, including Word and Excel, email, teleconference platforms such as Skype, Zoom or other similar applications, and cloud-based storage service.
  • Spanish Fluency

Our Culture
We bring our whole selves to work every day. We’re courageous and we deliver together. We’re passionate individuals who enjoy working together. We’re brave enough and care enough to have the right conversations to get the best outcome and are famous for our can-do attitude. We see challenges as opportunities and move with pace to achieve our goals.

If you’re ready to help us in our journey to optimize the measurement of brain health around the world, please apply now!

Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role

This role will focus on developing a centralized case management solution that integrates Anti-Money Laundering (AML), sanctions screening, fraud detection, and trade surveillance into a unified investigative environment.

The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering expertise with financial crimes regulatory knowledge and experience leveraging automation, machine learning, and AI to improve detection effectiveness and operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable financial crimes applications, monitoring integrations, and investigative tools.
  • Build and enhance a centralized, end-to-end case management platform supporting alert management, investigations, escalations, documentation, and reporting.
  • Integrate internal data and third-party monitoring solutions to create unified investigative workflows.
  • Develop automated processes, data pipelines, and AI/ML-enabled capabilities to improve alert prioritization, risk scoring, and investigative efficiency.
  • Design configurable solutions supporting multiple jurisdictions, regulatory requirements, data privacy, and access controls.
  • Translate regulatory and operational requirements into technical solutions in partnership with Global Financial Crimes, Product, Engineering, and Data teams.
  • Own ongoing platform maintenance, production monitoring, troubleshooting, system enhancements, and operational reliability.
  • Implement appropriate audit trails, data integrity controls, regulatory recordkeeping, and reporting capabilities.

Must-Haves — Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, including experience developing financial services, compliance, risk, or financial crimes technology.
  • Strong backend engineering skills, including APIs, SQL databases, cloud infrastructure, data pipelines, and system integrations.
  • Demonstrated experience building or significantly enhancing case management systems, investigation platforms, or complex compliance workflow applications.
  • Working knowledge of U.S. financial crimes regulations and regulatory expectations, including SEC, FINRA, FinCEN, BSA/AML, and OFAC.
  • Experience developing scalable, secure applications with automated workflows, role-based access, audit trails, and data protection controls.
  • Experience building data-driven applications and integrating advanced analytics, automation, or machine learning capabilities into production systems.
  • Understanding of global technology architecture, jurisdiction-specific regulatory controls, and data privacy requirements.
  • Proven experience maintaining production-critical systems, including monitoring, troubleshooting, incident response, and performance optimization.
  • Ability to translate complex regulatory and operational requirements into practical technical solutions.
  • Strong coding skills, preferably in Go
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (preferably Google Cloud Platform), messaging queues and message brokers, containerization and orchestration technologies (preferably Kubernetes) and relational databases (preferably PostgreSQL)

Nice-to-Haves — Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience within a U.S. broker-dealer, clearing and custody firm, fintech, cryptocurrency business, or other regulated financial institution.
  • Familiarity with securities trading, omnibus accounts, market surveillance, and cryptocurrency transaction monitoring.
  • Experience with AML transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, fraud detection, or trade surveillance technologies, whether internally developed or vendor-provided.
  • Experience developing or deploying machine learning models for anomaly detection, behavioral analytics, entity resolution, or predictive risk scoring.

Bipolar etc.).

This position will be responsible for development and coordination of various strategic and tactical clinical marketing initiatives to

relationships with the marketing and sales teams, external Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), as well as internal ISI stakeholders such

work/projects. Understand competition and develop competitive differentiation.

being utilized and determine how to communicate that value proposition to other physicians.

At InStride, people are our purpose.

We believe that investing in people is the most powerful way to drive success—for individuals and organizations alike.

As a public benefit corporation, we partner with leading employers to unlock opportunities for their employees, providing access to top-tier education programs that align with their employees’ career goals and the company’s business goals.

Our mission goes beyond skill-building; we're here to empower our partners’ employees to advance their careers, elevate their expertise, and achieve meaningful personal and professional growth.

No matter the team you’re on, our dedication to the success of our partners and their employees is what drives us. If you're passionate about making a difference and driving educational and professional advancement, InStride is the place for you.

To get a better feel for our culture, watch more here.

Candidates must be located in one of the following states to be considered eligible for employment: AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, DE, FL, GA, IL, IN, KS, LA, MA, MD, MI, MN, MO, NC, NH, NJ, NV, NY, OH, OR, PA, TX, VA, WA, WI.

What we're looking for:

InStride is seeking experienced Data Analysts to join our growing Data Analytics team. As a Senior Data Analyst reporting to the Director of Data Analytics, you will play a crucial role in transforming data into actionable insights and recommendations that drive strategic decisions across the business. You’ll collaborate closely with stakeholders across the company, providing them with data-driven insights to support growth and operational efficiency. Your work will contribute to building a strong data culture, enabling key business partners to self-serve data through dynamic dashboards and make informed decisions using company-wide metrics.

Skills we’d love to see you show off:

  • Data Analysis & Reporting: Analyze complex datasets from Databricks to provide actionable insights across internal teams such as sales, marketing, finance, and product. Build and maintain dynamic Tableau dashboards that empower stakeholders to self-serve and track key metrics.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with business partners to understand needs and provide data-driven insights for strategic decisions. Serve as a trusted advisor to business stakeholders, helping them interpret data and apply it effectively.
  • Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and Metrics: Identify, define, and track company-wide key performance indicators (KPIs) aligned with business goals. Continuously monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of KPIs, suggesting new metrics to support organizational consistency.
  • Data Validation & Integrity: Ensure accuracy and consistency in data reporting, collaborating with analytics engineers to maintain data quality. Validate data models, ensuring alignment with business requirements and optimization for reporting.
  • Data Visualization & Presentation: Create clear and compelling visualizations to communicate complex data to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Present insights and recommendations in a concise, actionable format to business leaders and teams.
  • Documentation & Best Practices: Maintain thorough documentation of data models, analysis processes, dashboards, and business rules. Ensure stakeholders understand key metrics and methodologies through clear and accessible documentation.

Who you are:

  • 5+ years of experience in a data analysis or business intelligence role.
  • Strong expertise in SQL and visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI.
  • Excellent business acumen with the ability to quickly understand complex business processes and relationships between data.
  • Proficient in statistics and comfortable applying statistical methods to analyze data.
  • Experience identifying, defining, and tracking KPIs that support strategic business initiatives.
  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with a knack for making data insights easy to understand for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working in a collaborative environment with technical teams and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience in the edtech or education sector is a plus.

How you will create impact:

  • Enable key business partners to make data-driven decisions by providing timely and insightful analysis.
  • Collaborate with engineers to ensure the reporting infrastructure supports efficient and accurate business insights.
  • Identify and track key performance indicators (KPIs) that drive business success and continuously evaluate their effectiveness.
  • Improve data visualization and storytelling capabilities across the organization, increasing trust in and reliance on data.
  • Help drive business performance by uncovering trends and opportunities.

Compensation

At InStride, final offer amounts are dependent on multiple factors including location, depth of experience, interview performance and equity with other team members.

We encourage you to talk with your recruiter to learn more about the total compensation and benefits available for this role.

Compensation range:
$100,000—$125,000 USD

We are looking for someone who is not only technically skilled, but also enthusiastic about making a meaningful impact. If this description resonates with you, we're excited about the possibility of having you on our team. As a skills-driven employer, we encourage you to apply if there is a skill-fit, even in the absence of years of experience.

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At InStride, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role, but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this role!

Benefits @ InStride

As an organization that champions investing in people, it’s critical we walk the talk. That’s why InStride employees are eligible to enroll in 2,800+ online certificate and degree programs through our Step Forward program. Unlike traditional tuition reimbursement programs, InStride covers your tuition upfront, regardless of your course of study, degree type, or school - eligible to employees starting Day 1.

This role is also eligible for the following benefits:

  • 401(k) plan with company match
  • Flexible vacation policy
  • Paid family leave
  • Best-in-class health care benefits
  • And more!

InStride Diversity and Inclusion Statement

At InStride, we foster a culture of belonging, we support authenticity and intersectionality, and we embrace and appreciate our differences. We do this by building a diverse pipeline of talent and ensuring equitable access to opportunities, information and leadership. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let your recruiter know.

Policies & Disclosure

InStride recommends employees have their COVID vaccinations. InStride may require employees to have COVID vaccination before entering the office or attending any InStride-related even in the future. However, we do not require this at this time.

For questions on how we use personal information of job applicants, please refer to InStride's Job Applicant Privacy Policy.

Beware of recruiting scams. InStride does not require a financial transaction or any financial account information to be eligible for employment. If you receive a message purporting to be from InStride asking you for a financial transaction, your financial account information, or any other sensitive information, please do not respond and let us know immediately at .

About InStride

InStride is a human capital management company that helps organizations retain talent, upskill employees, and fill critical workforce roles through education programs. By breaking down barriers to learning, fostering career growth aligned with organizational goals, and simplifying program management, InStride delivers lasting impact. Partnering with forward-thinking companies like Labcorp, Adidas, and SSM Health, InStride drives meaningful social and business outcomes by providing access to life-changing education. The HR Operations Coordinator is responsible for supporting centralized Human Resources programs and operational initiatives across Mission Critical Group (MCG) and its subsidiaries. This position supports program administration within established policies and procedures, tracks activity and trends, and escalates issues and recommendations to the HR Operations Partner.The role serves as MCG's day-to-day contact with Thomas & Company for unemployment claims and tracks vendor service levels and program activity.Additional responsibilities include supporting WOTC administration, tuition reimbursement, professional development, employee recognition initiatives, and centralized HR service delivery.The position partners with HR leadership and business stakeholders to implement approved initiatives, strengthen program effectiveness, and support consistent HR operations across MCG.

Unemployment Claims Administration

  • Serve as MCG’s day-to-day point of contact with Thomas & Company for unemployment claims across MCG and its subsidiaries.
  • Coordinate with Thomas & Company to support timely, accurate unemployment claim responses and compliance with applicable state deadlines.
  • Gather, review, and provide employment separation information, attendance records, disciplinary documentation, and other supporting materials requested for claims.
  • Partner with HR Business Partners, Payroll, and business leaders to obtain complete and accurate information for Thomas & Company.
  • Monitor open claims, requests for information, determinations, hearings, appeals, and outstanding items through the vendor’s platform.
  • Coordinate hearing and appeal preparation with Thomas & Company and appropriate internal stakeholders.
  • Maintain organized records of claim activity, determinations, supporting documents, and vendor correspondence.
  • Provide HR leadership with unemployment claim activity reports, trends, and identified opportunities for improvement.
  • Escalate complex claims, disputed matters, and potential compliance concerns to the HR Operations Partner or appropriate HR leadership.
  • Track claim trends and appeal outcomes and report them to the HR Operations Partner, who manages the Thomas & Company relationship.

Work Opportunity Tax Credit (WOTC) Administration

  • Support the centralized WOTC program and maintain records in the associated vendor platform.
  • Monitor employee screening activity, application submissions, certification status, and outstanding documentation.
  • Review program records for completeness and coordinate resolution of missing or inaccurate information.
  • Maintain documentation supporting tax credit eligibility, certification, and reporting requirements.
  • Monitor program participation and provide regular updates regarding submission activity, certifications, and potential tax credit opportunities.
  • Identify opportunities to improve program participation, efficiency, and data accuracy.

Tuition Reimbursement and Professional Development Programs

  • Support administration of MCG's centralized tuition reimbursement and professional development programs in accordance with established company policies.
  • Receive and review employee applications for completeness and eligibility.
  • Coordinate required approvals with business leaders, HR, and other designated stakeholders.
  • Track approved requests, educational programs, reimbursement amounts, completion documentation, and applicable repayment obligations.
  • Coordinate with Payroll and Finance to support accurate and timely reimbursement processing.
  • Maintain program records and monitor expenditures against approved budgets.
  • Serve as a resource for employees and managers regarding program eligibility, application requirements, and reimbursement procedures.
  • Partner with business leaders to support employee development initiatives and consistent program administration.
  • Identify opportunities to improve employee participation and streamline program processes.

Centralized HR Inbox and Employee Support

  • Manage and monitor the centralized MCG HR inbox to ensure employee and manager inquiries receive timely and professional responses.
  • Serve as an initial point of contact for general HR questions regarding company policies, procedures, programs, and available resources.
  • Research and respond to routine HR inquiries within established guidelines and authority.
  • Route specialized or sensitive inquiries to the appropriate HR functional team, including Payroll, Benefits, Talent Acquisition, HRIS, or HR Business Partners.

  • Identify recurring questions, service issues, and opportunities to improve employee communications and HR service delivery.
  • Maintain confidentiality and exercise appropriate judgment when handling employee information and sensitive matters.
  • Track recurring employee issues and escalate significant operational problems to the HR Operations Partner.

Anniversary Program:

Work Authorization and Pre-Employment Screening Support

  • Support E-Verify case tracking and follow-up as assigned.
  • Track pre-employment screening status and adverse-action notice timelines in Verified First, escalating exceptions.
  • Maintain drug testing and DOT compliance records as assigned.

HR Records and Administrative Support

  • Maintain personnel files and HR records in line with MCG retention standards.
  • Track handbook and policy acknowledgments and onboarding checklist completion against MCG standards.
  • Support the Shoes for Crews program with Safety.
  • Support day-one logistics and new-hire documentation for acquired employees during M&A integrations.

Attributes:

  • Have Humanity: Respect the input and ideas of everyone to create the best possible outcome.
  • Be Transparent: Value transparency in all interactions, ensuring honesty and openness with each stakeholder.
  • Drive Innovation: Seek new ways to improve and take on new challenges.
  • Be Resilient: Adapt to the ever-evolving business needs enabled by resourcefulness and agility.
  • Always Reliable: Deliver on your commitments and achieve your goals. Show up to work on time and complete your assigned tasks.
  • Grit: Learn new things, actively seek feedback and training.
  • Ownership Mindset: Take full responsibility for the quality and efficiency of your work. Proactively identify issues, offer solutions, and follow through. Treat company resources and goals as your own.

Required Knowledge/Experience:

  • Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in human resources or business administration preferred, or equivalent experience
  • 1 to 2 years of experience in Human Resources, HR administration, or a similar role
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment while managing multiple priorities and deadlines
  • Experience managing or supporting HR projects across multiple departments or business units
  • Experience supporting multi-site or multi-entity operations
  • Experience with Form I-9 and E-Verify processes preferred
  • Experience with HRIS platforms; Paylocity preferred
  • Extremely proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Ability to prioritize workload, multitask, and work under pressure in a demanding environment.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Maintain discretion and confidentiality.
  • Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Excellent time management skills with a proven ability to meet deadlines.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

raw.excerpt: About Cogstate At Cogstate, we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.
raw.description:
About Cogstate

At Cogstate, we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.

Our digital cognitive assessments are trusted by researchers, clinicians, and pharmaceutical partners around the world, helping to drive breakthroughs in neuroscience and improve outcomes for people living with neurological conditions. Founded on decades of cognitive science and backed by rigorous validation, Cogstate’s assessments are used in more than 150 countries and over 2,000 clinical trials.

Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. Whether we’re supporting a multinational Alzheimer’s trial or developing tools to bring cognitive testing into routine care, our work is meaningful, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

At Cogstate, we’re not just imagining the future of brain health - we’re building it.

About the Clinician Network

By joining the Cogstate Clinician Network, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute your clinical expertise to research studies around the world.

Depending on your background, scales experience, and therapeutic area expertise, we may have an opportunity for you immediately - or it may take some time before a study opens that is the right fit.

Cogstate is continuing to grow and expand our clinical research initiatives, so new projects and opportunities are always on the horizon.

All applicants to the Clinician Network are kept in our active pipeline, and you’ll also receive our monthly Clinician Network newsletter, which shares updates and upcoming openings.

About the Role

Cogstate Clinicians are clinical psychologists or neuropsychologists responsible for delivering remote clinical interviews and cognitive assessment batteries to subjects with preclinical dementia, enrolled in a pharmaceutical clinical trial.

Cogstate provides all consultants with comprehensive, fully compensated training on general Cogstate operational policies, study-specific procedures, customized clinical interviewing skills and virtual cognitive assessment prior to performing remote scale administrations. Regular supervision and ongoing recalibration of clinical skill set will be provided.

*These are contract position.

*They are fully remote.

*Hired employee will work on an as needed basis based on their schedule.

- VINELAND/VABS Administration Experience Required
- Spanish Fluency Required

Key Responsibilities

Central Rating

  • Remotely administering semi-structured clinical interview assessments and cognitive battery of tests to study subjects and caregivers.
  • Remotely delivering computerized and traditional cognitive assessments via a tele-health platform.
  • Scoring completed scale administrations.
  • Participating in regular clinical skill recalibration activities.

Central Monitoring

  • Providing reviews of completed neuropsychological test batteries for central monitoring of data to ensure accuracy in administration and scoring and contribute to the overall success of a clinical trial.
  • Reviewing response forms and recordings of remote scale administrations and offering feedback to raters via email and telephone communications.

Qualifications & Expertise

  • MA/MS in Psychology or equivalent
  • ≥25 administrations of study scales or similar semi-structured clinical interviews
  • Experience working with pediatric populations with neurodevelopmental delays
    • Rare disease experience is a plus, including Angelman syndrome, Phelan-McDermid syndrome, Fragile X syndrome, or similar disorders
  • Vineland/VABS administration experience
  • Formal training in clinical interviewing and cognitive assessment, including experience working with pediatric populations and caregivers
  • Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience with direct clinical interviewing and psychological assessment in clinical research industry, academic or clinical settings
  • Direct experience with cognitive/behavioral/functional assessment of neurological/psychiatric populations
  • Ability to meet deadlines, being highly organized and methodical, with attention to detail to ensure delivery
  • Proficiency with MS Office, including Word and Excel, email, teleconference platforms such as Skype, Zoom or other similar applications, and cloud-based storage service.
  • Spanish Fluency

Our Culture
We bring our whole selves to work every day. We’re courageous and we deliver together. We’re passionate individuals who enjoy working together. We’re brave enough and care enough to have the right conversations to get the best outcome and are famous for our can-do attitude. We see challenges as opportunities and move with pace to achieve our goals.

If you’re ready to help us in our journey to optimize the measurement of brain health around the world, please apply now!

raw.title: Senior Software Engineer - Financial Crimes
raw.excerpt: Who We Are: Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.
raw.description:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role

This role will focus on developing a centralized case management solution that integrates Anti-Money Laundering (AML), sanctions screening, fraud detection, and trade surveillance into a unified investigative environment.

The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering expertise with financial crimes regulatory knowledge and experience leveraging automation, machine learning, and AI to improve detection effectiveness and operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable financial crimes applications, monitoring integrations, and investigative tools.
  • Build and enhance a centralized, end-to-end case management platform supporting alert management, investigations, escalations, documentation, and reporting.
  • Integrate internal data and third-party monitoring solutions to create unified investigative workflows.
  • Develop automated processes, data pipelines, and AI/ML-enabled capabilities to improve alert prioritization, risk scoring, and investigative efficiency.
  • Design configurable solutions supporting multiple jurisdictions, regulatory requirements, data privacy, and access controls.
  • Translate regulatory and operational requirements into technical solutions in partnership with Global Financial Crimes, Product, Engineering, and Data teams.
  • Own ongoing platform maintenance, production monitoring, troubleshooting, system enhancements, and operational reliability.
  • Implement appropriate audit trails, data integrity controls, regulatory recordkeeping, and reporting capabilities.

Must-Haves — Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, including experience developing financial services, compliance, risk, or financial crimes technology.
  • Strong backend engineering skills, including APIs, SQL databases, cloud infrastructure, data pipelines, and system integrations.
  • Demonstrated experience building or significantly enhancing case management systems, investigation platforms, or complex compliance workflow applications.
  • Working knowledge of U.S. financial crimes regulations and regulatory expectations, including SEC, FINRA, FinCEN, BSA/AML, and OFAC.
  • Experience developing scalable, secure applications with automated workflows, role-based access, audit trails, and data protection controls.
  • Experience building data-driven applications and integrating advanced analytics, automation, or machine learning capabilities into production systems.
  • Understanding of global technology architecture, jurisdiction-specific regulatory controls, and data privacy requirements.
  • Proven experience maintaining production-critical systems, including monitoring, troubleshooting, incident response, and performance optimization.
  • Ability to translate complex regulatory and operational requirements into practical technical solutions.
  • Strong coding skills, preferably in Go
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (preferably Google Cloud Platform), messaging queues and message brokers, containerization and orchestration technologies (preferably Kubernetes) and relational databases (preferably PostgreSQL)

Nice-to-Haves — Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience within a U.S. broker-dealer, clearing and custody firm, fintech, cryptocurrency business, or other regulated financial institution.
  • Familiarity with securities trading, omnibus accounts, market surveillance, and cryptocurrency transaction monitoring.
  • Experience with AML transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, fraud detection, or trade surveillance technologies, whether internally developed or vendor-provided.
  • Experience developing or deploying machine learning models for anomaly detection, behavioral analytics, entity resolution, or predictive risk scoring.
  • Familiarity with generative AI, LLMs, MLOps, model governance, and AI-assisted investigative workflows.
  • Experience designing multi-jurisdiction platforms with configurable regulatory workflows, data residency controls, and localized reporting.
  • Experience modernizing legacy compliance systems or consolidating multiple monitoring tools into a unified case management platform.

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will help Alpaca build and maintain a centralized, scalable, and intelligent Global Financial Crimes platform that improves investigative efficiency, strengthens regulatory controls, reduces manual processes, and supports continued international expansion.

This role offers the opportunity to develop technology that evolves with Alpaca’s business while leveraging automation and advanced analytics to improve financial crimes detection and prevention.

How We Take Care of You:

  • Competitive Salary & Stock Options
  • Health Benefits
  • New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
  • Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

Recruitment Privacy Policy

description: We are seeking a Clinical Pharmacist to join our employee benefits consulting team.

raw.title: Clinical Pharmacist
raw.excerpt: We are seeking a Clinical Pharmacist to join our employee benefits consulting team.
raw.description:
We are seeking a Clinical Pharmacist to join our employee benefits consulting team. This role provides clinical and analytical support for pharmacy benefits strategy, PBM evaluation, and cost containment strategies for self-funded employer clients. You will conduct claims analysis, evaluate clinical programs, and prepare client-facing materials that support the team’s strategic recommendations.

Key Responsibilities:

Clinical Analysis & Program Support

·Analyze pharmacy claims data to identify utilization trends, cost drivers, and high-cost claimants.

·Support evaluation of clinical programs and draft evidenced-based recommendations for review.

·Maintain and update internal tracking tools for high-cost claimant monitoring and clinical program performance.

·Research pharmacy industry trends, regulatory developments, and emerging therapies, and summarize implications for client portfolios.

Client Consulting & Communication

·Present findings, benchmarking insights, and high-cost claimant analysis to clients in a clear, strategic manner.

·Provide oversight and guidance for pharmacy-related needs, including education and support to the sales and service teams.

·Participate in client and prospect meetings in a supporting capacity, providing clinical detail and answering technical questions as directed.

·Draft external client-facing communications, including a monthly or quarterly client newsletter covering pharmacy trend updates, regulatory changes, and emerging therapies.

Cross-Functional Support

·Collaborate with actuarial, clinical, and account management teams to gather data and context for clinical analysis.

·Contribute to risk management strategies within captive programs.

·Assist in developing and maintaining internal training materials to educate broader team on new PBM programs, regulatory developments, and clinical topics.

·Support due diligence reviews for vendor arrangements.

Qualifications:

Education & Credentials

·PharmD (Doctor of Pharmacy) required.

·Active pharmacist license required.

·Additional board certifications or specialized training in areas such as pharmacotherapy, ambulatory care, or internal medicine are preferred.

Experience

·3+ years of experience in pharmacy benefits, PBM operations, clinical pharmacy, or a related setting.

·Clinical practice experience (hospital, ambulatory care, or managed care) is highly desirable.

·Prior consulting or health plan experience is a plus, not required.

Skills

·Strong communication skills with the ability to simplify technical content.

·Strong analytical, financial, and clinical decision-making skills.

·Ability to synthesize information quickly and translate it into practical recommendations.

·Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to support client-facing presentations.

·Comfort working under deadlines in a fast-paced, team-based environment.

·Willingness to learn PBM contract structures and pharmacy benefit design fundamentals.

Who you are

·Detail-oriented and analytically minded, with a strong foundation in clinical pharmacy.

·A collaborative team player who thrives working under senior guidance while building independent judgement.

·Reliable, organized, and able to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

·A clear communicator with a passion for advancing pharmacy strategy in employee benefits.

What You’ll Get: Competitive compensation, comprehensive health coverage, professional development opportunities, employee ownership, FTO, etc.

raw.title: Sr. Marketing Manager, Thoracic and Colorectal
raw.excerpt: Primary Function of Position This position has the opportunity to make a direct impact to Intuitive US marketing initiatives that deliver da Vinci Surgery to patients worldwide.
raw.description:
Primary Function of Position
This position has the opportunity to make a direct impact to Intuitive US marketing initiatives that deliver da Vinci Surgery to
patients worldwide. With the direction and guidance of the US Clinical Marketing leaders, you will develop, drive, and support the
US marketing efforts for Colorectal & Thoracic Surgery. You will have a particular focus on Colorectal & Thoracic Multi-Port &
Single Port procedures with the use of the da Vinci Surgical System and its associated products (e.g. Vessel Sealer Extend, Force

Bipolar etc.).

Essential Job Duties
This position will be responsible for development and coordination of various strategic and tactical clinical marketing initiatives to
drive procedure growth within the US Colorectal & Thoracic business. The individual will be expected to establish strong
relationships with the marketing and sales teams, external Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), as well as internal ISI stakeholders such
as other marketing departments, training, clinical affairs, legal, regulatory, and Market Access / Health Economics.

Build & execute high impact marketing plans and corresponding tactical plans / programs to achieve budgeted growth
projections in key areas of General Surgery.
 Develop qualitative and quantitative data and experiences to segment and deeply understand existing and new
markets, the surgeon, their practice, the patient journey, and the clinical procedure steps.
 Utilize market knowledge to design and develop strategies and value messaging (clinical, economic, operational,
strategic), collateral, tactics, and programs with demonstrated ROI.
 Assimilate Colorectal & Thoracic market trends and their potential implications to current and future
work/projects. Understand competition and develop competitive differentiation.
 Contribute to budget, resource allocation and financial planning for projects / programs with measured ROI to justify
through multiple marketing / media channels (webinars, sales collateral, etc.)
 Work with Key Opinion Leader surgeons to better understand how the da Vinci Surgical System and instruments are
being utilized and determine how to communicate that value proposition to other physicians.
 Develop and build KOLs by market segment with the goal of making Intuitive the preferred industry collaborator.
 Build relationships with key society members / leaders to establish a higher level of engagement to ensure Intuitive is
seen as an integral collaborator when planning congresses and implementing guidelines.
 Coordinate trade show activities, digital & website development, strategies, and tracking of marketing campaigns to
evaluate results and provide recommendations for future marketing promotions.
 Coach other Marketing colleagues in on-boarding, learning marketing standards, and growing their business acumen

(clinical, hospital, or academic).

 Lead cross-functional teams to deliver high value marketing projects and programs.
 Deliver impactful presentations to senior and executive Intuitive leadership.
 Be a market expert in the area of Colorectal & Thoracic surgery – effectively leveraging the value propositions,
approved claims, surgeon feedback, and sales input to maximize Intuitive’s footprint and growth trajectory in this area.
 Be a champion of the Intuitive culture; learning and embodying the company’s individual expectations for success.

Required Skills, Experience, and Training
 Minimum 10 plus years of marketing and/or sales experience in a therapeutic medical device company preferred.
 A proven record of achievement and leadership.
 Results-driven attitude & a resolve to win; must be self-directed with the ability to work with minimal supervision.
 Proven ability to solve open-ended problems and work cross-functionally to implement initiatives.
 Superior verbal/written communication and presentation skills, teambuilding, and interpersonal skills to work across

multiple constituents.

 Bachelor degree required, MBA or Masters degree preferred.
 Must be well versed in MS Office Suite.
Commitment:
 Must be available to work full-time hours.
 Ability to travel 35%; up to 50% if remote.

Due to the nature of our business and the role, please note that Intuitive and/or your customer(s) may require that you show current proof of vaccination against certain diseases including COVID-19. Details can vary by role.

Intuitive is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws.

Mandatory Notices

U.S. Export Controls Disclaimer: In accordance with the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (15 CFR §743.13(b)), some roles at Intuitive Surgical may be subject to U.S. export controls for prospective employees who are nationals from countries currently on embargo or sanctions status.

Certain information you provide as part of the application will be used for purposes of determining whether Intuitive Surgical will need to (i) obtain an export license from the U.S. Government on your behalf (note: the government’s licensing process can take 3 to 6+ months) or (ii) implement a Technology Control Plan (“TCP”) (note: typically adds 2 weeks to the hiring process).

For any Intuitive role subject to export controls, final offers are contingent upon obtaining an approved export license and/or an executed TCP prior to the prospective employee’s start date, which may or may not be flexible, and within a timeframe that does not unreasonably impede the hiring need. If applicable, candidates will be notified and instructed on any requirements for these purposes.

We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with fair chance laws.

This position may be filled at a different job level than listed here depending on
business need and/or on the selected candidate’s experience, knowledge and skills.
Compensation will be based primarily on the job level at which the role is filled and the
candidate’s qualifications, consistent with applicable law.

Accommodation & Accessibility Notice:

Intuitive is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you require assistance or an accommodation during any part of the application or interview process, please contact People Services at .

We provide market-competitive compensation packages, inclusive of base pay, incentives, benefits, and equity. It would not be typical for someone to be hired at the top end of range for the role, as actual pay will be determined based on several factors, including experience, skills, and qualifications. The target base compensation ranges are listed.

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive. As a global leader in robotic-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care, our technologies—like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.

We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.

The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare, you’ll find your purpose here.

raw.description:
At InStride, people are our purpose.

We believe that investing in people is the most powerful way to drive success—for individuals and organizations alike.

As a public benefit corporation, we partner with leading employers to unlock opportunities for their employees, providing access to top-tier education programs that align with their employees’ career goals and the company’s business goals.

Our mission goes beyond skill-building; we're here to empower our partners’ employees to advance their careers, elevate their expertise, and achieve meaningful personal and professional growth.

No matter the team you’re on, our dedication to the success of our partners and their employees is what drives us. If you're passionate about making a difference and driving educational and professional advancement, InStride is the place for you.

To get a better feel for our culture, watch more here.

Candidates must be located in one of the following states to be considered eligible for employment: AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, DE, FL, GA, IL, IN, KS, LA, MA, MD, MI, MN, MO, NC, NH, NJ, NV, NY, OH, OR, PA, TX, VA, WA, WI.

What we're looking for:

InStride is seeking experienced Data Analysts to join our growing Data Analytics team. As a Senior Data Analyst reporting to the Director of Data Analytics, you will play a crucial role in transforming data into actionable insights and recommendations that drive strategic decisions across the business. You’ll collaborate closely with stakeholders across the company, providing them with data-driven insights to support growth and operational efficiency. Your work will contribute to building a strong data culture, enabling key business partners to self-serve data through dynamic dashboards and make informed decisions using company-wide metrics.

Skills we’d love to see you show off:

  • Data Analysis & Reporting: Analyze complex datasets from Databricks to provide actionable insights across internal teams such as sales, marketing, finance, and product. Build and maintain dynamic Tableau dashboards that empower stakeholders to self-serve and track key metrics.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with business partners to understand needs and provide data-driven insights for strategic decisions. Serve as a trusted advisor to business stakeholders, helping them interpret data and apply it effectively.
  • Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and Metrics: Identify, define, and track company-wide key performance indicators (KPIs) aligned with business goals. Continuously monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of KPIs, suggesting new metrics to support organizational consistency.
  • Data Validation & Integrity: Ensure accuracy and consistency in data reporting, collaborating with analytics engineers to maintain data quality. Validate data models, ensuring alignment with business requirements and optimization for reporting.
  • Data Visualization & Presentation: Create clear and compelling visualizations to communicate complex data to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Present insights and recommendations in a concise, actionable format to business leaders and teams.
  • Documentation & Best Practices: Maintain thorough documentation of data models, analysis processes, dashboards, and business rules. Ensure stakeholders understand key metrics and methodologies through clear and accessible documentation.

Who you are:

  • 5+ years of experience in a data analysis or business intelligence role.
  • Strong expertise in SQL and visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI.
  • Excellent business acumen with the ability to quickly understand complex business processes and relationships between data.
  • Proficient in statistics and comfortable applying statistical methods to analyze data.
  • Experience identifying, defining, and tracking KPIs that support strategic business initiatives.
  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with a knack for making data insights easy to understand for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working in a collaborative environment with technical teams and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience in the edtech or education sector is a plus.

How you will create impact:

  • Enable key business partners to make data-driven decisions by providing timely and insightful analysis.
  • Collaborate with engineers to ensure the reporting infrastructure supports efficient and accurate business insights.
  • Identify and track key performance indicators (KPIs) that drive business success and continuously evaluate their effectiveness.
  • Improve data visualization and storytelling capabilities across the organization, increasing trust in and reliance on data.
  • Help drive business performance by uncovering trends and opportunities.

Compensation

At InStride, final offer amounts are dependent on multiple factors including location, depth of experience, interview performance and equity with other team members.

We encourage you to talk with your recruiter to learn more about the total compensation and benefits available for this role.

Compensation range:
$100,000—$125,000 USD

We are looking for someone who is not only technically skilled, but also enthusiastic about making a meaningful impact. If this description resonates with you, we're excited about the possibility of having you on our team. As a skills-driven employer, we encourage you to apply if there is a skill-fit, even in the absence of years of experience.

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At InStride, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role, but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this role!

Benefits @ InStride

As an organization that champions investing in people, it’s critical we walk the talk. That’s why InStride employees are eligible to enroll in 2,800+ online certificate and degree programs through our Step Forward program. Unlike traditional tuition reimbursement programs, InStride covers your tuition upfront, regardless of your course of study, degree type, or school - eligible to employees starting Day 1.

This role is also eligible for the following benefits:

  • 401(k) plan with company match
  • Flexible vacation policy
  • Paid family leave
  • Best-in-class health care benefits
  • And more!

InStride Diversity and Inclusion Statement

At InStride, we foster a culture of belonging, we support authenticity and intersectionality, and we embrace and appreciate our differences. We do this by building a diverse pipeline of talent and ensuring equitable access to opportunities, information and leadership. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let your recruiter know.

Policies & Disclosure

InStride recommends employees have their COVID vaccinations. InStride may require employees to have COVID vaccination before entering the office or attending any InStride-related even in the future. However, we do not require this at this time.

For questions on how we use personal information of job applicants, please refer to InStride's Job Applicant Privacy Policy.

Beware of recruiting scams. InStride does not require a financial transaction or any financial account information to be eligible for employment. If you receive a message purporting to be from InStride asking you for a financial transaction, your financial account information, or any other sensitive information, please do not respond and let us know immediately at .

About InStride

InStride is a human capital management company that helps organizations retain talent, upskill employees, and fill critical workforce roles through education programs. By breaking down barriers to learning, fostering career growth aligned with organizational goals, and simplifying program management, InStride delivers lasting impact. Partnering with forward-thinking companies like Labcorp, Adidas, and SSM Health, InStride drives meaningful social and business outcomes by providing access to life-changing education. Visit instride.com or follow InStride on LinkedIn for more information and up-to-date news.

raw.description:
The HR Operations Coordinator is responsible for supporting centralized Human Resources programs and operational initiatives across Mission Critical Group (MCG) and its subsidiaries. This position supports program administration within established policies and procedures, tracks activity and trends, and escalates issues and recommendations to the HR Operations Partner.The role serves as MCG's day-to-day contact with Thomas & Company for unemployment claims and tracks vendor service levels and program activity.Additional responsibilities include supporting WOTC administration, tuition reimbursement, professional development, employee recognition initiatives, and centralized HR service delivery.The position partners with HR leadership and business stakeholders to implement approved initiatives, strengthen program effectiveness, and support consistent HR operations across MCG.

Unemployment Claims Administration

  • Serve as MCG’s day-to-day point of contact with Thomas & Company for unemployment claims across MCG and its subsidiaries.
  • Coordinate with Thomas & Company to support timely, accurate unemployment claim responses and compliance with applicable state deadlines.
  • Gather, review, and provide employment separation information, attendance records, disciplinary documentation, and other supporting materials requested for claims.
  • Partner with HR Business Partners, Payroll, and business leaders to obtain complete and accurate information for Thomas & Company.
  • Monitor open claims, requests for information, determinations, hearings, appeals, and outstanding items through the vendor’s platform.
  • Coordinate hearing and appeal preparation with Thomas & Company and appropriate internal stakeholders.
  • Maintain organized records of claim activity, determinations, supporting documents, and vendor correspondence.
  • Provide HR leadership with unemployment claim activity reports, trends, and identified opportunities for improvement.
  • Escalate complex claims, disputed matters, and potential compliance concerns to the HR Operations Partner or appropriate HR leadership.
  • Track claim trends and appeal outcomes and report them to the HR Operations Partner, who manages the Thomas & Company relationship.

Work Opportunity Tax Credit (WOTC) Administration

  • Support the centralized WOTC program and maintain records in the associated vendor platform.
  • Monitor employee screening activity, application submissions, certification status, and outstanding documentation.
  • Review program records for completeness and coordinate resolution of missing or inaccurate information.
  • Maintain documentation supporting tax credit eligibility, certification, and reporting requirements.
  • Monitor program participation and provide regular updates regarding submission activity, certifications, and potential tax credit opportunities.
  • Identify opportunities to improve program participation, efficiency, and data accuracy.

Tuition Reimbursement and Professional Development Programs

  • Support administration of MCG's centralized tuition reimbursement and professional development programs in accordance with established company policies.
  • Receive and review employee applications for completeness and eligibility.
  • Coordinate required approvals with business leaders, HR, and other designated stakeholders.
  • Track approved requests, educational programs, reimbursement amounts, completion documentation, and applicable repayment obligations.
  • Coordinate with Payroll and Finance to support accurate and timely reimbursement processing.
  • Maintain program records and monitor expenditures against approved budgets.
  • Serve as a resource for employees and managers regarding program eligibility, application requirements, and reimbursement procedures.
  • Partner with business leaders to support employee development initiatives and consistent program administration.
  • Identify opportunities to improve employee participation and streamline program processes.

Centralized HR Inbox and Employee Support

  • Manage and monitor the centralized MCG HR inbox to ensure employee and manager inquiries receive timely and professional responses.
  • Serve as an initial point of contact for general HR questions regarding company policies, procedures, programs, and available resources.
  • Research and respond to routine HR inquiries within established guidelines and authority.
  • Route specialized or sensitive inquiries to the appropriate HR functional team, including Payroll, Benefits, Talent Acquisition, HRIS, or HR Business Partners.
  • Track outstanding inquiries and follow up with responsible parties to support timely resolution.
  • Identify recurring questions, service issues, and opportunities to improve employee communications and HR service delivery.
  • Maintain confidentiality and exercise appropriate judgment when handling employee information and sensitive matters.
  • Track recurring employee issues and escalate significant operational problems to the HR Operations Partner.

Anniversary Program:

  • Manage and administer the MCG and MCGS employee anniversary recognition program, including the coordination, execution, and distribution of employee recognition gifts through Giftogram to support employee engagement and recognition initiatives across the organization.

Work Authorization and Pre-Employment Screening Support

  • Conduct routine I-9 audit sampling and track corrections to completion under established procedures.
  • Track work-authorization expiration dates and send reverification reminders to HRBP’s
  • Support E-Verify case tracking and follow-up as assigned.
  • Track pre-employment screening status and adverse-action notice timelines in Verified First, escalating exceptions.
  • Maintain drug testing and DOT compliance records as assigned.

HR Records and Administrative Support

  • Maintain personnel files and HR records in line with MCG retention standards.
  • Track handbook and policy acknowledgments and onboarding checklist completion against MCG standards.
  • Support the Shoes for Crews program with Safety.
  • Support day-one logistics and new-hire documentation for acquired employees during M&A integrations.

Attributes:

  • Safety Focus: Prioritize safety in all actions. Actively follow safety protocols, identify potential hazards, and take immediate steps to correct or report unsafe conditions. Model safe behavior for others and contribute to a culture of workplace safety.
  • Have Humanity: Respect the input and ideas of everyone to create the best possible outcome.
  • Be Transparent: Value transparency in all interactions, ensuring honesty and openness with each stakeholder.
  • Drive Innovation: Seek new ways to improve and take on new challenges.
  • Be Resilient: Adapt to the ever-evolving business needs enabled by resourcefulness and agility.
  • Always Reliable: Deliver on your commitments and achieve your goals. Show up to work on time and complete your assigned tasks.
  • Grit: Learn new things, actively seek feedback and training.
  • Ownership Mindset: Take full responsibility for the quality and efficiency of your work. Proactively identify issues, offer solutions, and follow through. Treat company resources and goals as your own.

Required Knowledge/Experience:

  • Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in human resources or business administration preferred, or equivalent experience
  • 1 to 2 years of experience in Human Resources, HR administration, or a similar role
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment while managing multiple priorities and deadlines
  • Experience managing or supporting HR projects across multiple departments or business units
  • Experience supporting multi-site or multi-entity operations
  • Experience with Form I-9 and E-Verify processes preferred
  • Experience with HRIS platforms; Paylocity preferred
  • Extremely proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Ability to prioritize workload, multitask, and work under pressure in a demanding environment.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Maintain discretion and confidentiality.
  • Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Excellent time management skills with a proven ability to meet deadlines.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Mission Critical Group (MCG) is a U.S.-based electrical systems and solutions provider that reduces time-to-power through its broad product portfolio, modular solutions, and more than one million square feet of U.S. manufacturing capacity.

We bring design, manufacturing, and advanced services together to deliver power reliability, scalability, and speed.
