raw.title: Senior Player/Game Economy
raw.excerpt: Our company has a vision tochange people’s mood for the better.
raw.description:
Our company has a vision tochange people’s mood for the better. And our mission is to be a fast moving, highly efficient, tech services company that engages people, partners & players and gives them great experiences.

We work with a range of global client brands - we are in “scale up” mode, hiring the best and most highly motivated, fast working, bureaucracy hating, “I want to win but I’m not afraid to fail…”, team players.

Sweepstakes Casino & Real-Money Gaming

300+ employees. 10+ years in gaming. Multiple international brands.We are an established and rapidly growing gaming company operating across Sweepstakes Casino and Real-Money Gaming. We are looking for a senior commercial leader to own the player economy and monetization strategy across our portfolio.

This is a high-impact leadership role with direct access to senior management, significant decision-making authority and clear ownership of commercial outcomes.For an exceptional candidate, we offer a top-of-market executive compensation package, significant performance-based bonus and meaningful equity participation.

About the Role

You will own the player economy across our RMG and Sweepstakes brands: bonuses, offers, VIP and loyalty, GC/SC coin packages and pricing, segmentation, economy-driven features, game RTP and content mix. You set the economic rules, measure the outcomes and adjust.

You will work across Product, CRM, VIP, User Acquisition, Analytics, Casino, Customer Service and Marketing so every team operates against one economic and monetization plan.

What You Will Do

  • Define monetization and economy strategy by vertical, brand and player segment: bonus cost as a share of GGR, promotional depth, VIP reinvestment, pricing and RTP policy.

  • Own the bonus and offer framework: mechanics, eligibility, cost models, wagering/playthrough rules and abuse controls.

  • Own player segmentation and lifecycle monetization across new, active, retained, lapsing, reactivated, high-value and VIP players.

  • Design and price GC/SC coin packages, bundles, first-purchase/first-deposit offers and personalized offers.

  • Own VIP and loyalty economics: tier thresholds, reinvestment rates, rewards and cost per tier; automatically control spend on negative-value players.

  • Approve the economics of promotions proposed by CRM, VIP, Customer Service and Marketing and hold teams accountable to the plan.

  • Set RTP policy by brand, market and game category, and manage game/provider mix against margin and retention targets.

  • Define economic requirements for features including bonus engines, gamification, missions, tournaments, jackpots, cashback and loyalty.

  • Own A/B testing across pricing, bonus depth, packages, rewards, promotions and economy features; scale what works and stop what does not.

  • Forecast the impact of changes before release and report actual performance against forecast after launch.

  • Define economy and monetization dashboards with Analytics and run a regular economy review with leadership.

  • Work with Compliance to ensure bonus terms, RTP disclosure and promotional mechanics remain within the rules of each market.

What You Bring

  • 2+ years in Monetization, Game Economy, LiveOps, Product or Revenue Optimization within iGaming, Sweepstakes, Social Casino or highly monetized F2P gaming.

  • Direct ownership of bonus, promotional, economy or VIP reinvestment budgets, with measurable results you can demonstrate.

  • Proven ability to improve revenue, payer/depositor conversion, retention, ARPPU and player LTV.

  • Working knowledge of slot mechanics, RTP models, volatility, bonus abuse patterns and wagering/playthrough design.

  • Understanding of dual-currency Sweepstakes economies: Gold Coins / Sweepstakes Coins, purchases, promotional currency, playthrough and redemption.

  • Strong analytical skills: able to build cost models and independently interpret cohort, segmentation and LTV data.

  • Track record of controlled experimentation and changing commercial decisions based on evidence.

  • Leadership experience and the ability to challenge commercial teams and explain economics in clear business language.

Strong advantages:direct US Sweepstakes experience, operator-side experience with CRM/bonus engine platforms, multi-brand experience, RMG casino experience, SQL/BI capability and experience building or leading monetization/economy teams.

How Success is Measured

  • Bonus and promotional cost as a share of GGR within target by vertical, brand and segment.

  • Effective RTP and margin within policy while protecting retention and player value.

  • VIP reinvestment proportional to player value and profitability.

  • Improvement in second purchase / second deposit rates, payer conversion, ARPPU, retention and LTV.

  • Incremental revenue from A/B tests, new features, pricing and segmentation without costs growing faster than revenue.

The Offer

We are prepared to pay at the top of the market for exceptional talent.

  • High executive-level base salary

  • Significant performance-based bonus

  • Meaningful equity participation

  • Long-term incentives linked to the value you help create

  • Real ownership, direct access to senior management and significant decision-making authority

We are not looking for someone to simply manage an existing function.We want someone who can build it, own it, materially grow the business and participate in the upside they create.

About SixValues

Our vision is to elevate the mood of people everywhere, making every interaction more engaging, rewarding, and memorable. Through cutting-edge technology and a real commitment to excellence, we aim to revolutionize how people connect with digital experiences, transforming the world of betting and gaming technology.

Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to be a fast-moving, highly efficient tech company that brings joy and excitement to players by delivering top-tier solutions for operators. From website and application development to data analytics and payment systems, everything we do is designed to create seamless, thrilling experiences for our partners and their customers.

raw.excerpt: Company Overview Our client sells subscription software to property managers.
raw.description:
Company Overview

Our client sells subscription software to property managers. It has an iOS and Android app for field capture, a web dashboard for reports, tenant self-inspections and work orders. It grows through direct sales, referrals and partnerships, and it connects to the systems customers already use.

The CEO founded the company in California in 2014. It also turns voice notes into inspection reports with AI. The team is fully remote, and the engineering manager works from Uruguay.

Your Role

As Senior Software Engineer, you'll own features on the product engineering team, from the first product conversation through release and what happens in production afterwards. The seat is hands-on and covers Senior to Staff level. It's a full-time remote contractor role on Pacific time hours.

You'll report to the Head of Product Engineering and work closely with product. The team is building more with AI, and it's moving parts of its single large codebase into separate services while customers keep using the product. Your working day needs several hours of overlap with Pacific time.

Success means a feature you built is live and you're watching it in production. It also means you've fixed production data problems at the root cause, and your code reviews show in the work of the engineers around you.

You'll

  • Own features from the first product conversation through release and fixes after launch
  • Write short design notes and share them with the team before building
  • Fix late, repeated or cut-off mobile uploads at their root cause
  • Speed up queries over a dataset of 100M+ inspection photos
  • Build AI features on the voice-to-report tool, with a safe fallback for wrong output
  • Watch production after each release and fix what breaks
  • Help decide which parts of the monolith become separate services, and in what order
  • Review pull requests and mentor engineers, giving the reason for each comment

You Bring

  • Several years building and running a live product where mistakes cost customers
  • Full-stack experience with significant backend depth: services, data and APIs, plus React or Next.js and mobile work
  • A product mindset: you start from the customer's problem and ask product sharp questions
  • Features taken from rough idea to release, then watched in production
  • A production problem you debugged to its root cause and can walk through
  • AI tools in your engineering workflow every day, and AI-powered features you've shipped to real users
  • Clear English, written and spoken, for design notes and pull requests
  • Code review and mentoring of other engineers
  • Self-starting habits that suit a small, remote team

Bonus Points

  • Led a cross-team initiative or defined the architecture of a major system
  • Moved part of a monolith into services while customers kept using the product
  • Built offline capture or sync with retries and duplicate handling

What's Offered

  • Compensation based on experience and where you're based. Share your target range and we'll go from there.

Interview Process

1️⃣ First call: 30 minutes with us at atomic✳HR on what you have built, working terms and what you want next.
2️⃣ Interviews with the engineering team: conversations about systems you have owned, what broke in them, how you found out and what you changed afterwards.
3️⃣ Final conversation with the CEO: on how you would work with product and the team, and what you would want to take on first.
4️⃣ Identity verification: a check that you are the person on the profile, done before an offer is made.
5️⃣ Offer: level, monthly rate in USD and start date, in writing.

raw.description:
About Wirex

Wirex is a UK-headquartered, FCA-regulated digital payments and crypto platform. We built the first debit card that lets people pay with crypto, and we've spent more than a decade making digital money work in everyday life. Today around 250 people across 26 countries power our consumer app, card programmes and Banking-as-a-Service products, through a group of regulated and service entities in the UK, Europe, Asia-Pacific and the Americas.

The role

We're entering a period of significant regulatory and commercial growth, and we're looking for a General Counsel & Chief Legal Officer to lead Legal through it. You'll be Wirex's single senior legal voice: accountable to the CEO, Co-Founders and Board for all legal matters across the group, and for how legal risk is understood, managed and reported.

You'll lead an in-house Legal function organised in two disciplines: Regulatory and Corporate & Commercial. This is a hands-on leadership role. It suits a commercially minded lawyer who is as comfortable negotiating a scheme agreement or a funding round as advising the Board.

What you'll do

  • Act as strategic legal adviser to the CEO, Co-Founders, Board and Executive Team, and report on legal risk to the Board and investors.
  • Lead negotiation of key commercial agreements, including card scheme, issuer-processor, banking, safeguarding and BaaS partnerships.
  • Lead legal work on fundraising, investment rounds, M&A, restructurings and new entity set-up.
  • Oversee corporate governance and company secretarial compliance across every group entity.
  • Oversee licensing, regulator engagement and horizon-scanning, and shepherd new products into new jurisdictions.
  • Manage disputes, data protection, IP and wider legal risk, and the external counsel panel and Legal budget.
  • Develop the team, set clear ownership for every matter, and use AI to work faster and smarter.

What you'll bring

  • Qualified lawyer, admitted in England & Wales (or equivalent), with at least 12 years' PQE.
  • Private practice training in corporate or commercial law, plus senior in-house experience.
  • Experience leading the legal function, or acting as deputy GC, in a payments, e-money, banking or fintech business.
  • A strong track record in payments commercial contracts, and in fundraising, lending structures, investment rounds or M&A.
  • Experience advising boards, governing a multi-entity international group, and managing external counsel and a legal budget.
  • Desirable: crypto or digital assets experience (including MiCA or FCA cryptoasset regulation), regulator engagement, and experience as a designated or approved person.

Ready to lead an exceptionally talented in-house Legal team at a regulated fintech shaping the future of digital money? If you have the skills and experience we're looking for, apply now. We're reviewing applications on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply early.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary and package
  • Pension
  • Remote and flexible working hours
  • Home working allowance
  • Annual training allowance
  • One paid charity day
  • Enhanced employee product perks
  • Team and company-wide social events

NOTE: This job description is not contractual and may be amended to reflect the changing needs of the business. Benefits may vary from region to region and will depend on the location you are hired in.

Pre-employment screening

All appointments are subject to satisfactory completion of pre-employment screening and background checks appropriate to the role.

These checks are mandatory for new hires and form part of Wirex's governance and regulatory framework. The scope of screening may vary depending on the role, seniority and regulatory responsibilities.

Candidates will receive relevant information regarding the screening process and any applicable consent requirements during the recruitment process.

Equal opportunity

Wirex is committed to equal opportunity and to building an inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.

Job Description Summary:

At Rocket Software, we power the world's most innovative businesses through modernization. Our mission is to help customers maximize the value of their existing technology investments while accelerating innovation through AI, automation, cloud, and hybrid infrastructure. Every Rocketeer contributes to helping customers solve complex challenges while preserving and extending the value of their mission-critical systems.

As a AI Test Automation Engineer, you will help build and run AI-enabled test automation across Rocket's mainframe and enterprise software portfolio. You will contribute to automated testing frameworks and validation methods for agentic AI systems, with a developing understanding of IBM z/OS environments. This is a hands-on growth role: you will work on well-defined test projects alongside experienced engineers and build the skills to take on broader scope over time.

The AI Test Automation Engineer is an intermediate-level technical contributor on a project or work team, using practical technical principles to build and maintain test automation for AI-powered and agentic applications. Working under moderate supervision, this role supports Engineering, Product Management, and Data Science teams in validating AI agents, large language model (LLM) integrations, retrieval systems, and AI-driven workflows operating in enterprise and mainframe environments.


The ideal candidate has foundational experience in software development or quality engineering and is building working knowledge of test automation and AI testing methods. They apply technical principles to somewhat complex problems on smaller, less complex projects and assignments, seek advice from senior engineers when needed, and have their work reviewed to ensure key objectives are met. They may provide guidance and assistance to less experienced team members within their job area.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities


Agentic AI Testing

  • Build and maintain automated evaluation tests for AI agents, LLM-powered applications, and orchestration workflows, following established frameworks and patterns.
  • Develop test cases for AI agent behavior, task completion accuracy, and tool use, using direction from senior engineers.
  • Assist in building and maintaining benchmark datasets and test environments for continuous AI performance validation.
  • Collect, measure, and report results such as hallucination rates, accuracy, robustness, and bias, and flag safety concerns to the team.
  • Support regression testing and the validation of AI guardrails and monitoring strategies.

Automation & Engineering Excellence

  • Implement and maintain automated tests integrated into product CI/CD pipelines.
  • Use AI-assisted and agent-driven testing tools in daily work, and share what works with the team.
  • Contribute data to quality metrics and operational dashboards.
  • Make minor improvements to test processes, tools, and systems to improve quality and cycle time within the job area.
  • Troubleshoot test failures and defects, escalating to senior personnel when issues extend beyond the immediate project.

Collaboration & Growth

  • Work with Engineering, Product Management, and Data Science teammates to understand AI reliability, explainability, safety, and trustworthiness requirements.
  • Communicate test results, defects, and quality risks clearly to colleagues within the department.
  • Provide guidance and assistance to less experienced team members within the job area.
  • Seek and apply feedback from senior engineers and keep current on AI testing techniques and mainframe technologies.

Required Qualifications

  • University degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • At least 2 years of relevant experience in software development, software quality engineering, or test automation.
  • Experience writing code or scripts (for example Python, Java, or similar) for test automation.
  • Basic understanding of AI, machine learning, LLMs, or generative AI concepts, and a willingness to learn agentic AI testing.
  • Basic understanding of APIs, distributed systems, and cloud-native applications.
  • Understanding of the technical and business context of the products being tested, and awareness of emerging advances in AI testing.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to IBM z/OS environments and mainframe technologies.
  • Exposure to public cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and test automation frameworks.
.

Rocket Software Inc. is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Rocket Software Inc. is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status.


At Rocket Software, we believe AI is a critical enabler of innovation and productivity. All Rocketeers are expected to actively leverage AI-powered tools and technologies, where appropriate, to enhance efficiency, improve decision-making, and deliver greater impact in their roles. Embracing continuous learning and the responsible use of AI is an essential part of how we work.


As part of our commitment to a safe and trustworthy workplace, we include background and reference checks in our hiring process.


Rocket is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with physical and mental disabilities. If you need special assistance or an accommodation while seeking employment, please call: 781-577-4321 or send an email to . We will make a determination on your request for reasonable accommodation on a case-by-case basis.

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

raw.description:
Summary

The Director, Project Management and Resource Operations provides strategic leadership for the Project Management Office and Resource Management Office supporting Logicalis Professional Services. This role is accountable for building a scalable delivery operating model that improves project predictability, customer experience, portfolio visibility, financial performance, and resource utilization.

This leader ensures customer commitments are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned to expected business outcomes. The Director drives delivery governance, portfolio health, resource orchestration, risk management, and continuous improvement across complex professional services engagements. The role uses data, automation, and AI-enabled capabilities to improve decision-making, identify risks earlier, reduce administrative burden, protect project margin, and enable proactive business leadership.

As a senior Services leader, this position serves as the executive escalation point for significant delivery, customer, financial, and resource risks. The Director partners closely with Professional Services, sales, finance, practice leadership, delivery teams, and customer stakeholders to ensure consistent execution, stronger accountability, and a more scalable, customer-obsessed delivery model.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

PMO and RMO Leadership

· Leads the integrated PMO and RMO operating model, including project intake, project manager assignment, resource qualification and scheduling, subcontractor coordination, project governance, financial oversight, and project closure.

· Establishes clear decision rights, standards, and accountability across PMO, RMO, Engagement Managers, practice leaders, sales, finance, delivery teams, partners, and customer stakeholders.

· Builds forward-looking capacity and demand management capabilities using backlog, pipeline, resource availability, skills, utilization, and third-party capacity data.

· Ensures projects are assigned the appropriate project leadership and technical resources based on customer needs, required skills, delivery complexity, availability, location, and financial considerations.


Delivery Governance and Portfolio Management

· Defines and maintains a scalable project delivery framework with differentiated governance based on engagement value, risk, complexity, customer impact, delivery model, and contractual exposure.

· Owns portfolio health reporting and executive governance, connecting delivery, financial, customer, schedule, scope, resource, and quality indicators.

· Establishes thresholds and operating mechanisms for escalation, recovery planning, executive sponsorship, corrective action, and closure.

· Leads project recovery efforts for high-risk or strategically important engagements and ensure corrective actions have accountable owners, dates, and measurable outcomes.

· Governs delivery involving strategic vendors, subcontractors, and acquired organizations.

· Ensures consistent application of the PMO operating framework while simplifying requirements where additional rigor does not improve customer or business outcomes.


Customer Experience and Executive Engagement

· Establishes customer experience standards across project initiation, planning, execution, escalation, communication, transition, and closure.

· Ensures project managers provide proactive, transparent, and outcome-oriented customer communication.

· Uses customer feedback, CSAT, escalation trends, closure reviews, and lessons learned to identify systemic improvement opportunities.

· Serves as executive sponsor or escalation leader for high-risk and strategically important engagements.

· Partners with sales and delivery leaders to restore customer confidence when execution, scope, resource, or communication issues place an engagement at risk.


Financial and Commercial Performance

· Owns PMO and RMO operating performance, budgets, workforce planning, productivity, and cost management.

· Establishes governance for project revenue, cost, budget consumption, estimate-to-complete, billing readiness, write-offs, change requests, and margin performance.

· Identifies financial risk early and lead corrective actions in partnership with Professional Services leaders, finance, sales, and delivery.

· Ensures scope changes and customer requests are evaluated promptly and converted into approved change orders when appropriate.

· Monitors third-party labor usage, subcontractor performance, purchase-order coverage, and the financial impact of external delivery resources.

  • undefined

· Provides executive portfolio reporting that supports fact-based decisions and timely intervention.

Resource Strategy and Workforce Leadership

· Develops the PMO and RMO workforce strategy, including role segmentation, capacity models, career paths, succession planning, hiring profiles, contractor use, and future skill requirements.

· Creates differentiated project leadership capabilities across project coordinators, project managers, senior project managers, and program managers.

· Ensures project management capability is matched to project rigor, financial exposure, technical complexity, and customer expectations.

· Partners with Professional Services leadership to improve scheduling accuracy, utilization, resource-calendar reliability, and delivery continuity.

· Establishes standards for subcontractor qualification, onboarding, performance, and replacement.

· Builds a culture of customer obsession, ownership, timely escalation, financial discipline, continuous improvement, and data-based decision-making.


Data, Platforms, Automation, and AI

· Improves the quality, consistency, and timeliness of project, financial, customer, capacity, and resource data.

· Develops and executes an automation and AI roadmap for PMO and RMO operations, including status reporting, meeting follow-up, risk detection, resource recommendations, scope-change identification, financial alerts, and project closure.

· Establishes appropriate human review, data governance, access controls, and accountability for AI-enabled processes.

· Measures adoption, productivity gains, decision quality, customer impact, and financial value from platform and automation investments.


Pre-Sales and Business Partnership

· Partners with sales, solution leaders, and delivery practices to qualify complex opportunities, validate delivery assumptions, assess risk, and strengthen project governance before contract execution.

· Provides project leadership input into statements of work, delivery plans, resource models, dependencies, acceptance criteria, governance, and change-control provisions.

· Supports integration, transition, and transformation initiatives that require structured cross-functional program leadership.

· Acts as the senior PMO and RMO advisor to Services and company leadership.

General

  • Demonstrates and actively promotes an understanding and commitment to the mission of Logicalis through performing behaviors consistent with the organization's values.
  • Maintains a working knowledge of applicable Federal, State, and Local laws and regulations as well as policies and procedures of Logicalis in order to ensure adherence in a manner that reflects honest, ethical and professional behaviors.
  • Supports and conducts self in a manner consistent with customer service expectations.

Supervisory Responsibilities

Directly supervises PMO Team Managers and Project Managers in Project Management Office. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.

Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education/Experience/Technical Requirements/Certifications

Equivalent combination accepted.

Education

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a related field.

Experience / Technical Requirements

· 12 or more years of progressively responsible experience in project, program, portfolio, professional services, or delivery operations.

· 7 or more years of leadership experience, including responsibility for managers and geographically distributed teams.

· Demonstrated experience leading a PMO, RMO, professional services operations function, or comparable delivery organization.

· Proven responsibility for project financial performance, resource capacity, delivery governance, customer escalations, and organizational improvement.

· Experience leading complex technology programs involving contractual, budgetary, resource, vendor, and customer-accountability requirements.

· Demonstrated success improving project predictability, customer experience, margin protection, operational scalability, and executive visibility.

· Working knowledge of professional services commercial models, including fixed-fee, time-and-materials, staff augmentation, consumption-based, and subcontracted delivery.

· Strong executive communication skills and experience working with senior customer and internal leadership.

Certifications

· Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent project/program management certification preferred.

· PMP, PMI-PMOCP, Agile, Lean Six Sigma, ITIL, or resource management certification beneficial.

Other Skills and Abilities

· Customer obsession and ownership mindset.

· Financial and commercial acumen.

· Portfolio-level judgment and executive decision support.

· Ability to translate strategy into scalable operating processes and measurable outcomes.

· Exceptional communication, influence, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills.

· Ability to lead organizational change and increase adoption of new processes, platforms, and ways of working.

· Strong analytical capability with a disciplined approach to metrics, data quality, forecasting, and continuous improvement.

· Ability to attract, develop, hold accountable, and retain high-performing talent.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is constantly required to sit, talk, see, hear, and use hands and arms. The employee is frequently required to stand; move about, climb steps or balance and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.

The above statements describe the general nature and level of work being performed by individuals assigned to this classification. This is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities and duties required of personnel so classified.

Logicalis is an Equal Opportunity Employer. It is our policy to employ people who are qualified by reason of education, training, experience, and demonstrated performance. We value inclusion and belonging at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity and gender expression, marital status, age, height, weight, disability, veteran status, or any other reason prohibited by applicable federal or state laws.

Why We Need You!

Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) is a growing team that partners closely with Product Engineering, Security, and Support. We are responsible for the reliability, deployment, and continuous operation of the Ivanti Cloud services. We need your help to take our existing platform to the next level with observability, release automation, chaos engineering, and more.

The SRE role is a blend of infrastructure, networking, operating systems, automation, development, and application administration. It is a hands-on technical position in a fast-paced atmosphere. The ideal candidate has prior experience managing cloud-based SaaS applications and strives to solve traditional operations problems through automation and software. More so, the candidate must possess a high standard of excellence, have a strong customer focus, and is capable of technical deep dives into code, app servers, databases, load balancers, operating systems, and networks.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Work Monday to Friday from 1:30 AM to 10:30 AM IST, including lunch)
  • Deploying, managing, and securing Ivanti’s production Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) environments in AWS and Azure
  • Working with geographically dispersed, cross-departmental teams to solve difficult problems
  • Automating common and repetitive tasks
  • Write documentation and training material

raw.title: Senior Engineer, Partner Integration
raw.excerpt: Why This Role Exists We operate a multi-tenant automotive SaaS platform serving thousands of dealer groups across the United States, running on a native AWS backend: Lambda, EventBridge, DynamoDB, S3, Step Functions.
raw.description:
Why This Role Exists

We operate a multi-tenant automotive SaaS platform serving thousands of dealer groups across the United States, running on a native AWS backend: Lambda, EventBridge, DynamoDB, S3, Step Functions.

That platform doesn't operate alone. It sits between dealer groups and the systems they already run: DMS platforms (CDK, Reynolds & Reynolds, Tekion, DealerTrack, Procede), CRMs, digital retail tools, F&I providers, and lenders. Over 40 partner platforms feed or consume our data today, and every one of them has its own auth model, its own schema, its own idea of what a "deal" is, and its own opinion about how much traffic you're allowed to send.

That integration surface is the product. If a dealer's data doesn't land clean and on time, nothing downstream works: not the desking tool, not the reporting, not the AI. This role owns that surface end to end. You are the engineer who reads the partner's spec, gets on the call with their team when the spec is wrong, builds the ingestion in Python on AWS, and keeps it healthy in production.

The engineering is only half of it. The other half is the partner's integration team: reading between the lines of their documentation, getting a straight answer about undocumented behavior, and pushing back on a bad contract before it becomes our problem. We want an engineer who does that work well and understands what dealer workflow the data serves, not one who moves JSON from A to B and calls it done.

Scope & Scale

  • Over 40 integrated partner platforms across DMS, CRM, Digital Retail, F&I, and lending, each with distinct auth, rate limits, and data models.
  • 5,000+ dealer tenants, each with isolated data and per-tenant partner configuration.
  • Tens of thousands of API requests daily across REST, SOAP, webhook, and file-based integration surfaces.
  • Partner outages, silent schema changes, and rate-limit shifts are routine, not exceptional. The integrations you own have to survive them without a human in the loop.

What You'll Own

  • End-to-end partner integrations. From spec review and sandbox access through production cutover. You write the Python, define the mapping, and own the result.
  • The partner-facing technical relationship. You're the engineer on the call with their integration team: clarifying undocumented behavior, negotiating payload changes, driving certification, and escalating when their sandbox is down.
  • Ingestion and normalization pipelines. Webhook receivers, polling clients, and file-based feeds landing into S3 and promoting through the medallion layers into the normalized model.
  • Resilience under someone else's SLA. Idempotency and deduplication, exponential backoff, rate-limit handling, replay of missed events, and graceful degradation when a partner goes dark.
  • Integration security. Webhook signature verification, OAuth2/JWT credential lifecycles, KMS encryption, and credential storage in SSM/Secrets Manager. No secrets in code, ever.
  • Contract testing and validation. JSON Schema validation at the boundary, contract tests against partner sandboxes, and CI gates that catch a partner's breaking change before a dealer does.
  • Observability and integration health. CloudWatch dashboards, alarms, and structured logging per partner, so a 2 AM failure is diagnosable without guessing.
  • Documentation that survives you. Mapping specs, runbooks, and onboarding guides per partner. The next engineer should not have to re-derive what you learned on a call.

First 90 Days / First Year

First 90 Days: Ramp on the partner catalog, the normalized data model, and the dealer workflows the data feeds, so you know what the fields are for. Ship your first partner-facing change to production in the first few weeks. By day 90, own one full partner integration end to end: client, mapping, validation, tests, dashboards, runbook.

First Year: Running independently across a portfolio of partners, and the primary technical contact for several of them. New partner onboarding is measurably faster and less bespoke because of the patterns and tooling you built.

Hands-On Expectations

This is a building role, and the balance shifts with the calendar. Between onboardings you're heads-down in code: clients, transformations, tests, instrumentation. During an active partner onboarding, expect several calls a week with their engineering team and real time spent in their documentation. Both modes are the job.

Tech & Tools

  • Integration core: Python (AWS Lambda Powertools), API Gateway, EventBridge, Step Functions, SQS; REST, SOAP/XML, webhook, and SFTP surfaces.
  • Cloud services (native AWS stack): Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, EventBridge, Step Functions, ECS Fargate, Aurora, API Gateway, CloudWatch, Secrets Manager, KMS, CDK.
  • Languages: Modern Python.
  • Data platform: S3 data lake with medallion layering (landing, bronze, silver, gold), DynamoDB single-table design, MySQL/Aurora.
  • Infrastructure and security: CDK, IAM, Auth0, OpenTelemetry, CircleCI.

How You'll Use AI

This is not a "we are AI-curious" company. We use Claude every day, and we expect you to as well. Concrete examples for this role:

  • Turning vendor API docs, WSDLs, and sample payloads into typed Python client skeletons and mapping code.
  • Using Claude Code to scaffold Lambda handlers, JSON Schemas, and unit tests from a partner spec.
  • Diffing a partner's new spec version against the old one to find the breaking change fast.
  • Drafting integration runbooks and mapping documentation from the code you just wrote.
  • Reasoning over production logs to isolate whether a failure is ours or theirs.

You will not be replaced by AI. You will be the engineer who onboards partners at a pace the rest of the industry can't match.

Role Specifics

  • Department: Engineering (Data Platform Engineering)
  • Reports To: Head of Data Platform
  • Location: Remote (US). Denver HQ nice to have.
  • Employment Type: Full-Time

Requirements

Must Have

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience with strong, current Python.
  • Judgment about scope: you start from what the integration is worth to the dealer, not from the most interesting way to build it, and you've shipped the boring version when the boring version was right.
  • Hands-on production experience integrating third-party APIs you don't control, including at least one integration you owned through spec, build, certification, and production support.
  • Comfort across integration styles, not just modern REST: SOAP/XML, webhooks, and file-based feeds are all in scope here.
  • Hands-on AWS experience (Lambda, S3, EventBridge, DynamoDB, Step Functions, Secrets Manager/SSM).
  • Real experience mapping and normalizing inconsistent external schemas into a canonical model, and the judgment to know when the partner's data is simply wrong.
  • Ability to debug distributed, event-driven systems from logs and traces and be able to put observability in place.
  • Willingness to be the person on the partner call. Direct, clear, and unbothered by pushing back on someone else's engineering team.

Strongly Preferred

  • Idempotency and deduplication patterns for at-least-once delivery (e.g., DynamoDB-backed dedup).
  • Webhook security: HMAC signature verification, mTLS, replay protection.
  • OAuth2 / JWT credential flows and rotation for machine-to-machine integrations.
  • JSON Schema or comparable contract validation at system boundaries.
  • Infrastructure as code (CDK) and CI/CD (CircleCI).

Nice to Have

  • Automotive retail, DMS/CRM, fintech, or multi-tenant marketplace platform experience.
  • Experience standing up a partner integration program from scratch (templates, scorecards, onboarding runbooks).

Benefits

We pride ourselves on cultivating a fun, casual, and collaborative workplace culture where your hard work is recognized, your contributions drive real results, and your impact is felt every day. At A2Z Sync, we're deeply committed to our employees' well-being, starting with comprehensive benefits designed to help you care for yourself and your family.

Here's what we offer:

  • Base Salary: $160,000 – $180,000, depending on experience and qualifications, plus an equity grant.
  • Employer-Paid Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance: Comprehensive coverage for you and your family starting on day one.
  • Flexible Work: Remote (US). Denver HQ nice to have.
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan with Company Match: Build your future with our competitive matching program.
  • Generous Paid Time Off (PTO): Unlimited PTO and 10 paid holidays.
  • Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Coverage: Fully employer-paid.
  • Life and AD&D Insurance: Employer-paid coverage for peace of mind.
  • Free Mental Health Support: Access to confidential therapy sessions through BetterHelp.
  • Pet Insurance Options: Affordable plans for your furry family members.
  • Identity Theft Protection: Voluntary services to safeguard your personal information.
  • Other Cool Stuff: On-site gym in Denver, great co-workers, and a stocked kitchen with snacks and beverages to keep you fueled.

Company Background/Overview

Founded in 2008, what started as a small business has grown into a diverse and innovative global team owned by Cook Inlet Region, Inc. an Alaska Native Regional Corporation. As a US Federal contractor, we are a dedicated IT Service Provider supporting the Departments of the Army, Navy, Air Force, DoD Educational Institutions, and large corporate entities. Our expertise is in Cloud Computing, Cyber Security, Compliance Management, Enterprise Architecture, IT Support, and CSfC. If you are passionate about making a difference and thrive in a dynamic and collaborative environment, we invite you to apply to join our team.

General Function

The Government Contractor Capture Manager is responsible for identifying, developing, and securing new business opportunities in the government sector. The Capture Manager works closely with business development, proposal, and executive teams to create winning strategies for capturing government contracts. The Capture Manager also fosters relationships with key government clients, industry partners, and subcontractors, ensuring alignment with the company's growth objectives.

Location: Remote (U.S.). Preference will be given to candidates residing in Maryland, Virginia, or the District of Columbia; however, qualified candidates from other locations will also be considered.

Major Activities (Typical Duties/Responsibilities)

  • Identifies and qualifies new government contract opportunities that align with the company's strategic objectives, capabilities, and resources.
  • Develops and implements comprehensive capture plans, including win strategies, teaming arrangements, and pricing models.
  • Builds and maintains strong relationships with government clients, industry partners, and subcontractors to support the pursuit of new business opportunities.
  • Collaborates with business development, proposal, and executive teams to develop and execute effective capture strategies.
  • Conducts market and competitive analysis to identify and assess potential business opportunities and areas for growth.
  • Develops and maintains a capture pipeline, tracking and reporting on the status of opportunities throughout the capture lifecycle.
  • Provides leadership and direction to cross-functional capture teams, ensuring alignment with company objectives and compliance with government regulations.
  • Participates in industry events, conferences, and other networking opportunities to stay current on market trends, competitor activities, and government procurement practices.
  • Facilitates proposal development, working closely with proposal managers, technical leads, and subject matter experts to create compelling, compliant, and winning proposals.
  • Continuously monitors and evaluates capture efforts, adjusting strategies and tactics as necessary to maximize the probability of winning new business.
  • Monitors key government portals, notices and postings on a daily basis to identify strategic and tactical fit opportunities for Go/No-Go consideration.
  • Evaluates industry competitors for strengths and weaknesses in order to maximize probability of win
  • Establishes and maintains relationships with prospective customers
  • Complies with all company policies and procedures
  • Personally responsible for properly marking and handling of all information and materials, in any form

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities

  • Ability to build relationships with the federal market and to translate company capabilities into growth opportunities and to visual strategic approaches to entering markets and building capabilities
  • Strong knowledge of government procurement processes, regulations, and contract vehicles
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively engage with clients, partners, and internal stakeholders
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess market conditions, competition, and customer needs
  • Proven ability to lead and manage cross-functional teams in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Approachable demeanor and strong motivation to go above and beyond
  • Capability to multitask and handle multiple projects / tasks with competing deadlines
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to follow oral and written instructions
  • Ability to make sound judgments and decisions in the best interest of the company
  • Ability to be resourceful and problem solve quickly, and at times work under pressure
  • The ability to work efficiently and effectively, while maintaining attention to detail
  • Self-motivated, goal-oriented, and able to work independently or as part of a team.

Physical Abilities

  • Sufficient fine motor skills for the use of computers, calculators with an ability to withstand repetitive keyboarding for extended periods of time.
  • Ability to work in confined rack spaces.
  • Visual and communications ability are adequate to perform the essential functions of the job.
  • Ability to kneel, bend and twist at the waist on an occasional basis.
  • Ability to reach below shoulder height with regular frequency (desk position) and at or above shoulder height on occasion.
  • Ability to push, pull, carry and lift objects weighing up to 10 pounds on a regular basis, and greater weights on an occasional basis.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, IT, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
  • A minimum of 5 years of experience in government contracting, with a focus on capture management, business development, or proposal management.
  • Demonstrated success in capturing and winning government contracts across multiple agencies and contract vehicles.
  • Experience with building relationships within the federal market.
  • Overnight to travel as needed to support capture efforts and attend industry events.op talent.

Preferred Requirements

  • Possess an active Secret security clearance or the ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance may be required, depending on the nature of the contracts pursued

Key elements of our package include a competitive base pay and a comprehensive benefits package:

We offer eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefits offerings. Here are just some of our benefits for our US based positions.

  • Medical/ Dental/ Vision
  • Life insurance and AD&D
  • Flexible Spending
  • Accident, Critical Illness and Hospital Indemnity coverage
  • 401(k) and ROTH retirement options and company match
  • Pet Insurance
  • Identity Theft and Fraud Protection coverage

Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled

Regional Vice President, Biddable

Location: Remote, United States

About Doximity

Doximity is the leading clinical AI company with the largest network of U.S. clinicians. Doximity’s AI-powered workflow platform is trusted by over 85% of U.S. physicians and 300+ health systems. Doximity's mission is to help clinicians be more productive so they can provide better care for their patients.

At Doximity, we value curiosity, ownership, inclusion, and a commitment to making a meaningful impact. If you're excited about solving complex problems that improve healthcare, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

Our Pharma sales team is a variety of individuals with diverse backgrounds, all committed to our goal of helping our clients bring their important messaging to the healthcare professionals on our platform. We are launching a biddable platform in January, 2027 and will have a new go-to-market team to work closely with our sales teams and clients. We look for individuals who face challenges head on and are highly motivated to exceed sales goals. Presentation, communication, and closing skills are essential to be successful in this role.

As a Regional Vice President:

  • Develop expertise and sell biddable ad products
  • Support our clients by developing strategies that help brand product teams and marketing agencies make informed decisions through a consultative sales approach
  • Make data informed decisions through forecasting and business analytical skills to identify opportunities and reach goals
  • Build relationships and trust with agency and brand decision-makers
  • Develop and lead proposals and opportunities for client sales pitches
  • Collaborate with teams to ensure performance metric goals are achieved or exceeded

Location: This role isRemote, in the United States and will require travel to client meetings.

What We're Looking For

We're excited to meet candidates who have many of the following qualifications:

  • Programmatic and HCP healthcare sales experience (required). You have sold programmatic or biddable media to pharma brands and health agencies, and you know how HCP audiences are targeted and measured.
  • Auction-savvy. You can explain bids, budgets, pacing, and cost per engagement to a brand team, and you can coach a client from fixed guarantees toward performance-based buying.
  • Platform seller. You have sold a self-serve or managed-service ad platform (DSP, search, or retail media) and you know how to drive adoption, not just close an insertion order.
  • Embedded in the planning cycle. You have senior relationships with pharma manufacturers and health agencies, and you win early, when budgets are set, not just when RFPs go out.
  • Data literacy. Functional understanding of business analytics to maximize opportunities and prioritize goals.
  • Launch builder. You're energized by taking a new product to market, and you turn client feedback into input for pricing, packaging, and the product roadmap.
  • Goal-motivated. You thrive in a team that embraces accountability through individual sales quotas.

Compensation

The anticipated total compensation for this role is $192,500 - $313,833, depending on factors such as experience, skills, location, and internal equity.

Our total compensation package may include:

  • Base salary
  • Equity (where applicable)
  • Annual bonus or incentive compensation (where applicable)

Specific compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

Benefits

In addition to competitive compensation, Doximity offers a comprehensive benefits package for full time employees. Some of our offerings include:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Flexible paid time off and company holidays
  • Paid parental leave
  • Professional development and learning opportunities
  • Wellness and mental health resources
  • Remote work support and home office stipend (where applicable)

Why You'll Love Working Here

At Doximity, you'll join a mission-driven company where your work has a meaningful impact on healthcare. We believe great ideas come from empowered teams, and we're committed to creating an environment where people can do their best work.

  • Make a real impact. Help build products that support over a million healthcare professionals and ultimately improve patient care.
  • Work with exceptional teammates. Collaborate with thoughtful, talented colleagues who value curiosity, humility, and continuous learning.
  • Enjoy flexibility and trust. We support flexible ways of working and empower employees with the autonomy to own their work.
  • Grow your career. Take on meaningful challenges, develop new skills, and shape your career through mentorship and professional development.
  • Bring your authentic self. We're committed to fostering an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives are welcomed, respected, and celebrated.

Our Hiring Process & AI Tools

Doximity may use artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled tools throughout the hiring process to help improve the candidate experience and support our recruiting team. These tools may assist with administrative tasks such as scheduling, general communication, interview coordination, note-taking, or summarizing interview feedback. Human recruiters and hiring managers make all hiring decisions. We are committed to using AI responsibly, transparently, and in accordance with applicable laws.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Doximity is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know so we can support your participation.

  • Impartirás clases dinámicas y entretenidas de Minecraft basadas en los programas y materiales que proporcionamos.

Este es un puesto remoto: necesitarás tu propio portátil, una conexión estable a Internet y un ambiente tranquilo para trabajar.

Después de la entrevista, se te pedirá que completes una prueba adicional.

Job Description:

As an IT Asset Management Tool SME supporting the Hosting Operations & Maintenance (HOM) program for the Financial Management Services Group of the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS), you will support the administration, operation, optimization, and continuous improvement of the program's IT Asset Management (ITAM) capabilities for data center hardware and software assets. This position will be part of the IT Asset Management team and work under the leadership of the IT Asset Management Lead, with technical guidance from the ITAM Tool SME Tech Lead.

In this role, a typical day amongst the ITAM Tool SMEs (2) will include:

  • Administer and operate the IT Asset Management platform (Eracent) to discover, inventory, track, and manage hardware and software assets across the program's data center environment.
  • Perform platform administration, configuration, troubleshooting, and maintenance activities, including user administration, configuration management, data integrations, discovery processes, and system functionality.
  • Troubleshoot complex technical issues involving asset discovery, data integrity, system integrations, reporting, and platform functionality; identify root causes and implement corrective actions.
  • Progressively assume responsibility for designated IT Asset Management platform administration, maintenance, reporting, and operational activities, developing the capability to independently perform critical functions and provide technical backup to the ITAM Tool SME Tech Lead.
  • Analyze hardware and software inventory data using SQL, Excel, and platform reporting capabilities to identify discrepancies, trends, compliance issues, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Maintain accurate inventory and update asset assignments throughout asset management lifecycle.
  • Monitor, report and analyze software and hardware inventory, evaluate for entitlement compliance, N-1, End of Support/Life, upcoming renewals (in collaboration with Procurement SME) and ad-hoc reports or data calls. This includes tasking and follow-up on related action items.
  • Identify and implement opportunities to automate asset discovery, data collection, validation, reconciliation, reporting, and other ITAM processes, including integration with other enterprise systems.
  • Investigate missing assets and work to account for them within the asset management tool.
  • Collaborate with Procurement, Hosting, Infrastructure, Security, DBA, Operations and Technical teams and SME’s to implement asset management practices, processes and procedures.
  • Validate asset management tool upgrades to ensure no impact to existing features.
  • Create and maintain all technical and process documentation related to Asset Management.
  • Present asset information to the client, such as the status of an asset, the renewal period, entitlement compliance status, where the asset is physically located, and maintenance agreement information.
  • Work with the asset management tool vendor and HOM teams to analyze and apply tool patches, lead validation steps, and propagation through the various environments through to production.
  • Mentor and coach other asset management team members in technical areas.
  • Support the evolution of IT Asset Management capabilities to accommodate cloud infrastructure, cloud asset visibility, resource utilization, and FinOps-related cost management.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Information Systems, Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or an equivalent combination of education, technical certifications, training, and work experience.
  • 5+ years of experience administering, configuring, supporting, maintaining, or troubleshooting complex enterprise applications, management platforms, or systems management tools.
  • Knowledge of SQL, with the ability to write, execute, and interpret moderately complex queries to retrieve, analyze, and validate data.
  • Strong data analysis skills, including proficiency with Microsoft Excel (PivotTables, data manipulation, and analysis) or equivalent tools.
  • Working technical knowledge, not necessarily hands-on experience, of data center infrastructure, including servers, network devices, operating systems (Linux/Windows), databases, firmware, patches, firewalls, and virtual environments.
  • Ability to independently investigate technical issues, analyze complex data, identify root causes, and implement solutions, with appropriate escalation when necessary.
  • Ability to understand complex technical environments, system integrations, data flows, and automated discovery processes.
  • Experience working with technical teams and vendors to investigate issues, resolve problems, and implement technical solutions.
  • Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail, with the ability to manage large volumes of technical data and maintain accurate records.
  • Demonstrated ability to learn complex enterprise applications and technical platforms, with an interest in developing expertise in IT Asset Management and the Eracent platform.
  • A continuous improvement mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities for process optimization, automation, and reducing manual effort.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • IT Asset Management Experience
    • Experience with Eracent Asset Management tools or equivalent ITAM platforms.
    • Experience administering, configuring, optimizing, or maintaining an enterprise ITAM platform.
    • Experience with hardware and software asset management, software entitlement management, and asset lifecycle management.
    • 3+ years of direct IT Asset Management experience.
  • Technical and Data Management Experience
    • Experience with IT asset discovery, inventory reconciliation, data integrations, and automated reporting.
    • Experience with complex software licensing models, particularly Oracle and IBM.

raw.description:
About QBench
QBench is the modern operating system for the regulated lab. For years, the Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) category meant rigid tools and heavy custom code, so we built one that adapts to how each lab already works. Our customers do everything from detecting food pathogens to inventing new materials to developing life-saving medicines. Labs love it, and they depend on it. That is why we have been the #1 LIMS on G2 for two years running, and why we keep growing fast.

We are expanding from the system of record labs run on today to an AI-driven system of action and intelligence. As we scale, we’ll build network effects that make QBench far more than workflow software: operating benchmarks by industry, an inventory marketplace, and proprietary insights from our data.


The Opportunity
We are hiring our first VP of Product, a critical addition to our team. The mission is to own product strategy and outcomes as we scale to become the mid-market LIMS category leader by the end of 2028, and to build the product and design team that gets us there.

Here is what makes this seat different. The foundation is already strong. The product consistently wins, our move upmarket is lifting ACVs, and our GRR and NRR are best-in-class. We have just finished building our "AI Software Factory," which has dramatically increased the pace at which we can ship. Execution is no longer the bottleneck. Judgment is. What we need most is a leader with the taste and strategic clarity to aim all that speed at the things that matter.

You step into real product-market fit and a company that already knows how to grow (forecasted to end 2026 at 75% YoY ARR growth). Few product leaders inherit a product this differentiated, a culture this good, and this much room to define the category.

You will partner closely with our CTO, CRO, and CCO, and you will coach an existing product team that includes a strong Lead PM on a steep growth path. This is a builder's role, not a caretaker's. At our stage, the best product leaders set strategy and still get their hands dirty.


What You'll Own
Product strategy and judgment. Decide what gets built and what doesn't. Find the right problem before anyone writes code. Make the call before the data is conclusive, and own the outcome. Set a quality bar that makes taste a team asset. Run every major bet against value, usability, feasibility, and viability, with honest pivot, persist, or perish reviews.

AI product leadership. Set the strategy for how AI shows up in the product. Decide where AI creates real customer value and where it just adds complexity and risk. In a regulated lab environment, that means clear guardrails, sensible confidence thresholds, and a strong instinct for when AI should suggest and a human should confirm. You work AI-natively, and you bring the judgment the tools can't.

Team building. Hire, ramp, and develop PMs and designers. Bring a real network and a repeatable way of finding great people. Coach the team to the next level, including the Lead PM. Build the org we'll need at $25M, starting now.


Who You Are
We care more about how you think than about which logos are on your resume. Specifically:
  • Judgment and taste. You know how to discover what to build and, just as important, what not to. As AI makes execution cheap, this is the skill that matters most.
  • A builder and a leader. You can go deep on a hard problem and also get a team excited to run at it.
  • AI-native. AI is genuinely part of how you work, and you have a point of view on where it belongs in the product development process, as well as experience building AI products that have meaningful impact on customers.
  • A fast learner. You can get to real depth in an unfamiliar domain quickly, and you enjoy it. If you have not worked in lab or scientific software, that is fine. If you are not excited to become an expert in it, this is not the role for you.
  • Commercially sharp. You are comfortable in front of customers, in pricing conversations, and with the numbers that show whether the product is working.
  • High EQ, high agency. You bring people together and move things forward without steamrolling them.

Experience
  • Led product at a B2B SaaS company, ideally a vertical SaaS company through a scaling phase
  • Shipped real AI-powered features and can speak honestly about what worked, what you killed, and how you measured it
  • Built and developed a product team and grew the people who reported to you
  • Comfortable with regulated or complex domains (compliance, validation, a split between buyer and user) is a strong plus
  • Lab, LIMS, or scientific software experience is a bonus, not a requirement

Why This Role
You get real ownership at a company with product-market fit and room to run. You get a team already using AI to drive real outcomes for customers, building a product that pushes science forward. You will report to a CEO with a product background who wants a true product partner and will give you room to lead.

Please apply here, or selected job board, and get you in front of our team's eyes. If you have any issues, or concerns feel free to contact our HR Manager at .

Our client is a performance marketing agency that runs paid media, creative and web work for colleges, universities, K-12 schools and nonprofits. Partners hire them as their agency of record and tend to stay for years, so the websites you design keep evolving long after launch.

The agency was founded in 2020 and works fully remote, with a team across the US and Latin America.

Your Role

As UX & Experience Systems Designer, you'll lead the design systems behind client websites, landing pages and digital products, and connect information architecture, UX, visual design and front-end development into one delivery process.

You'll report to the VP of Web Services and work closely with front-end developers, information architects, and the strategy, SEO and CRO teams. The job goes well beyond wireframes and high-fidelity screens. You'll set up reusable patterns, stay involved through development and QA, and help the team bring AI-assisted workflows into how it designs and builds.

Success means experiences that work well for the people using them and are practical for developers to build and maintain.

You'll:

  • Build and govern the design system: components, design tokens, responsive patterns and accessibility standards
  • Agree on component architecture and behavior with front-end developers before detailed design starts
  • Deliver implementation-ready specs and interactive prototypes that make handoffs clear
  • Review built pages in QA for usability, accessibility and fidelity to the design
  • Design wireframes, prototypes and high-fidelity layouts for client sites and landing pages
  • Shape navigation, page hierarchy and conversion paths with IA, strategy and SEO
  • Run usability tests and use analytics and A/B results to recommend improvements
  • Try AI-assisted design and prototyping tools, and set rules for checking their output

You Bring:

  • A portfolio showing UX/UI work, design systems and reusable components
  • Experience as a UX, Product, Design Systems or Experience Designer in an agency or digital team
  • Hands-on experience creating or maintaining a component library
  • Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, responsive front-end and component-based architecture
  • Strong Figma skills (or an equivalent tool) and openness to AI-assisted workflows
  • Solid grounding in information architecture, usability and WCAG accessibility
  • Clear written and spoken English for explaining design decisions to developers and clients

Bonus Points:

  • Websites for higher education, schools or nonprofits
  • Experience designing within CMS constraints
  • CRO work or A/B tests you helped design and read out
  • Code-aware prototyping or functional prototypes

This role suits a designer who thinks in components and enjoys working through implementation details with developers. If you mostly want to design one-off pages and hand them off, it's probably not the right fit.

  • Flexible hours within US time zones, with overlap required for meetings

  • 20 paid days off per year, covering holidays, sick days and regular time off
  • A direct line to the VP of Web Services
  • A real say in how the agency's design and development teams work together

raw.description:
About the Team

DoorDash is seeking a Manager, Technical Revenue Accounting to support complex revenue arrangements, new product offerings, and accounting policy alignment across its businesses.

This is an individual contributor role with responsibility for leading technical revenue accounting assessments for assigned business lines, products, and transactions. You will partner with Business Development, Product, Sales, Legal, Finance, and operational accounting teams to evaluate proposed contract terms and product offerings, explain their accounting and financial statement implications, and help stakeholders assess alternatives.

About the Role

You will apply US GAAP, particularly ASC 606, to complex transactions; document clear, well-supported accounting conclusions; and translate those conclusions into practical implementation requirements. This role offers exposure to a broad range of revenue streams and business initiatives and requires strong technical judgment, independent project ownership, and effective communication with business partners, accounting leadership, and external auditors.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead technical revenue accounting assessments. Research and evaluate complex or non-standard arrangements under ASC 606 and other applicable US GAAP, including merchant incentives and rebates, revenue guarantees, material rights, promotional programs, contract modifications, and principal versus agent considerations.
  • Advise on commercial arrangements and new products. Review proposed contracts, deal structures, and product offerings early in their development. Clearly explain accounting implications and evaluate alternatives to support informed business decisions.
  • Document accounting conclusions. Prepare technical accounting memos and position papers that clearly explain relevant facts, applicable guidance, significant judgments, and conclusions.
  • Support acquisition integration. Assess accounting policies and practices at acquired businesses, identify differences, and support alignment with DoorDash’s accounting policies.
  • Support operational implementation. Translate accounting conclusions into requirements for billing, revenue recognition, financial reporting, and controls, partnering with operational accounting teams to support accurate execution.
  • Strengthen policies, processes, and controls. Develop and maintain revenue accounting policies, guidance, and training materials, and identify opportunities to improve contract review processes and related controls.
  • Support audits and financial reporting. Work with accounting leadership and external auditors to address technical accounting questions, explain significant judgments, and support quarterly and annual reporting as needed.
  • Manage projects independently. Balance competing priorities, communicate review requirements and timelines, and escalate significant accounting issues or unresolved judgments promptly.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or a related field.
  • Six or more years of relevant accounting experience, including substantial experience applying ASC 606 to complex revenue arrangements.
  • Strong knowledge of US GAAP and demonstrated ability to research unfamiliar accounting issues, exercise sound judgment, and develop well-supported conclusions.
  • Experience reviewing commercial contracts and identifying the accounting implications of non-standard terms.
  • Demonstrated ability to prepare clear, persuasive technical accounting memos and position papers.
  • Experience supporting external audits and discussing technical accounting matters with auditors.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex accounting matters to non-accounting stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects, and collaborate effectively across functions in a fast-paced environment.
  • Relevant experience in public accounting, industry technical accounting, or a combination of both

Preferred Qualifications

  • CPA, ACA, ACCA, or equivalent professional accounting qualification.
  • Big 4 public accounting experience.
  • Experience with technology, marketplace, e-commerce, SaaS, or platform-based businesses.
  • Experience supporting post-acquisition integration and accounting policy alignment.
  • Familiarity with SOX requirements, internal controls over financial reporting, and accounting process design.
  • Experience translating technical accounting conclusions into operational processes and system requirements.

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Job Purpose

Support and coordinate day-to-day labeling, artwork, translation, and packaging activities across multiple markets, ensuring that deliverables are accurately prepared, reviewed, tracked, and completed within agreed timelines. Provide operational support to the Senior Regulatory Labeling & Artwork Consultant and relevant cross-functional teams.

  • Labeling Operations: Coordinate day-to-day labeling activities, including updates to prescribing information, patient information leaflets, and packaging components, following established regulatory strategies and processes.

  • Artwork and Submissions: Prepare, coordinate, and track artwork files, packaging materials, and mock-ups required for regulatory submissions and local market implementation.

  • Label Change Tracking: Maintain trackers for labeling changes, country submission status, implementation timelines, and outstanding actions to ensure activities remain on schedule.

  • Translation Coordination: Manage translation requests by sending source texts to vendors, collecting translated materials, coordinating proofreading and review cycles, and maintaining accurate document versions.

  • Process Support: Help maintain labeling templates, trackers, standard documentation, and operational processes to support consistency and efficiency across markets.

Experience and Qualifications

  • Approximately 1–4 years of experience in regulatory labeling, artwork coordination, regulatory operations, or a related pharmaceutical or medical device role.

  • Working knowledge of EU labeling requirements and artwork review processes.

  • Familiarity with artwork management systems such as FOCUS and GLAMS; knowledge of Veeva RIM is an advantage.

  • Experience coordinating translations, proofreading activities, and external vendors.

  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple activities and deadlines across different countries.

  • Good communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with internal teams and external partners.
