WHAT WE DO

Founded in 2007, Growth Acceleration Partners (GAP) is a consulting and technology services company. We consult, design, build and modernize revenue-generating software and data engineering solutions for clients. With modernization services and AI tools, we help businesses achieve a competitive advantage through technology. GAP’s remote, integrated engineering teams use end-to-end solutions to innovate and align with your business goals. We have 600+ English-speaking engineers based in Latin America and approximately 20 U.S.-based engineers. With some of the highest customer satisfaction scores in the industry, GAP’s focus is customer and employee success.

GAP is a woman-owned company headquartered in Austin Texas. We are a values-based company focused on growing our people by investing in education, onsite English classes and training in the latest technologies, including AI, data analytics and machine learning. Our goal is to provide solutions for our customers that help them achieve critical business outcomes, while enabling our GAPSters and our communities to attain long-term success.

Summary
We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to design, build and run our lakehouse platform on Databricks. You will bring in data from a wide range of source systems, model it through bronze, silver and gold layers, govern it in Unity Catalog, and make it available for reporting, analytics and operational applications. You will own data domains end to end: onboarding a new source, agreeing business mappings with data owners, automating deployment, and supporting it in production. You will also test new technologies through proofs of concept and turn what you learn into platform standards. You have several years of hands-on experience and solve problems on your own. You communicate clearly with business stakeholders and other technology teams, mentor other engineers, make key technical decisions, and help set the platform’s direction.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain data domains as Databricks bundles: ingestion jobs, SQL Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines (streaming tables and materialized views), Unity Catalog views and orchestration jobs.

  • Ingest data from SaaS, database, file and API sources using Auto Loader, Lakehouse Federation and Python-based extraction.

  • Model curated datasets with deduplication, change history (SCD), reconciliation checks and business rules agreed with data owners.

  • Implement governance in Unity Catalog: schema and permission design, row-level security, column masking, external locations and data classification.

  • Serve data through BI tools, Databricks dashboards, metric views and Genie, and Lakebase (managed PostgreSQL) for low-latency applications.

  • Maintain CI/CD with GitHub Actions: pull request validation, OIDC authentication and approval-gated promotion across environments. Manage cloud infrastructure as code.

  • Lead proofs of concept for new platform features and tools. Measure cost, performance and limitations, document the results, and recommend whether to adopt.

  • Modernize legacy pipelines and move them onto the lakehouse platform.

  • Write and maintain documentation, including source-to-target mappings, lineage and runbooks, for engineers, QA and business readers.

  • Monitor job and pipeline health, find the root cause of data issues, and manage compute cost.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.

Professional Experience

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data engineering or related data technologies.

  • Hands-on experience delivering production pipelines on Databricks or another Spark-based lakehouse platform.

Required Skills

  • Expertise in Databricks: Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Lakeflow Jobs and Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines (formerly Delta Live Tables).

  • Advanced SQL (Databricks SQL / Spark SQL), including window functions, incremental processing and query tuning.

  • Proficiency in Python and PySpark.

  • Experience with Databricks bundles (DABs) or similar declarative deployment tooling.

  • Knowledge of data modeling: medallion architecture and dimensional modeling (star/snowflake schema).

  • Solid understanding of data fundamentals: transformation, exploratory analysis, data cleaning and regulatory compliance.

  • Data quality and testing practices: pipeline expectations, reconciliation queries and validation across environments.

  • Data security and governance: Unity Catalog permissions, row filters and column masks, service principals, OAuth/OIDC, private networking, and handling confidential and personal data.

  • Experience with at least one major cloud provider (Azure, AWS or GCP).

  • Infrastructure as code (Terraform or Bicep).

  • Version control with Git and GitHub (branching, pull requests, code review).

  • CI/CD with GitHub Actions, including environment promotion and approval gates.

  • Working knowledge of Scrum or Kanban.

Preferred Skills

  • Microsoft Azure, including Microsoft Entra ID, Azure storage and networking.

  • Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory or Azure Synapse Analytics.

  • Power BI (semantic models, DAX).

  • PostgreSQL or Lakebase.

  • AI-assisted development, such as coding agents and LLM functions in SQL.

  • Databricks Data Engineer certification (Associate or Professional).

Soft Skills

  • Advanced proficiency in English, written and spoken.

  • Eagerness to learn new technologies in a fast-changing platform and AI tooling landscape.

  • Excellent communication skills, including explaining technical topics to non-technical stakeholders and writing clear documentation.

  • Strong time management across several workstreams in parallel.

  • Effective mentoring and negotiation skills, including coordinating changes with other teams.

  • Strong technical support skills: investigating production issues and finding root causes.

  • Ownership: carries a change through testing, QA sign-off and production release under change management.

Grâce à notre modèle en marque blanche, nos partenaires commercialisent les services fournis par Sewan sous leur propre marque. Ils restent l’interlocuteur unique de leurs clients, les facturent directement et développent des revenus récurrents.

Vos missions

Vous encadrez une équipe de Responsables Ventes Indirectes et pilotez l’activité commerciale de la région Nord-Ouest.

  • Manager l’équipe régionale en accompagnant les Responsables Ventes Indirectes au quotidien, en suivant leurs objectifs et en assurant le reporting commercial.
  • Piloter la relation commerciale avec les partenaires et les prospects de votre périmètre et accompagner le développement de leur activité avec Sewan.
  • Élargir le réseau de vente indirecte en identifiant et en recrutant de nouveaux partenaires dans le Nord-Ouest.
  • Détecter de nouvelles opportunités commerciales en vous appuyant sur un réseau de courtiers et d’intermédiaires.
  • Contribuer au suivi des impayés et au recouvrement en lien avec les partenaires concernés et les équipes internes.
  • Vous avez une expérience en management commercial et en développement d’un réseau de partenaires B2B. Vous savez fixer des priorités, suivre les résultats de votre équipe et accompagner vos collaborateurs sur le terrain.
  • À l’aise dans la négociation, vous savez construire des relations commerciales durables avec des interlocuteurs variés.
  • Une connaissance de l’écosystème IT ou télécoms et des modèles de vente indirecte est un atout pour ce poste.
  • Localisation et déplacements
  • Le poste est en télétravail intégral et couvre le périmètre commercial Nord-Ouest.
  • Des déplacements sont à prévoir dans la région pour rencontrer l’équipe et les partenaires, ainsi qu’à Paris environ une fois par mois, selon le calendrier des réunions et des événements.

Pourquoi Sewan ?

  • Le Bien-être au cœur de nos préoccupations

Depuis plus de 5 ans, Sewan est labélisée Happy At Work! En 2022, nous avons obtenu la note de 4,4/5 de la part de nos équipes en France et à l’international et un taux de recommandation de 89,2%.

Chaque jour, nous travaillons pour que les Sewaners se sentent bien.

Notre index égalité Femmes/ hommes est de 86/100.

  • Une politique RSE forte : Médaille d'argent "Ecovadis" pour notre performance RSE

A titre d'exemples, chez Sewan nous développons le Mécénat de compétences. 1 journée par an est offerte à chaque collaborateur pour contribuer à relever les grands défis sociaux et environnementaux.

Nous mettons en place les trophées RSE pour que nos Sewaners soient acteurs de notre politique RSE !

  • Une participation aux bénéfices

Qui accompagne la belle croissance de Sewan depuis plusieurs années.

  • Du Télétravail

2 jours de télétravail encadrés par une Charte

  • Un salaire mais bien plus !

9 à 12 RTT par an, Mutuelle prise à charge à 75%, Tickets Restaurant d'une valeur de 11€ (pris en charge à 50% par Sewan), forfait mobilité durable à hauteur de 500€/ an, Chèques cadeaux de +150€, Compte Epargne Temps à disposition, crèches d'entreprise … et bien plus :)

  • La mobilité interne

Chaque année, ce sont 30% de salariés qui évoluent en interne. L'évolution de carrière fait partie de la philosophie de Sewan.

Un accord et une charte mobilité accompagnent l'expérience des salariés tout au long de leur vie chez Sewan.

  • L'esprit Sewan

Chez Sewan, nous nous engageons à garantir des processus de recrutement inclusifs et à plaider pour l’embauche et la promotion de chaque candidat de manière éthique et équitable.
Nous interdisons strictement toute discrimination à l'encontre de tout candidat à un emploi en raison de son identité ou expression de genre, de son orientation sexuelle, de ses origines socio-économiques et/ou multiculturelles, de son état de santé, de son âge, de sa religion ou de toute autre caractéristique protégée par la loi.
Nous sommes fiers de garantir l'égalité des chances pour tous nos candidats.

Nos engagements pour l'inclusion

• Sensibilisation des équipes Sewan à travers des conférences et des formations thématiques.
• Individualisation du processus d’intégration et suivi rapproché par la Mission Handicap interne.
• Une écoute confidentielle et un accompagnement personnalisé :

Chez Sewan, nous mettons un point d’honneur à accompagner chaque collaborateur dans son parcours professionnel, notamment les personnes en situation de handicap.
Notre référente handicap est à votre disposition pour répondre à toutes vos questions en toute confidentialité. Son rôle : garantir un accompagnement adapté à vos besoins, faciliter votre intégration au sein de nos équipes et assurer le respect de nos engagements en faveur de l’inclusion.

Engagement en faveur du handicap

Chez Sewan, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité est une richesse et nous nous engageons à favoriser l’inclusion des personnes en situation de handicap. Si vous bénéficiez de la Reconnaissance de la Qualité de Travailleur Handicapé (RQTH) et que vous avez besoin d’aménagements spécifiques dans le cadre de votre processus de recrutement, n’hésitez pas à nous contacter à l’adresse suivante avant de démarrer le processus de recrutement : .

Encouragements à candidater

Sewan souhaite donner sa chance à des personnes de tous horizons. Nous avons conscience que tout le monde ne répondra pas à l’intégralité des qualifications attendues dès le premier jour, et c'est normal. Si vous êtes attiré par le secteur de la tech et des télécommunications et que vous souhaitez développer vos compétences, nous vous encourageons vivement à postuler.

Processus de recrutement

Nous souhaitons que votre expérience de recrutement chez Sewan soit fluide et agréable. Voici les étapes clés du processus :

  1. Préqualification téléphonique.
  2. Deux entretiens d'embauche : un avec l'équipe recrutement et un avec votre futur manager.
  3. Un test technique (uniquement pour certains postes techniques).
  4. Un retour téléphonique systématique.

Référence interne C2

Créée en 2007, Sewan est née du constat que la transition numérique des entreprises reste encore trop complexe. Avec l’ambition de simplifier les communications des entreprises, Sewan s’est développée autour d’un modèle économique innovant en marque blanche et d’une plateforme SaaS devenue le cœur de son ADN : Sophia.

Sophia est une solution entièrement automatisée, accessible via une interface intuitive. Elle permet à nos partenaires et clients de commander, configurer et déployer facilement un large catalogue de services cloud et télécom destinés aux utilisateurs : téléphonie hébergée, centres d'appels, téléphonie mobile, lien d'accès, hébergement cloud et cybersécurité.

Aujourd’hui, plus de 1 M d'utilisateurs en entreprise font confiance aux solutions et à l'expertise de Sewan. L’entreprise s’appuie sur un réseau solide de 1 350 partenaires distributeurs et accompagne 165 000 clients professionnels.

Avec trois acquisitions en Espagne, Belgique et récemment aux Pays-Bas, Sewan poursuit son expansion européenne. Elle a réalisé en 2019 une levée de fonds record de 75 M€ et atteint un chiffre d’affaires de 190 M€ en 2025.

raw.description:
Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.

Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.


PTC is seeking a Senior Director of Global Partner Programs & Strategy to help define and execute the next phase of our global partner ecosystem. This leader will shape how PTC engages, enables, and scales its partner network to accelerate growth, expand market reach, and deliver differentiated customer outcomes.

Reporting to the Chief Partner Officer, this role sits at the center of PTC’s go-to-market evolution. The leader will help set the strategic direction for PTC’s work with Global Strategic Integrators (GSIs), regional partners, and emerging ecosystem players—and then translate that strategy into scalable programs, operating models, and measurable field execution.

Success requires someone equally comfortable developing strategy and driving implementation. This leader must be able to assess the ecosystem, make clear strategic choices, align senior stakeholders, build the supporting programs, and ensure those programs produce results across regions.

Key Responsibilities

Partner Strategy

  • Help define and execute a comprehensive global partner strategy aligned with PTC’s growth priorities and go-to-market model.
  • Assess the current partner ecosystem and identify where PTC should invest, expand, rationalize, or deepen strategic relationships.
  • Develop strategic frameworks for partner segmentation, coverage, engagement, investment, and value creation.
  • Translate market trends, customer needs, and PTC’s business priorities into actionable partner opportunities.
  • Build alignment across Sales, Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and regional leadership around a unified partner strategy.

Program Design and Execution

  • Translate partner strategy into scalable programs that drive pipeline, revenue, market expansion, and customer outcomes.
  • Design and evolve partner engagement models, incentives, enablement programs, and joint go-to-market motions.
  • Lead programs from initial strategy and business case through design, launch, adoption, and optimization.
  • Establish clear objectives, ownership, milestones, governance, and accountability.
  • Ensure strategic priorities translate into consistent execution—not presentations, disconnected initiatives, or programs that fail to gain field adoption.

GTM Integration and Growth

  • Partner with Sales leadership to embed partners into core go-to-market and account strategies.
  • Enable joint account planning, pipeline development, solution creation, and execution with priority partners.
  • Identify opportunities for partners to support new market entry, regional expansion, and growth within strategic accounts.
  • Create feedback loops between global strategy, regional execution, partner performance, and customer outcomes.
  • Use field insights to continuously refine partner strategy and investment decisions.

Global-to-Regional Execution

  • Ensure global partner strategy and programs translate into measurable regional impact.
  • Partner with regional leadership to adapt programs to market needs while maintaining global strategic alignment.
  • Define the operating model between global partner leadership, regional teams, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Drive adoption by giving regional teams and partners the tools, enablement, and support required to execute.
  • Identify and resolve gaps between strategic intent and field execution.

Operational Excellence and Scale

  • Establish metrics, governance, operating rhythms, and performance reviews that connect partner activity to business outcomes.
  • Use AI and advanced analytics to strengthen ecosystem planning, partner targeting, investment decisions, and performance visibility.
  • Embed automation and intelligent workflows to reduce manual effort, improve execution speed, and increase organizational capacity.
  • Evaluate program and partner performance using data and regional feedback, making clear recommendations about where to invest, adjust, or stop.
  • Drive cross-functional decisions and remove obstacles that limit execution.

Experience and Skills

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in partner strategy, alliances, partner programs, business development, or go-to-market roles within enterprise software.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop partner strategy and translate it into programs that deliver measurable business results.
  • Experience assessing complex partner ecosystems and making strategic decisions about segmentation, investment, coverage, and engagement.
  • Experience working with GSIs, regional partners, and other strategic ecosystem participants.
  • Strong strategic thinking combined with the operational discipline to lead implementation and execution.
  • Ability to influence senior executives and create alignment across Sales, Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and regional organizations.
  • Experience operating across global and regional structures while balancing enterprise consistency with local market requirements.
  • Strong analytical capabilities and experience using data to guide strategy, investment, and program optimization.
  • Experience applying AI, advanced analytics, automation, or intelligent workflows to partner or go-to-market operations.
  • Experience supporting transformation within a SaaS or subscription-based business model.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional leadership skills.

PTC carefully considers a wide variety of factors when determining compensation. The anticipated annual salary range for this position is between $314,200 - 400,000. The salary range reflects a good-faith estimate of compensation at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on a candidate's skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Additionally, candidates may be eligible for a performance-based bonus. Employees also have the opportunity to become a PTC shareholder through our employee share purchase program (ESPP), which allows for the purchase of discounted PTC stock. Certain roles may also be eligible for participation in our equity programs. Employees may be eligible for medical, dental and vision insurance, paid time off and sick leave, tuition reimbursement, 401(k) contributions and employer match, flexible spending accounts, life insurance, disability coverage and, if you are an office-assigned employee, a generous commuter subsidy. All total rewards and benefits programs are subject to applicable plan eligibility and other terms and conditions.

Life at PTC is about more than working with today’s most cutting-edge technologies to transform the physical world. It’s about showing up as you are and working alongside some of today’s most talented industry leaders to transform the world around you.

raw.description:
Job Description


Associate Director, Science, Assessment Development

College Board - API


Location: This is a remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.

Role Type: This is a full-time position

About the Team

The AP Curriculum and Assessment Team at College Board (125+ staff) collaborates with colleagues across all aspects of the AP Program to develop, manage, and deliver AP’s 43 courses in a wide variety of subject areas. AP® is a rigorous academic program built on the commitment, passion, and hard work of students and educators from secondary schools and higher education. AP provides willing and academically prepared high school students with the opportunity to study and learn at the college level. AP’s course teams comprised of educators and disciplinary experts ensure that course curricula are aligned to higher education expectations and reflect the state of the art in the discipline, contribute to instructional resources and tools for teachers, and develop assessments that allow students in these courses to demonstrate their mastery of course content and skills. AP leads in strategic use of AI to expand student access, strengthen instructional design and professional support, and enhance assessment creation and exam analysis. The Science department, which includes biology, chemistry, physics, psychology, environmental science, and Research, is currently comprised of approximately 25 people supporting 10 courses in the AP portfolio.

About the Opportunity

As the Associate Director, Science Assessment Content you are responsible for sourcing texts and drafting items for use on the AP Biology and Environmental Science exams. The Associate Director, Science Assessment Development is the primary point of contact in AP for all stimulus content development and item development for AP Biology and AP Environmental Science collaborating closely with the AP Biology and AP Environmental Science Course Experts who lead all operational assessment development activities. The Associate Director may provide assessment development support in other related subject areas. You will ethically and effectively integrate AI technologies in assessment creation and review. This includes judiciously using AI assisted tools to support fairness, validity, and innovation in AP assessments. You may train SMEs on assessment development protocols, translate between academics and technical experts (psychometricians), and collaborate to develop formative assessment materials and resources to support AP Biology and AP Environmental Science.


In this role, you will:

Assessment Development and Scoring (80-90%) 

  • Independently identifies, selects, reviews, and edits appropriate stimulus material for use in developing assessment items for AP Biology and AP Environmental Science and readies it for internal and external review.
  • Facilitates the review process (internal and/or external) for all stimulus materials, and adapts future stimulus identification and selection process based on internal and external acceptance criteria for stimulus materials (e.g., permissions, Development Committee review, etc.)
  • Reviews assessment content (formative, summative, scoring materials), recommending revisions based on established item review criteria.
  • With support from your manager, author assessment content, leveraging generative AI to improve and/or make more efficient assessment processes and outputs.
  • As needed, and in collaboration with AP Course Experts, facilitate multiple face-to-face, weekend meetings, and virtual meetings (during work week, evenings, or weekends) annually with the AP Test Development Committee.
  • In collaboration with AP Course Experts support the successful scoring of student responses for AP Exams at the annual scoring event in person and online—the “AP Reading”—and produce AP Reading publications materials for teacher and student use.

Assessment Quality and Process (10-20%)

  • Contribute to current research and best practices in assessment, and engage regularly with AP Curriculum & Assessment colleagues to align on standards and shared principles guiding AP’s assessment directions
  • Support assessment workstreams within the AP Science.
  • Contribute to processes for efficient, high-quality assessment development
  • Monitor and improve stimulus quality, reliability, fairness, etc.

About You

You (have):

  • A Master’s degree in Biology, Environmental Science, or a directly related discipline, and knowledge of current trends in the discipline (required), although a doctorate in the discipline is strongly preferred
  • Expertise in Biology or Environmental Science with at least 3 years of experience in standardized assessment development or related work; experience with digital assessment and teaching preferred
  • Strong oral and written communication skills, with solid technical proficiency and a customer-focused mindset
  • Excellent organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and maintain close attention to detail, including proofreading
  • Demonstrated ability to implement processes and procedures, manage project plans and schedules, and maintain tracking documentation
  • Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across all levels, and engage in giving and receiving constructive feedback
  • Ability to travel 6-8 times per year, plus up to two additional weeks for the AP Reading; must be eligible to work in the United States

All roles at College Board require:

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work
  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and comfort with learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.
  • Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal
  • A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.
  • A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking.
  • A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success
  • Authorization to work in the United States

About Our Process

  • Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.
  • While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.

What We Offer

At College Board, we offer more than a paycheck: we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.

A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation

  • The hiring range for this role is $60,000–$100,000.
  • Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board.
  • We aim to make our best offer upfront, rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.
  • We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.

You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out our careers page for more.

raw.description:
About EXP Group

EXP Group is a produce distribution and logistics company with operations in New Jersey, New York, and Texas. Our transportation team keeps fresh product moving every day, starting before sunrise.

About the role

We are looking for an experienced routing dispatcher to build each day's local delivery operation. Every evening, you will route our fleet of 15 box trucks based on the next day's volume. When volume exceeds what the box trucks can handle, you will plan and build trailer loads for our tractor division. You will also be the designated backup for our lead dispatcher.

This role works 4:00 AM – 12:00 PM Eastern Time

What you'll do

  • Route about 15 box trucks every night for the next day's local deliveries, adjusting to daily volume
  • Build efficient multi-stop routes that account for delivery windows, truck capacity, and driver availability
  • Plan and build trailer loads for the tractor division when volume exceeds box-truck capacity
  • Make sure the next day's operation is fully routed and dispatched before ending the shift
  • Cover the lead dispatcher's responsibilities and schedule during their PTO
  • Communicate clearly with drivers, warehouse staff, and the morning dispatcher

Qualifications

  • Fluent in English and Spanish, spoken and written (required)
  • 2+ years of experience routing local, multi-stop delivery operations
  • Experience with load planning: truck and trailer capacity, stop sequencing, delivery windows
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
  • Schedule flexibility to cover another shift when needed
  • Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet workspace, and a working phone/headset

Preferred

  • Knowledge of the tri-state area (NY/NJ/CT)
  • Experience in produce, refrigerated, or food distribution
  • Experience with dispatch, routing, or TMS software

raw.description:
Position Overview

Lead the work that wins the next project. As a Senior EPC T-Line Engineer, you’ll lead transmission projects and programs of all complexity levels, serve as an internal point of contact for technical decisions, mentor and direct engineers, and help shape the standards and proposals that position our team for future awards.


The Leidos portfolio puts you at the center of some of the industry’s larger and more complex high-voltage programs. Leidos is actively competing for and executing major transmission projects, including 500 kV projects extending hundreds of miles, and as a Senior engineer you’ll have the opportunity to help lead and win that work. You’ll also be able to utilize cutting-edge technology in your day-to-day work.


Successful candidates understand that engineering decisions directly impact project cost, procurement, construction sequencing, and contractual risk, and are comfortable making decisions in a fast-paced EPC environment.


Key Responsibilities

Project Leadership & Transmission Line Engineering Design

  • Lead transmission line engineering projects and programs of all complexity levels, utilizing PLS-CADD, PLS-POLE, MFAD, and other typical design software.
  • Ensure client standard and national code compliance (NESC, IEEE, ASCE, ACI, GO 95, etc.).
  • Ensure project team communication and efficiency to deliver on-schedule, high-quality work products following the EPC Power Delivery Solutions Quality Management Standards.
  • Perform quality checks and participate in challenge meetings.
  • Develop hour estimates and project approach documents for all projects.
  • Collaborate across disciplines and resolve design conflicts, including client communication.
  • Provide PE stamp as required.

Proposals, Client Engagement & Leadership

  • Lead the engineering content of PMO-owned proposals, including preparing and reviewing technical write-ups, estimates, and project approach documents for all projects, and defining the assumptions, risk matrices, and Leidos value proposition.
  • Present and justify proposals, estimates, and technical write-ups to management.
  • Interface directly with clients to proactively resolve project issues (scope, schedule, budget, technical) and develop relationships at the production and management levels.
  • Provide weekly status updates to the Project Manager on tasks completed and effort remaining.
  • Provide guidance and mentorship to engineering staff and act as an internal point of contact for technical engineering decisions.
  • Organize lunch and learns, technical presentations, and trainings.
  • Direct other engineers and/or self-create and develop Leidos standards, processes, and guidelines.

What You’ll Bring

Required Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in an engineering discipline
  • 8–12 years of relevant experience
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license
  • Expertise with PLS-CADD and PLS-POLE
  • Proficient with MFAD and/or LPILE
  • Firm knowledge of NESC, ASCE, ACI, and GO 95 code requirements, construction specifications, and the material procurement process
  • Proven ability to communicate effectively with clients and project teams; strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Demonstrated ability to lead projects of all complexity levels and mentor engineers
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and within a team environment
  • Willingness to travel periodically as needed

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience performing constructability reviews and partnering with construction crews
  • Experience applying value engineering solutions to improve material economy, constructability, and/or safety
  • Experience preparing proposals, estimates, and project approach documents

Career Development & Growth

This position is designed to build technical authority. The next step is EPC T-Line Principal Engineer, which expects subject matter expertise within the discipline, ownership of complex internal engineering decisions, and leading the presentation and defense of proposals for programs and large, complex projects. From there, engineers can progress to Principal EPC T-Line Engineer or move into management as an EPC T-Line Engineering Supervisor or Manager.


Why This Team

Leidos is a trusted, technology-focused solutions provider, and our Power Delivery Solutions team is the go-to for utilities and developers who need reliable power expertise. We’ve worked with more than 50 investor-owned utilities, over 160 municipalities and cooperatives, and multiple leading developers, and we’re still expanding.

Here’s what you can expect when you join our EPC Transmission Line Engineering team:

  • Invested in your success. Leidos puts leading technology in your hands and keeps our team at the front of the industry, which sets us apart on projects and sets you up for what’s next.
  • A voice in what we build. We’re growing this new EPC extension of our large, established T-Line organization, and we want contributors at every level. You get the energy of building a new team with the stability and security of an $18B company.
  • A future we help you shape. Leadership recognizes individual contributions and carves out a path for talent to grow.
  • A work-life balance that supports a long career.

PDSTLINE

PDSPM

PowerDelivery

If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

Job Description

Role Title: Inpatient facility coder

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

We are engaging experienced Inpatient facility coders to contribute to a customer project focused on high-quality case review and adjudication. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. This engagement emphasizes strong written and verbal communication, attention to detail, and a commitment to coding excellence.

Required Skills

  • Icd-10-cm coding

  • Icd-10-pcs coding

  • Ms-drg assignment

  • Apr-drg assignment

  • Pre-bill review

  • Drg validation

  • Second-level coding audit

  • Epic ehr

  • 3m encoder

  • Solventum encoder

  • Optum encoder

  • Clinical documentation improvement

  • Written communication

  • Verbal communication

  • Analytical thinking

  • Attention to detail

  • Coding accuracy

  • Independent work

  • Remote collaboration

Scope of Work

  • Review and code inpatient facility stays using ICD-10-CM and PCS classifications, ensuring accurate MS-DRG and APR-DRG assignment.

  • Conduct comprehensive pre-bill reviews, DRG validation, and second-level audits as part of case adjudication.

  • Document clear, concise rationales for DRG changes, supported by thorough chart evidence and clinical documentation.

  • Leverage Epic and industry-standard encoders (3M/Solventum or Optum) during the coding and review process.

  • Assess cases objectively—calling them up or down as appropriate—and provide detailed written feedback.

  • Participate in steady case volume review through Q1, meeting project submission requirements and quality benchmarks.

  • Collaborate remotely with the micro1 platform and project stakeholders to ensure alignment on deliverables and outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Active CCS credential required; CIC, RHIT, or RHIA certifications are a plus.

  • Minimum of 3 years' experience independently coding inpatient stays, including MS-DRG and APR-DRG assignment.

  • Demonstrated experience in pre-bill review, DRG validation, or second-level coding audits.

  • Background in clinical validation (CCDS, CDIP, or RN with coding expertise) highly valued.

  • Proficiency with Epic EHR and at least one standard encoder platform (3M/Solventum or Optum).

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; able to articulate coding decisions and evidence clearly.

  • Strong analytical mindset and commitment to accuracy, integrity, and ongoing learning within inpatient facility coding.

Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

Territory Manager III, DBS - San Antonio, TX


Working at Abbott


At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

  • Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
  • Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year
  • An excellent retirement savings plan with high employer contribution
  • Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree.
  • A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
  • A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

Neuromodulation


Our Neuromodulation business includes implantable devices compatible with mobile technology to help people who suffer from chronic pain and movement disorders. These non-opioid therapies allow us to provide interventional pain therapy to patients throughout the pain continuum.


The Opportunity


As a member of the regional sales team, the Territory Manager III will be responsible for leading the strategy within an assigned territory to accomplish planned objectives as to sales volume, market penetration, and profitability while ensuring alignment and collaboration across the team and with sales leadership. The incumbent will work in a highly matrixed, geographically diverse environment under general direction with clinical and sales teammates to identify and capitalize on sales opportunities by creating competency, comfort, and expertise with Abbott therapies among physicians, support staff and customers. The incumbent will perform work that involves a high degree of independence and will exercise sound judgment in planning, organizing, and performing work while continually seeking to improve territory efficiency.


What You’ll Work On


  • Identifies strategies to increase referrals of Abbott therapies and overcome barriers that are restricting the national growth and adoption of the therapies
  • Integrates into accounts, builds trust, and establishes strong rapport with with new and existing customers, key opinion leaders (KOLs), and industry leaders

  • Exercises considerable latitude in determining the technical objective of work assignments

  • Fosters high trust relationships with colleagues including the regional teams and area leadership
  • Conducts evaluations and develops sales strategies for capital equipment opportunities within accounts
  • Coordinates implanting schedules of aligned Territory Managers and Clinical Specialists
  • Interfaces and interacts with patients up to 50% of the time
  • Demonstrates fiscal responsibility by effectively managing consigned inventory used in the territory
  • Analyzes sales statistics, prepares reports, and performs required administrative sales duties such as filing expense account reports, scheduling appointments, and making travel plans
  • Exercises authority to make sales commitments for assigned efforts and is accountable for results
  • Attends trade shows where new products and technologies are showcased; meet other sales representatives and clients to discuss new product developments
  • Complies with U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations, other regulatory requirements, company policies, operating procedures, processes, and task assignments
  • Maintains positive and cooperative communications and collaboration with all levels of employees, customers, contractors, and vendors
  • Performs other related duties and responsibilities, on occasion, as assigned

Required Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree In a related field - an equivalent combination of education and work experience
  • 8 or more years of sales experience in medical devices
  • 4 or more years of work experience in Neuromodulation
  • Ability and willingness to travel within assigned area on a regular basis (% of travel varies by area)
  • Capable and willing to work an unpredictable schedule that may change on short notice
  • Excellent verbal, written and presentation skills with the ability to effectively communicate at multiple levels and to large groups within and outside the organization
  • Capable of managing multiple projects and accustomed to tight deadlines

Preferred Qualifications


  • Prefer bachelor’s degree in biomedical engineering or related field
  • Prefer candidates with demonstrated leadership capabilities

Standard Job Description

WHO WE ARE

Lockheed Martin is a global leader in aerospace, defense, and technology solutions, dedicated to pushing the boundaries of innovation and shaping the future of the industry. With a rich legacy of excellence and a commitment to delivering advanced capabilities to our customers, we are proud to be at the forefront of cutting-edge technology and engineering.

WHAT WE'RE DOING

At Lockheed Martin, we're revolutionizing the aerospace and defense sector through groundbreaking technology, advanced manufacturing processes, and a world-class team of professionals. Our mission-driven approach and unwavering dedication to excellence ensure that we continue to deliver superior products and solutions to our customers around the world.

THE WORK

The successful candidate will serve as the Global Sustainment (GS) Senior Manager for both the Air Commercial Solutions (ACS) and Land and Maritime Solutions (LMS) market segments within the Training, Logistics, and Simulation (TLS) line of business. This position leads training, support, and advanced test equipment teams for various platforms, including C-130J, F-16, Combat Rescue Helicopter, and Aegis. In addition, the role will also support new business capture, new business growth of existing programs, and proposals.

This role will partner with the ACS and LMS cross-functional leadership team, ensuring all program and customer requirements, sustainment deliverables, and support services, meet/exceed expected performance outcomes. The successful candidate will execute in alignment with the RMS, TLS, and GS strategies, driving performance across all Perform, Transform, and Grow focus areas.

Additionally, the GS ACS and LMS Senior Manager ensures Program Management and customer satisfaction through on-time delivery of required sustainment deliverables and support services at the best value to the customer.

WHY JOIN US

Opportunity for Impact: Join a team that is at the forefront of innovation in the aerospace and defense industry and make a significant impact on the success of our organization.
Professional Development: Take advantage of unparalleled opportunities for growth and advancement within Lockheed Martin, with access to world-class training and development programs.
Collaborative Culture: Work alongside some of the brightest minds in the industry who share your passion for excellence and who are committed to supporting each other's success.
Competitive Benefits: Enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance, retirement plans, and paid time off, as well as competitive salary offerings.
Cutting-Edge Technology: Be part of a dynamic and forward-thinking work environment where you will have the opportunity to work with the latest technology and contribute to groundbreaking projects that are shaping the future of aerospace and defense.

Basic Qualifications

The successful candidate will have demonstrated leadership of multi-functional teams in a dynamic environment with internal and external customers. Key qualifications include:

  • Full Spectrum Leadership—strong oral & written communication skills and effective organizational skills
  • Proven ability to build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external customers
  • Ability to establish positive relationships with various customers, teammates, subcontractors and employees/co-workers
  • Experience with planning, development and integration of complex systems
  • Successful coordination with multi-functional teams, including customer and external partners
  • Must be able to travel (domestic and international) at least 25%
  • Have active Secret clearance and be able to qualify and hold an SAP clearance

Desired Skills

The selected candidate may also hold the following skills:

  • Domain Knowledge of Sustainment capabilities & solutions
  • Familiarity with the ACS & LMS market segments, including functional support and execution
  • Program Manager experience overseeing P&L responsibility and strong execution
  • Experience managing personnel to support mission readiness at dedicated training and operational installations.
  • Experience working in environments that require interaction with multiple functional areas and personnel from varied backgrounds.
  • Demonstrated experience in successfully leading and working with virtual teams and customers
  • Prior experience working with a represented workforce

Pay Information

GeoZone Definition: GeoZones are geographic groupings created by Lockheed Martin to align compensation ranges with regional labor markets and cost-of-labor differences across the United States. Locations are assigned a Geo Zone based on the primary work location of the role.

  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 1): $198400.00 - $368400.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Sunnyvale CA; Pal Alto, CA; New York City metropolitan area; Newark, New Jersey; etc.
  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 2): $178500.00 - $331500.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Denver, CO; King of Prussia, PA; Stratford, CT; Moorestown, NJ; etc.
  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 3): $158700.00 - $294700.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Dallas–Fort Worth, TX; Orlando, FL; Grand Prairie, TX; Marietta, GA; etc.
  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 4): $142800.00 - $265200.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Camden, AR; Lexington, KY; Lufkin, TX; etc.

At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.

The salary range for this position is as listed on the requisition. Please note that the salary information listed is a general guideline only.
Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer.

Benefits offered: Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible work arrangements and schedules (e.g., 4x10), 401(k) match, Paid time off, Holidays, Parental Leave, EAP, Flexible Spending Accounts, Education Assistance, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability.

  • Annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics.
  • For (Washington state applicants only) Non-represented full-time employees: accrue at least 10 hours per month of Paid Time Off (PTO) to be used for incidental absences and other reasons; receive at least 90 hours for holidays. Represented full time employees accrue 6.67 hours of Vacation per month; accrue up to 52 hours of sick leave annually; receive at least 96 hours for holidays. PTO, Vacation, sick leave, and holiday hours are prorated based on start date during the calendar year.

raw.description:
About Cogstate

At Cogstate, we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.

Our digital cognitive assessments are trusted by researchers, clinicians, and pharmaceutical partners around the world, helping to drive breakthroughs in neuroscience and improve outcomes for people living with neurological conditions. Founded on decades of cognitive science and backed by rigorous validation, Cogstate’s assessments are used in more than 150 countries and over 2,000 clinical trials.

Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. Whether we’re supporting a multinational Alzheimer’s trial or developing tools to bring cognitive testing into routine care, our work is meaningful, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

At Cogstate, we’re not just imagining the future of brain health - we’re building it.

About the Clinician Network

By joining the Cogstate Clinician Network, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute your clinical expertise to research studies around the world.

Depending on your background, scales experience, and therapeutic area expertise, we may have an opportunity for you immediately - or it may take some time before a study opens that is the right fit.

Cogstate is continuing to grow and expand our clinical research initiatives, so new projects and opportunities are always on the horizon.

All applicants to the Clinician Network are kept in our active pipeline, and you’ll also receive our monthly Clinician Network newsletter, which shares updates and upcoming openings.

About the Role

Cogstate Clinicians are clinical psychologists or neuropsychologists responsible for delivering remote clinical interviews and cognitive assessment batteries to subjects with preclinical dementia, enrolled in a pharmaceutical clinical trial.

Cogstate provides all consultants with comprehensive, fully compensated training on general Cogstate operational policies, study-specific procedures, customized clinical interviewing skills and virtual cognitive assessment prior to performing remote scale administrations. Regular supervision and ongoing recalibration of clinical skill set will be provided.

*These are contract position.

*They are fully remote.

*Hired employee will work on an as needed basis based on their schedule.

- MADRS Administration Experience Required
- Estonian Fluency Required

Key Responsibilities

Central Rating

  • Remotely administering semi-structured clinical interview assessments and cognitive battery of tests to study subjects and caregivers.
  • Remotely delivering computerized and traditional cognitive assessments via a tele-health platform.
  • Scoring completed scale administrations.
  • Participating in regular clinical skill recalibration activities.

Central Monitoring

  • Providing reviews of completed neuropsychological test batteries for central monitoring of data to ensure accuracy in administration and scoring and contribute to the overall success of a clinical trial.
  • Reviewing response forms and recordings of remote scale administrations and offering feedback to raters via email and telephone communications.

Qualifications & Expertise

  • MD, DO, MBBS or PhD, PsyD in Psychology or RN, APRN, PA, MA/MS/MSW in Psychiatry (or equivalent)
  • Formal training in clinical interviewing and cognitive assessment
  • Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience with direct clinical interviewing and psychological assessment in clinical research industry, academic or clinical settings
  • Direct experience with cognitive/behavioral/functional assessment of neurological/psychiatric populations
  • Ability to meet deadlines, being highly organized and methodical, with attention to detail to ensure delivery
  • Proficiency with MS Office, including Word and Excel, email, teleconference platforms such as Skype, Zoom or other similar applications, and cloud-based storage service.
  • Slovak Fluency
  • MADRS Administration Experience Required

Our Culture
We bring our whole selves to work every day. We’re courageous and we deliver together. We’re passionate individuals who enjoy working together. We’re brave enough and care enough to have the right conversations to get the best outcome and are famous for our can-do attitude. We see challenges as opportunities and move with pace to achieve our goals.

If you’re ready to help us in our journey to optimize the measurement of brain health around the world, please apply now!

raw.excerpt: About Us… Obsidian Therapeutics is pioneering engineered cell and gene therapies to deliver transformative outcomes for patients.
raw.description:
About Us…

Obsidian Therapeutics is pioneering engineered cell and gene therapies to deliver transformative outcomes for patients. Obsidian’s programs apply our cytoDRiVE® technology in Cell and Gene therapy products to control expression of proteins for enhanced therapeutic efficacy and safety. Obsidian’s lead program is currently in clinical development for the treatment of patients with metastatic melanoma and non-small cell lung cancer.

We’re proud of our diverse talented team and committed to cultivating an environment of inclusion where each person feels a strong sense of belonging and is supported to continuously learn and contribute their best work. Our Research team is based in the heart of Cambridge, MA, and Technical Operations team is based in our purpose built facility in Bedford, MA. Obsidianites enjoy a highly collaborative culture, competitive salary and benefits, and potential for ownership through stock options.

Our Opportunity...

We are looking for a highly motivated Medical Science Liaison (MSL), with a strong background in solid tumor oncology and cell therapy. As a key contributor within our newly established Medical Affairs team, you’ll own scientific exchange and thought leader engagement across your assigned region for our melanoma program and our broader pipeline, including non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) programs, helping to drive the development of our first clinical stage autologous cell therapy program targeting solid tumors.

You’ll serve as the field-based scientific face of Obsidian with investigators, key opinion leaders (KOLs), and treatment centers, with academic centers and clinical trial sites as the priority: building peer-level relationships at academic melanoma and NSCLC centers with TIL and cell therapy capability, turning that engagement into trial awareness, referrals, and enrollment across our clinical studies, communicating emerging amsoki-cel data in a compliant, non-promotional manner, and bringing actionable insights back to Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, and the broader organization. Your priority is preparing the field for commercial launch of amsoki-cel in melanoma, starting with the academic ATCs and expanding into community centers as the ATC network grows. As one of the first two MSLs at Obsidian, you’ll also help shape the field medical function itself, including its territory plans, engagement standards, tools, and training, as we advance through late-stage development toward pre-BLA readiness and launch preparation.

As a member of our Medical Affairs team, you will be a vital part of a highly collaborative group working to unlock the promise of precision cell therapy for patients, starting with our lead program amsoki-cel (OBX-115), a novel engineered tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte (TIL) cell therapy that uses our proprietary cytoDRiVE® platform. This is a unique opportunity to be a valuable contributor in a well-funded clinical company with field-leading advisors, best-in-class partners, and an experienced team.

This is a remote, field-based role requiring significant travel (approximately 50–60%), including overnight travel to treatment centers, clinical trial sites, and scientific congresses. Candidates should reside within their assigned region with ready access to a major airport; prefernce to Central US timezones.

You Will...

Core responsibilities

  • Build and maintain peer-level scientific relationships with KOLs, investigators, and multidisciplinary care teams at priority academic and community treatment centers for melanoma and NSCLC in the assigned region, and use those relationships to build awareness of, referrals to, and enrollment in Obsidian-sponsored clinical trials, with equal commitment to both studies.
  • Prioritize field activity at academic centers, ATCs, and clinical trial sites. Partner cross-functionally to provide medical input on ATC selection and onboarding and prepare each center scientifically for the commercial availability of amoski-cel in melanoma. Work is driven by corporate goals, launch readiness, and study enrollment.
  • Partner with Clinical Development and Clinical Operations on trial execution: site identification and feasibility input, education of site and referring-center staff, engagement of the referral networks around study sites, and identification and resolution of enrollment and operational barriers.
  • Engage in compliant, fair-balanced scientific exchange on amsoki-cel, the cytoDRiVE® platform, TIL cell therapy, and the relevant disease states, working from the approved scientific platform and lexicon.
  • Systematically gather, document, and synthesize medical insights from KOLs, investigators, and treatment center stakeholders, and translate them into actionable recommendations for Medical Affairs and cross-functional partners.
  • Educate treatment center teams on the TIL patient journey, from patient identification and tumor tissue procurement through cell infusion and post-infusion care, to build scientific and operational preparedness for cell therapy in solid tumors.
  • Represent Obsidian Medical Affairs at scientific congresses: engage experts, cover key sessions, gather competitive and scientific intelligence, and contribute to post-congress reporting.
  • Respond to unsolicited requests for medical information accurately and in line with company procedures, and identify and report adverse events and product complaints within required timelines.
  • Support advisory boards, medical education activities, and speaker and investigator identification, and serve as the regional point of contact for investigator-sponsored research inquiries and registry or long-term follow-up engagement.
  • Contribute to building the field medical function alongside the VICE PRESIDENT, Medical Affairs: territory planning, engagement standards, CRM and insight processes, field materials, training content, and onboarding of future MSLs.
  • Collaborate appropriately with Clinical, Regulatory, Market Access, and Commercial colleagues while maintaining medical independence, a clear non-promotional posture, and adherence to all applicable laws, regulations, and company policies.

You Bring...

Core Qualifications

  • Advanced clinical or scientific degree (NP/PA, PharmD, DNP, or PhD with relevant clinical )
  • 10+ years of progressive relevant clinical and/or biopharma experience, including at least 3 years as a field-based MSL in oncology.
  • Solid tumor oncology expertise with direct experience in melanoma and/or thoracic oncology (NSCLC), and a strong working knowledge of immuno-oncology.
  • Experience in cell therapy (TIL, TCR-T, or CAR-T) or another complex, center-based oncology therapy, with an understanding of how treatment centers deliver it.
  • Established relationships with melanoma and/or NSCLC KOLs, investigators, and academic treatment centers in the assigned region.

raw.description:
At Morning Brew Inc., we mix what you need to know with our unique brand of wit to attract, and build real relationships with, the next generation of business leaders. We speak to them like people, ensuring they get the context and insight needed to make decisions every day. Loyalty and trust are our most valuable currencies.
Whether scrolling, reading, watching, or listening, our audience trusts us for credible, entertaining business content that makes an impact on their personal and professional lives.
The Morning Brew team is clever, creative, and growing fast. Want in? Read on.

This is a contract position.

OVERVIEW

You’ll read and review an array of newsletter items, interviews, and reported stories for errors and other considerations across the B2B portfolio—Founder Brew, Retail Brew, HR Brew, Marketing Brew, Healthcare Brew, CFO Brew, and Tech Brew, among others. You’ll work with the assigning editor to maintain the integrity, accuracy, cohesiveness, and tone of all of our stories.

This job will require you to work cross-functionally with managing and assigning editors, reporters, other copy editors and fact-checkers, designers, growth, and social leads. Being a team player and working well with peers is essential, as are flexibility and good communication skills.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Making sure stories adhere to Morning Brew’s style guide and overall tone
  • Proofreading text and correct spelling, grammar, and punctuation errors - Verifying factual correctness of information, such as dates and statistics
  • Fact-checking original reporting and stories, with experience working with editors and reporters to ensure that stories are as accurate as possible
  • Ensuring stories adhere to Morning Brew standards
  • Working with editors to publish newsletters in a timely manner
    •

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • 2+ years of experience copy editing and/or fact checking at a news or media publication, preferably with a business focus—but if you don't have quite that experience, we'd still like to hear from you!
  • Experience working with reporters and editors, preferably in the B2B space
  • A sharp eye for detail, the ability to catch every spelling, grammar, and punctuation mistake
  • Ability to manage multiple projects on a tight deadline
  • Fluency with online publishing and organizational tools
  • Strong written communication skills and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team
  • An understanding of the importance of language
    •
RATE $40-45/hr

BRIEF BREW HISTORY

Morning Brew Inc. was founded in 2015 by two entrepreneurial college students who noticed their peers were not consuming legacy media resources about business and finance news, but had a high desire to learn about those topics. What started as a small on-campus email has since evolved into a multi-channel media company that operates 20+ unique content franchises. All while maintaining our witty, honest and engaging tone that millions of loyal MBI audience members rely upon daily to better navigate the world.
In 2020 a majority stake in MBI was acquired by Axel Springer SE and in February 2025 that position was increased to full ownership of the business. Axel Springer SE is a family-owned, transatlantic media company headquartered in Berlin and New York that is committed to the values of a free and informed society. To learn more about Axel Springer SE and what defines us, visit .

As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

CrowdStrike is seeking a Corporate Sales Engineer who is passionate about cybersecurity. In this role, you will learn to articulate how current security solutions are designed and deployed, and why they are failing so that you can provide value to potential customers. You will be part of a team responsible for changing what the security market and customers believe is possible with a next-generation endpoint technology.


Our Corporate Sales Engineers collaborate with Account Managers to grow and expand existing customer relationships.


This position offers the flexibility of 100% remote work for candidates located within the United States. (Central Standard Time zone preferred)

  • Solid understanding of Windows, macOS, and Linux operating systems

  • Understanding of AI/ML concepts as they apply to threat detection, anomaly detection, or security automation — ability to speak credibly to both skeptics and enthusiasts
  • Ability to write and modify basic scripts. Preferred languages are PowerShell, Python, and Bash
  • Experience with virtualization/VDI technologies
  • Experience with large scale cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.

  • Customer facing experience and being comfortable leading presentations

raw.excerpt: Health Coach Institute is looking for Inside Sales Reps for the Health Coach (HCI) Course!
raw.description:
Health Coach Institute is looking for Inside Sales Reps for the Health Coach (HCI) Course!

KEY INFO!

  • PLEASE NOTE: We are currently hiring for our (January) class.
  • Compensation:Base salary of $50,000, with an uncapped commission structure bringing your On-Target Earnings (OTE) to $100,000.
  • Free Enrollment in the Health Coach Course on Day 1!
  • Must reside in an ISSA-eligible state (AZ, UT, NV, ID, TX, IL, IN, WI, TN, GA, FL, SC, NC, VA)
  • Core business hours are 6 am to 6 pm M-F AZ Time. If you live in another time zone, the flexibility to work a schedule within our core business hours is critical. (For example, some shifts may end at 9 pm Eastern.) Additionally, this is a work-to-goal environment, so you can work beyond this core shift to achieve your goals and earn more money!

ISSA + Health Coach Institute: Expanding the Definition of Wellness Education

For over 35 years, the International Sports Sciences Association (ISSA) has empowered hundreds of thousands of professionals to transform lives through science-based fitness, nutrition, and wellness education.

Now, through the integration of Health Coach Institute (HCI), a pioneer in habit change and life transformation, ISSA broadens its mission to include the art and science of coaching. Together, ISSA and HCI merge evidence-based training with mastery of behavior change, creating a complete ecosystem for holistic health professionals.

This partnership equips students not only to train the body but also to guide the mind—developing experts who help clients build sustainable habits, lasting motivation, and lifelong wellness.

Together, ISSA and HCI empower people to transform lives through science, education, and habit change.

We are adding an Inside Sales Representative to our team of relationship-builders who are laser-focused on providing exceptional service to our students. We are tenacious and resilient in our pursuit of personal and professional success, while we incorporate fun into every day!

So What's the Job?

We are looking for sales professionals who want to transform lives through health and fitness! Use our extensive knowledge of certifications and specializations to overcome objections, address prospect concerns, and convert warm leads into sales!

  • This role will be focused on selling our Health Coach (HCI) course.
  • Make up to 150 calls per day to prospective students (no cold calling!)
  • Use discovery questions and rapport-building techniques to engage with students.
  • Meet and exceed sales targets, including Monthly Revenue, Average Order Value, and Conversion Rate goals.

WHAT is ISSA looking for?

  • A desire to promote and sell our Health Coach (HCI) course.
  • At least 1 year of phone-based inside sales experience.
  • Proven track record in high-ticket sales or managing premium product portfolios is preferred.
  • Prior CRM experience.
  • Enthusiastic and results-oriented with a proven track record in phone-based sales.
  • Excellent phone-based communication skills.
  • Personal passion for health, life, and nutrition coaching and desire to help others.
  • Money motivated with a competitive nature that enjoys the grind of sales.
  • Comfortable interacting with a diverse potential customer base.
  • Ability to communicate and coach someone through their challenges and inspire them to take action despite their fears or roadblocks.
  • Ability to build rapport, empathize, and make a personal connection with our prospective students.
  • Ability to frame the enrollment/sales conversation as a powerful conversation to help someone bridge the gap from where they are to where they want to be.
  • Describe the experience and attributes of the ideal candidate
  • Comfortable learning and applying AI tools as part of daily work

WHO is ISSA looking for?

Skills can be developed. Experience can be built. What's harder to teach, and what we pay close attention to, is mindset. The qualifications below are specific to this role. But across every role at ISSA, we're looking for the same kind of person.

  • Someone who leads with curiosity. Who asks "why do we do it this way?" as a genuine question, not a complaint.
  • Someone humble enough to know what they don't know, and bold enough to challenge the way things have always been done.
  • Someone who can advocate hard for an idea and then fully commit when the team goes a different direction.
  • Someone who takes ownership of their mistakes, shares credit for their wins, and believes the best idea should win regardless of who had it.

We're looking for people who are personally invested in healthy living, not because it's their job, but because they believe in its power to change lives. You don't have to have it all figured out. You just have to care.

We're not looking for perfect. We're looking for growth-oriented, mission-driven, and genuinely invested in doing something that matters. If that sounds like you, you'll fit in great here!

Anything else? Absolutely! Benefits and Perks:

ISSA is a place where every day we are inspired by our teammates, encouraging each other to be our best. The environment is relaxed, friendly, and upbeat! And we feel it’s important to reward our team with competitive pay and benefits. Here are some of the highlights:

Free Certifications: Who wants to be their best self? WE DO! As an ISSA team member, you have access to our courses and certifications…at no expense! Additionally, you'll receive exclusive discounts on leading products in the fitness industry. Cool, right? After 90 days, employees can also enroll up to 5 friends/family members each year in our courses...FOR FREE!

Health & Wellness Reimbursement: If our company’s mission is to encourage healthy living, we need to walk the talk and ensure each employee is supported in their wellness journey! Employees can submit fitness purchases (gym membership, fitness equipment, classes) and professional and mental health purchases (personal learning courses, wellness apps, art classes, and more) for reimbursement up to $50/month…$600/year.

Work-Life Synergy: Our Team members have 3 weeks of PTO each year...this is accrued on a bi-weekly basis! And everyone at ISSA gets 9 paid national holidays every year...PLUS 1 floating holiday! Work hard, play hard!

Parental Time Off: We support our team members as they grow their families. Eligible employees giving birth can receive up to 12 weeks of paid leave, while other parents welcoming a new child (including partners and adoptive/foster parents) receive up to 6 weeks of paid bonding leave.

Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance: A key component to living a healthy lifestyle is having access to the care we (and our families) need. We offer 2 medical insurance plans accompanied by Health savings account (HSA) and Flexible Savings Account (FSA) options, as well Dental and Vision coverage. And you don’t have to wait forever! Eligibility begins the 1st of the month after you start.

Team Building: We may be remote, but we don’t have to be alone! We host a monthly schedule of virtual team activities, town halls, brown bag lunches, and other special events…so many fun ways for us to connect and support one another.

Tools To Do The Job: We ensure you are hooked up with the tools, equipment, and systems you need. We begin the process before your start date, so you are ready to rock ‘n roll on your first day. We also provide a monthly work-from-home allowance!

What Else? We have a 401(k) company match and 100% company-paid life/AD&D insurance/short-term disability. We also offer an employee assistance program to assist with work-life concerns (legal, financial, and mental health). Our ultimate goal is to support you and your overall wellness.

Transform your career at ISSA!
