Position Summary

This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship.

Samsung Electronics America (SEA) is a leader in mobile technologies, consumer electronics, home appliances, enterprise solutions and networks systems. Across each of these areas, our work drives innovation, economic growth and workforce opportunity in the United States.

For nearly five decades, Samsung has been at the forefront of technological advancements, investing over $100 billion and creating more than 20,000 jobs nationwide. Our mission? To integrate cutting-edge products, services, and AI technology to deliver smarter, sustainable, and more connected experiences that empower people to live better.
As a wholly owned subsidiary of Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd., SEA offers opportunities to work alongside global visionary thinkers and innovators who are passionate about making a difference. Explore the exciting opportunities at Samsung Electronics America and discover how you can make an impact.

To learn more, visit Samsung.com. For the latest news, visit news.samsung.com/us.

Role and Responsibilities

We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven B2B Monitor BDM to lead and expand Samsung's B2B Monitor sales through strategic engagement with National Channel Partners. The ideal candidate will be responsible for driving sales growth, enhancing market share, and executing partner development initiatives. This role requires a deep understanding of the B2B Monitor product portfolio, market trends, and the ability to position Samsung's solutions effectively in the competitive landscape. The B2B Monitor BDM will collaborate with internal teams to align strategies, support marketing initiatives, and ensure successful channel partner engagement.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Strategic Leadership: Develop and execute growth strategies for the B2B Monitor product category, focusing on pipeline development, market share expansion, and partner enablement.
  • Channel Partner Engagement: Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including executives, sales teams, and account managers within National Channel Partners.
  • Revenue Growth: Identify new business opportunities, promote products and services, and support sales efforts to drive consistent revenue growth.
  • Market Intelligence: Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and industry developments to identify opportunities and mitigate risks.
  • Performance Management: Provide regular updates, forecasts, and insights to internal and external stakeholders to inform strategic decision-making.
  • Marketing & Training: Execute marketing plans, conduct partner training, and implement competitive positioning strategies to enhance mind share of B2B Monitor solutions.
  • Representation: Represent Samsung at industry events, trade shows, and partner forums to promote the brand and strengthen relationships within the channel ecosystem.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with sales, marketing, and product development teams to align on channel initiatives and ensure seamless execution.
  • Account Reviews: Assist with account reviews and quarterly business reviews to evaluate performance and identify areas for improvement.

Skills and Qualifications

Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in business management or a related field (preferred).
  • Experience:
    • 5+ years of experience in hardware technology sales within the IT channel.
    • Familiarity with enterprise displays and monitor technology (preferred).
    • Experience using Salesforce.com or other CRM tools.
  • Skills & Abilities:
    • Strategic thinker with creativity and foresight to develop innovative approaches.
    • Excellent communication skills (written and verbal).
    • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently with minimal direction.
    • Proven ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment.
    • Self-motivated with a high-energy approach to achieving goals.
    • Technical foundation (considered a plus).

Travel: Willingness to travel up to 60% of the time domestically for channel partner engagement.

Life @ Samsung -

Benefits @ Samsung -

The salary range for this role is expected to be between $104,000 and $128,500. Actual pay will be determined considering factors such as relevant skills and experience, and comparison to other employees in the role.

Regular full-time employees (salaried or hourly) have access to benefits including: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, 401(k), Employee Purchase Program, Tuition Assistance (after 12 months), Paid Time Off, Student Loan Program (after 12 months), Wellness Incentives, and many more. raw.description:
ConnectWise is an industry and Global leading software company with over 3,000 colleagues in North America, EMEA and APAC. As a community-driven software company dedicated to the success of technology solution providers, our suite helps over 45,000 of our partners manage their businesses better, sell more efficiently, automate service delivery, and remotely control technology so they can consistently deliver amazing customer experiences.

Our company is powered by our connections, our colleagues, and our community. And, we accept all kinds.

Game-changers, innovators, culture-lovers—and humankind.

We invite discovery and debate. We recognize key moments as milestones.

We see you and value you for your unique contributions. Our inclusive, positive culture lays the foundation to ensure every colleague is valued for their perspectives and skills, giving you the choice of how YOU make a difference.

Curious? Read this opportunity to learn how YOU can make a difference at ConnectWise!

General Summary:

The Senior Manager, Software Engineering leads a team of AI and software engineers responsible for delivering multiple AI projects across the ConnectWise platform. This role combines people leadership, delivery ownership and technical judgment to turn business priorities into production-grade AI products, including machine learning models, LLM-powered features and AI agents. The Senior Manager works in partnership with product, data, platform and business stakeholders to set direction, manage priorities and ensure the team delivers high-quality outcomes on time and at scale.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

    • Leads, hires, develops and retains a high-performing team of AI, machine learning and software engineers, including managers or technical leads where applicable.
    • Owns end-to-end delivery of multiple concurrent AI projects, from scoping and planning through execution, launch and ongoing operation.
    • Partners with product management and business stakeholders to define roadmaps, prioritize work and align delivery with business outcomes.
    • Establishes and improves engineering processes, delivery practices and quality standards, including agile planning, code review, testing, MLOps and release management.
    • Provides technical direction on architecture for ML, LLM and agent-based systems, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, observable and cost-effective.
    • Ensures responsible AI practices, including model evaluation, safety, privacy, governance and compliance requirements.
    • Manages project risks, dependencies, resourcing and budgets, and communicates status clearly to senior leadership.
    • Sets clear goals, provides regular feedback and coaching, and conducts performance and career development conversations.
    • Fosters a culture of collaboration, ownership, innovation and continuous learning across distributed teams.
    • Works with cross-functional teams to ensure data pipelines, platforms and infrastructure support AI delivery.

Knowledge, Skills, and/or Abilities Required:

  • Proven ability to lead and grow engineering teams and to manage multiple projects simultaneously with minimal supervision.
  • Strong understanding of the machine learning and generative AI lifecycle, including model development, fine-tuning, retrieval-augmented generation, AI agents, evaluation and production deployment.
  • Solid software engineering background, with the ability to review designs and guide decisions on distributed systems, microservices, APIs and cloud-native architecture.
  • Experience with MLOps and DevOps practices, CI/CD, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and production monitoring.
  • Knowledge of at least one cloud platform (e.g. AWS or Azure) and its AI and data services.
  • Strong project and program management skills, including agile methodologies, estimation, prioritization and stakeholder management.
  • Ability to interpret business requirements and translate them into clear technical strategies and delivery plans.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to executives and audiences of varying technical understanding.
  • Strong decision-making, problem-solving and conflict-resolution skills.

Educational/Vocational/Previous Experience Recommendations:

    • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field required; Master's degree preferred.
    • 12+ years of relevant experience in software engineering, including AI/ML-focused work.
    • 4+ years of experience managing engineering teams, ideally including AI or ML engineers.
    • Proven track record of delivering multiple AI or ML products into production.
    • Experience building and operating software on cloud computing platforms.
    • Experience leading geographically distributed teams is a plus.

Working Conditions:

    • Onsite/Hybrid/Remote depending on location
    • 0-10% travel may be required

raw.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Product Sales is a team of deep functional and technical specialists who both lead and advise on deals for the most strategically important products in Stripe’s portfolio. Stripe is investing in the growth of its Fraud & Risk business, helping users balance strong controls with seamless customer experience. As a Sales Manager of Fraud & Risk Product Sales, you will lead a high-performing team of product sales account executives and be a critical member of the leadership team responsible for growing adoption of Radar, Identity, Managed Risk, Dispute Prevention, and more across the Americas. Few roles offer such a direct opportunity to shape the commercial success of a strategic product area while developing the next generation of product sales leaders.

What you’ll do

  • As the Manager, AMER Fraud & Risk Product Sales, you will recruit, develop, and lead a team of product sales executives responsible for delivering ambitious growth goals across our Fraud & Risk suite.
  • You will bring strong sales leadership, operating rigor, and a customer-first mindset to a complex and evolving product area. You will help your team navigate consultative, technical, and cross-functional sales cycles, partnering closely with Core Sales, Product, Solutions Architecture, Finance, Marketing, and Sales Development.
  • The ideal candidate has demonstrated success managing and developing enterprise sales teams, bringing complex products to market, operating effectively through ambiguity, and building durable sales motions in a high-growth environment.
  • Set a clear strategy and operating plan that delivers against pipeline, bookings, attach rate, adoption, and revenue goals.
  • Manage day-to-day business operations, including pipeline creation, deal progression, forecasting, performance against targets, and inspection of key sales metrics.
  • Partner closely with Core AEs to identify, prioritize, and execute on the highest-potential Fraud & Risk opportunities.
  • Engage directly in the largest and most strategic opportunities, building executive relationships, shaping commercial strategy, and helping the team win.
  • Develop and refine scalable sales motions for new business, expansion, and strategic account growth across Fraud & Risk.
  • Build strong feedback loops with Product, Engineering, and Marketing to surface market needs, unblock critical deals, and improve the end-to-end customer experience.
  • Inspire, motivate, and enable individual development, creating clear expectations and meaningful career growth opportunities for direct reports.
  • Lead with clarity and context, communicating a compelling plan that is aligned with Stripe’s strategy and the broader Global Fraud & Risk organization.
  • Continuously improve sales processes, operating mechanisms, and team effectiveness by sharing best practices and testing new approaches.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 10+ years of technology sales experience
  • 5+ years of people leadership experience
  • 3+ years of experience in payments or financial services industry
  • Demonstrated success leading enterprise new-business and expansion sales motions
  • Experience selling complex, technical, or regulated products through multi-stakeholder buying processes
  • Ability to hire, train, and coach a high-performance sales team, and work in a matrixed environment
  • Ability to build cross-functional relationships, motivate others, drive collaboration, teaming & resolve conflict between diverse stakeholder groups
  • High energy, strong work ethic, disciplined execution skills, willingness to do whatever it takes to deliver results

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience specifically selling fraud solutions for payments to enterprise customers

raw.excerpt: A little about us…Fleetio is a modern software platform that helps thousands of organizations worldwide manage their fleet operations.
raw.description:
A little about us…Fleetio is a modern software platform that helps thousands of organizations worldwide manage their fleet operations. Transportation technology is a hot market, and we’re leading the charge with raving fans and new customers signing up every day. We raised $450M in our Series D funding round in March of 2025 and are on an exciting trajectory as a company. Fleetio is also a proud founding member of the Rails Foundation!

More about our team and company:

  • Fleetio overview video:
  • Our careers page:

Fleetio’s largest customers don’t need a standard onboarding checklist; they need a trusted partner who can make a complex change feel manageable. As an Implementation Manager, you’ll lead a focused portfolio of Key and Enterprise customers through launches that can span teams, locations, data, and connected systems. You’ll shape the plan with customer leaders, help teams make sound rollout decisions, and see the impact as Fleetio becomes part of how their operations run. You’ll also help strengthen the way Fleetio delivers its most complex implementations.

This is a senior, customer-facing individual-contributor role. You’ll lead through project ownership and influence, partnering with customer executives and operators and with Fleetio teams across Sales, Product, Engineering, Support, and Customer Success.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead a focused portfolio of complex Enterprise implementations from post-sale handoff through launch and stabilization. Build a trusted partnership, understand what success means in the customer’s operation, and shape a rollout plan that fits the real-world need, not just the software setup.
  • Bring the moving parts together. Turn discovery into a clear path forward, coordinating customer and Fleetio owners across workflows, data, configuration, integrations, testing, and rollout. Keep scope, responsibilities, and dependencies clear and documented, and bring in technical partners where needed.
  • Make complexity manageable. Use pilots, phased rollouts, and readiness checkpoints to reduce risk; keep customer project leads and executives aligned; and surface risks or changed assumptions early with a practical recommendation.
  • Set customers up to sustain the change. Make role-based training and adoption part of the plan, lead a thoughtful transition to Customer Success, and turn lessons from complex launches into better ways of working across Fleetio.

Your Experience

  • 5+ years in customer-facing SaaS implementation, enterprise onboarding, technical project delivery, or a related role, with direct ownership of complex implementations through launch.
  • Experience guiding enterprise customers through multi-stakeholder, multi-location, or work-stream deployments.
  • Strong project leadership: you can turn customer goals into a workable plan, coordinate parallel work-streams and dependencies, and reset expectations when conditions change.
  • Clear, confident communication with customer operators, IT teams, project leads, and executives, including leading discovery, facilitating decisions, and navigating difficult conversations.
  • Technical aptitude with data-heavy implementations, including migration, configuration, integrations, testing, and cutover. You know when to involve technical specialists and how to keep customer expectations grounded in confirmed scope.
  • A consultative, detail-oriented approach to change management and adoption, with the judgment to manage risk and competing priorities while keeping customers moving toward sustainable use.

Helpful Experience

  • Experience implementing software for customers in fleet management, transportation, logistics, or field service.
  • Familiarity with how fleet teams use maintenance, telematics, fuel, or ERP systems in their day-to-day operations.

Role Considerations

  • 15% Travel required to customer on-site workshops and internal meetings
  • Some flexibility in working hours may be needed to coordinate with customer teams across time zones.

Benefits

  • Multiple health/dental coverage options (100% coverage for employee, 50% for family)
  • Vision insurance
  • Incentive stock options
  • 401(k) match of 4%
  • PTO - 4 weeks (increases at year two!)
  • 12 company holidays + 2 floating holidays
  • Parental leave - birthing parent (16 weeks paid) non-birthing (4 weeks paid)
  • FSA & HSA options
  • Short and long term disability (short term 100% paid)
  • Community service funds
  • Professional development funds
  • Wellbeing fund - $150 quarterly
  • Business expense stipend - $125 quarterly
  • Mac laptop + new hire equipment stipend
  • Fully stocked kitchen with tons of drinks & snacks (BHM only)
  • Remote working friendly since 2012

Fleetio provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit and business need.

This application is not intended to and does not create a contract or offer of employment. Employment with Fleetio is at will.

If you have a disability or a special need that requires an accommodation to fill out the online application, please let us know by calling (205) 718-7500.

We’re hiring someone to lead the people agenda for Kenya, our oldest and largest market, as it scales toward the next phase of the business.

Two things matter most. You’ve managed people partners before, not just worked alongside them. And you’ve held a market or business unit end to end, with the leadership relationship that comes with it.

This is a brand new role within the business, with huge impact and high visibility.

The Impact

Your work will directly shape how Kenya's leadership team builds, retains, and develops the people powering our largest market. We've recently celebrated reaching 10 million customers and are onboarding 10,000 new customers every day across all our markets. Behind every one of those numbers is a team of people, and you'll be the strategic partner ensuring that team is set up to keep scaling. It's your chance to be part of something that's literally transforming lives across an entire continent 🌍

What You’ll Do

  • Lead and develop the Kenya senior people partners who hold substantial books across Kenya sales, retail, manufacturing and logistics

  • Partner the Kenya MD and leadership team as their primary people counterpart, on structure, talent, culture and the hard conversations about leadership fit as the business scales

  • Own org design, talent review and succession for the market, and act as the escalation point for employee relations

  • Hold a focused client group of your own in business management, and customer care and collections

  • Translate group strategy into what actually happens in Kenya — real decisions, structure and delivery, not a cascade deck

  • Shape how we’re rebuilding job architecture, competencies and performance across the company — we’re open to doing this differently from the usual HR playbook

We want someone who thinks like a commercial and operational partner first — someone who can look past the standard HR approach when the business genuinely needs something else, and make that call with confidence.

What You Need

Essential Requirements:

  • Currently a Deputy Head of People or similar — holding your own client group, with a small team reporting to you, reporting into an HR Director or Head of People rather than running the function solo (but with a passion for taking the next step up)

  • Comfortable close to senior leadership — you’ve built real trust with directors and country leads

  • Real org design experience — whether built in-house or through consulting, you’ve designed structure and workforce plans, not just executed someone else’s

  • Working knowledge of Kenyan labor law, with direct experience owning employee relations matters

  • A business-first instinct — you reach for cost, risk, or growth before you reach for policy, and you can point to a time you made a call that wasn’t the textbook HR answer because the business needed something else

We’re not looking for someone already running a whole HR function, or reporting to a board. You’ll work closely with talent acquisition, shared services and other teams, but those teams sit elsewhere in the People org, so if you currently own all of that, this would likely be a step back.

Where We’re Looking

If you’re currently at a fast-paced Telco, FinTech, an FMCG or distribution business and you’re the strongest number two in your building — we'd love to talk to you!

Location & Benefits

  • Full-time, hybrid role in Kenya

  • Direct access to and partnership with Kenya's leadership team

  • Collaboration with a global People team across Africa and Europe

  • Professional development and coaching partnerships

  • Family-friendly policies and flexible working arrangements

  • Well-being support and career growth opportunities

Our Mission 🌍

We create financial inclusion for the traditionally excluded through a fair, flexible, customer-centric financing model. We strive to drive greater inclusion of women, youth, and low-income communities.

Our Impact 💚

  • Included 💳: $2+ billion in credit unlocked, 10 million customers reached, 10,000 new customers onboarded daily

  • Connected 📱: 2.5 million first-time smartphone users

  • Prosperous 💰: 70% of customers use their M-KOPA product for income generation, with 35,000+ livelihoods created for agents

  • Sustainable 🌱: 2.155 million tonnes of CO₂ avoided since 2010, with 127,700+ circular economy products sold

Ready to take the step up and shape the people strategy behind one of Africa's fastest-growing fintechs? Apply Now!

Why M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.

Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at .

Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 & 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e-bikes financed in Kenya.

Important Notice

M-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.

M-KOPA explicitly prohibits the use of Forced or Child Labour and respects the rights of its employees to agree to terms and conditions of employment voluntarily, without coercion, and freely terminate their employment on appropriate notice. M-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships.

M-KOPA does not collect/charge any money as a pre-employment or post-employment requirement. This means that we never ask for ‘recruitment fees’, ‘processing fees’, ‘interview fees’, or any other kind of money in exchange for offer letters or interviews at any time during the hiring process.

Applications for this position will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisting and interviews will take place at any stage during the recruitment process. We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if a suitable candidate is selected before the advertised closing date.

If your application is successful M-KOPA undertakes pre-employment background checks as part of its recruitment process, these include; criminal records, identification verification, academic qualifications, employment dates and employer references.

Leads sales and support operations as one signal-driven function, turning quantitative and qualitative insights into execution. Owns the operating cadence, forecasting, pipeline, territory, and deal execution, and resets the support operation beneath it. A hands-on, forward-deployed leader of a lean team, close enough to the work to set the bar and crack the hard problems. Reports to the VP, Revenue & Customer Operations.


What You'll be doing

  • Run the forecast and pipeline. Own forecasting, pipeline, territory, and quota as one operating cadence, and run the roll-up and cascade that keeps the field aligned to the growth plan.
  • Stand up the operating review. A live roll-up from IC to the top, so the quarterly is just another week and leadership is never surprised.
  • Own deal execution. Run deal execution and the RFP and approval flow, with clear standards and clean hand-offs so deals move without friction.
  • Reset support operations. Read the case data, rebalance coverage and routing, and standardize how support work is allocated, so the operation can be managed and resourced.
  • Standardize for automation. Codify the repeatable on both sides and feed sales and support definitions into the shared semantic layer with Modernization, so the work can be deflected and augmented.
  • Build a high-leverage function. Through a culture of curiosity, learning while running and building together, staying hands-on enough to set the bar and crack the hard problems.

What you'll likely bring

  • Runs on signal. Hands-on with the forecast, pipeline, and case data, hears the field and the customer alongside it, and standardizes what they find.
  • Runs a cadence leadership trusts. Has owned a forecast and pipeline rhythm an executive team ran on, not just reported.
  • Turned a support operation around. Has taken a support or service operation from ad hoc to managed: case data, load balancing, deflection.
  • Moves executives. Changes the decision in the room, not just reports into it.
  • AI at the frontier. Has created real productivity lift with AI and agents in the operation, enough to set the standard and pull the team to it.
  • Built and led the function. Has stood up or owned a sales or support operations function with a team, 10+ years in the field and several leading it.
  • Domain. Enterprise SaaS, operating close to go-to-market and support operations.

raw.description:
The opportunity

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to own personalization, recommendations and search across the Ziff Davis Shopping portfolio. You will shape how millions of deal-seekers find the right offer, merchant or product at the right moment, turning a one-time visit into a lasting relationship.You will take ownership of the vision and roadmap for our discovery stack. You will partner closely with product leaders, engineering teams and key stakeholders, and use experimentation to prove impact on conversion, engagement and retention. This role sits at the intersection of user experience, data and business outcomes, with a direct line to revenue.

Key responsibilities

  • Strategy and roadmap
  • Execute and evolve the product vision, strategy and roadmap for personalization, recommendations and search across all channels
  • Identify the highest-value opportunities across the shopping journey, from discovery to click-out, and prioritize by user impact, revenue and effort
  • Stay ahead of market trends, competitor strategies and emerging technologies, including generative AI and conversational search, to drive differentiation

Personalization and recommendations

  • Lead the development of recommendation systems that surface relevant deals, merchants, coupons and products based on user behavior, context and intent
  • Partner with data and engineering teams to define model objectives, ranking signals, feedback loops and evaluation criteria
  • Turn user insights and behavioral data into personalized experiences that drive engagement, retention and long-term loyalty
  • Work with the business analytics and MarTech teams to build and evolve the user profiles, segments and audience signals that power personalization
  • Balance relevance with business goals such as merchant commission, inventory freshness and content diversity

Search and discovery

  • Own on-site search, including query understanding, ranking, autocomplete, filtering and zero-results recovery
  • Improve how users find merchants, deals and products through semantic search and AI-assisted discovery
  • Reimagine deal discovery to inspire exploration and reach shoppers earlier in their buying journey

Experimentation and measurement

  • Champion a rapid test-and-learn culture, using A/B, multivariate and continuous testing to validate and refine algorithms and experiences
  • Define success metrics such as CTR, conversion rate, revenue per visit, search success rate and retention, and report impact to leadership
  • Partner with analytics to instrument tracking and build dashboards that monitor model and feature performance

Cross-functional leadership

  • Work closely with product leaders, UX, engineering, data, analytics and research to prototype, test and ship intuitive, high-impact features
  • Translate complex ML and search concepts into clear requirements, and communicate trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Partner with merchant operations teams and other key stakeholders on integrations and data partnerships that improve relevance
  • Ensure personalization practices respect user privacy, consent and data governance requirements (optional)

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including 2+ years owning personalization, recommendations, search or other data- and ML-driven products
  • Experience in ecommerce, affiliate, marketplace or consumer media, with a track record of improving conversion, engagement or retention
  • Working knowledge of recommendation and search concepts such as collaborative filtering, ranking, relevance tuning, embeddings and cold-start problems
  • Strong analytical skills, comfort with SQL and analytics tools, and a track record of using data to drive product decisions
  • Hands-on experience designing and interpreting A/B tests and experiments at scale
  • Proven ability to align cross-functional stakeholders and deliver against ambitious roadmaps

Preferred

  • Experience with search platforms such as Elasticsearch, OpenSearch or Algolia
  • Experience with LLM-powered features such as semantic search, conversational shopping assistants or generative content
  • Background in deals, coupons, cashback or loyalty programs a plus
  • Experience building product features across web, mobile app, email and push channels
  • Familiarity with privacy regulations and consent management (GDPR, CCPA)
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, statistics or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • A passion for consumer savings and ecommerce innovation

About Ziff Davis

Ziff Davis (NASDAQ: ZD) is a vertically focused digital media and internet company. It operates in seven verticals: Technology, Connectivity, Shopping, Entertainment, Health & Wellness, Cybersecurity and Marketing Technology. Its brands include IGN, Mashable, RetailMeNot, VoucherCodes, PCMag, Humble Bundle, Spiceworks, Ookla (Speedtest), RootMetrics, Everyday Health, BabyCenter, Moz, iContact and Vipre Security.

Our benefits

Ziff Davis Shopping offers competitive salaries and robust, health- and wellness-focused benefits. These include comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability benefits, Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs), a 401(k) with company match, and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. We are committed to work-life balance, with Flexible Time Off, Volunteer Time Off and paid holidays. We offer family-building and caregiving support, and generous family care and parental leave when you need it. We also provide fitness reimbursement and access to wellness programs, so our team stays healthy both physically and mentally. We are dedicated to an environment where everyone feels valued, respected and empowered to succeed. We offer Employee Resource Groups, company-sponsored events, and regular opportunities for growth through educational support, mentorship programs and career development resources. Employees are recognized and celebrated through engagement programs and recognition awards. If you want a dynamic, collaborative environment where you can see the direct impact of your work and thrive personally and professionally, Ziff Davis Shopping is the place for you.

Compensation Range

The salary compensation for this role is $115,000 - $125,000

Equal opportunity

Ziff Davis is an Equal Opportunity Employer. At Ziff Davis, Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) has always been about fairness, equal opportunity and belonging. DEI enables us to attract and retain the best talent, regardless of background or circumstances, while enabling our thousands of employees worldwide to thrive.

We are on the front line of recruitment, enabling organizations to hire smarter and onboard faster. At First Advantage (Nasdaq: FA), people are at the heart of everything we do. From our customers and partners to our greatest advantage — our team members.

Say hello to a rewarding career and come join a leading provider of mission-critical background screening solutions to some of the most recognized Fortune 100 and Global 500 brands.


About First Advantage

First Advantage (NASDAQ: FA) is a leading provider of global software and data in the HR technology industry. Enabled by proprietary technology and AI, First Advantage’s platforms, data, and APIs power comprehensive employment background screening, identity solutions, and verification services.

Headquartered in Atlanta, GA, we have an internationally distributed workforce of about 10,000 employees spanning 17 countries. With a strong emphasis on innovation, automation, and customer success, First Advantage empowers 80,000 organizations to modernize their hiring and onboarding processes on a global scale.


What You'll Do

Director, Global Contract Operations is responsible for establishing the operational strategy, governance framework, technology roadmap, and performance standards for the Company's global contracting function.


This role serves as the senior operational leader within Legal responsible for contract intake governance, workflow administration, process transformation, contract lifecycle management (CLM) optimization, contracting technology enablement and operational support services.


The position partners closely with Legal leadership, Sales, Procurement, Compliance, IT, Finance, and regional business leaders to develop scalable contracting capabilities that support business growth, operational efficiency, risk mitigation, and governance objectives.


The Director serves as the primary operational liaison between Legal leadership and business stakeholders, translating approved legal policies, playbooks, and contracting standards into sustainable processes, systems, controls, and service delivery models.

While this role does not make legal risk determinations or provide legal advice, it is accountable for enterprise-wide contracting operational effectiveness, contracting technology strategy, workflow governance, and continuous improvement initiatives supporting the Legal function.


This role is 100% work from home role within the United States.

Strategic Leadership & Operating Model Ownership

  • Define and execute the global contract operations strategy, roadmap, and operating model.
  • Establish enterprise-wide standards for contract intake, prioritization, assignment, workflow execution, escalation and service delivery.
  • Lead alignment of contracting operations across regions, business units, functions and contract types.
  • Identify operational risks, scalability challenges, and process inefficiencies and develop long-term solutions.
  • Serve as executive owner of contracting operational processes, procedures, governance standards, and service delivery models
  • Advise senior leadership on operational strategy, resource planning, and transformation opportunities.

Process Transformation & Continuous Improvement

  • Lead enterprise-wide process improvement initiatives focused on efficiency, standardization, automation, and scalability.
  • Own and continuously improve the global intake, triage, assignment, and workflow management framework.
  • Establish and maintain global SOPs, process maps, RACI models, and operational documentation standards.
  • Sponsor cross-functional initiatives that improve contracting effectiveness and stakeholder experience.
  • Drive implementation of best practices, automation opportunities, and operational controls across the contract lifecycle.
  • Lead remediation efforts for systemic operational bottlenecks and recurring process issues.

People Leadership & Organizational Capability

  • Lead and develop contract intake and administrative support resources responsible for contracting workflow coordination, intake management, and operational support.
  • Establish performance expectations, training plans, and workload management practices for operational support personnel
  • Partner with Legal leadership to ensure appropriate resource alignment and operational support for contracting activities.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and customer service.
  • Provide oversight for operational support activities that facilitate efficient contract administration and workflow execution.

Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) Strategy & Technology Enablement

  • Serve as business owner for contract operations technology, CLM adoption, workflow optimization and related operational systems.
  • Partner with Legal, IT, Procurement, Sales, and business stakeholders to define CLM priorities, enhancements, integrations, and future-state capabilities.
  • Lead operational readiness activities including UAT, change management, training, adoption, and post-implementation optimization.
  • Provide oversight of CLM administration activities, including system configuration requests, metadata governance, user support, training, and enhancement prioritization.
  • Drive technology-enabled transformation initiatives that improve visibility, efficiency, scalability, and compliance.
  • Ensure CLM capabilities align with contracting strategy, operational objectives, and business requirements.

Operational Performance, Metrics & Executive Visibility

  • Define the contract operations reporting strategy and performance management framework.
  • Establish key performance indicators, service level expectations, and operational health metrics.
  • Monitor service levels, turnaround times, workloads, backlog trends, resource utilization, and operational risks.
  • Provide executive leadership with actionable insights, trend analysis, and strategic recommendations.
  • Utilize operational data to drive investment decisions, resource planning, prioritization, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Establish executive visibility into contracting performance and operational effectiveness.

Governance, Controls & Risk Alignment

  • Lead operational governance associated with approved contracting policies, procedures, workflows, and controls.
  • Partner with Legal and Compliance leadership to ensure operational alignment with enterprise risk management objectives.
  • Establish standards for documentation, approvals, escalations, and process compliance.
  • Ensure operational readiness for audits, regulatory requirements, and governance reviews.
  • Support enterprise initiatives requiring contract operations leadership, governance oversight, or implementation support.
  • Maintain operational frameworks that support risk mitigation, consistency, accountability, and compliance.

Qualifications

  • Experience leading global contract operations, legal operations, compliance operations, or business operations functions.
  • Demonstrated success developing and executing operational strategy and transformation initiatives.
  • Proven ability to build scalable operating models, governance frameworks, and performance management programs.
  • Experience leading enterprise process improvement, workflow optimization, automation, and technology adoption initiatives.
  • Strong executive presence and ability to influence senior leaders across multiple functions.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management, communication, and change management skills.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and strategic planning capabilities.
  • Experience leading geographically dispersed teams and cross-functional initiatives.

Preferred:

  • Experience supporting legal, contracting, compliance, procurement, or commercial organizations.
  • Experience with CLM platforms (IntelAgree, Icertis, Ironclad, Agiloft, DocuSign CLM, etc.).
  • Experience with Salesforce, CPQ platforms, workflow automation tools, and enterprise technology implementations.
  • Experience leading digital transformation and AI-enabled process initiatives.
  • Project management and organizational change management experience.
  • Experience supporting global operations across multiple regions and business units.


What You Will Need to be Successful:

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; Juris Doctor preferred.

Experience:

  • 10+ years of experience in one or more of the following:
    • Contract Operations
    • Legal Operations
    • Contract Management
    • Compliance Operations
    • Business Operations
    • Process Management
  • 7+ years of progressive leadership experience, including responsibility for leading globally distributed teams.
  • Demonstrated experience leading enterprise process transformation, technology implementation, governance programs, or operational excellence initiatives.

Why Join Us at First Advantage?

At First Advantage, team members are united around a noble purpose: helping organizations to safeguard their workplaces and manage risk. The company’s culture is shaped by its core values — Authenticity, Curiosity, Integrity, Teamwork, Customer-Inspired — empowering team members to bring their best ideas forward, collaborate across departments, and make a real impact.

First Advantage offers a variety of culture programs and benefits designed to enhance employee experience and development.

  • Employee Impact Groups
  • FA Cares volunteer opportunities
  • Mentorship Advantage Program
  • SOAR, award-winning manager development program

Additional benefits offered include:

  • Ability to work remotely
  • Medical, Vision, Dental, and supplementary benefit plans, including paid Parental Leave and Bereavement.
  • 401k with an employer match and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP).
  • Competitive and flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) and 8 paid company holidays.
  • Volunteer Time Off Policy (VTOP) up to 10 hours a year.

What Are You Waiting For? Apply Today!

You have learned a little about us today – we want to learn about you! If you think this position and our company are a great fit for your areas of interest and expertise, tell us about you by applying now!


The salary range for this position is approximately $145K-$175K base annually. This range reflects our good faith estimate to pay fairly as to what our ideal candidates are likely to expect, and we tailor our offers within the range based on the selected candidate’s experience, industry knowledge, technical and communication skills, and other factors that may prove relevant during the interview process


We have great people here and are looking for more. Come join us!

Follow us:

raw.title: Principal AI Engineer - Model Optimization & Inference
raw.excerpt: Our Engineering organisation is scaling its AI Engineering capabilities under new leadership, creating an opportunity to shape the next generation of AI at Rapid7.
raw.description:
Our Engineering organisation is scaling its AI Engineering capabilities under new leadership, creating an opportunity to shape the next generation of AI at Rapid7. We’re looking for Principal AI Engineers to define and influence the technical direction of our LLM and agentic AI systems across the organisation. You’ll tackle our most complex technical challenges, establish architectural principles and engineering standards, and drive greenfield innovation that delivers meaningful impact for our global customers. Through technical leadership and mentoring, you’ll shape strategic product and platform investments and influence how we build and scale AI across Rapid7.


About the Team

Rapid7's AI Engineering team builds the AI that powers our security platform. We are AI engineers and applied scientists who take models from research to production, combining open-source and frontier LLMs, AI agents, and fast predictive models with more than 20 years of Rapid7 security expertise. Our work drives core use cases across Detection and Response, such as alert triage, threat investigation, and automated response, and Exposure and Remediation, such as vulnerability prioritization, attack surface risk assessment, and guided remediation. Together, these help customers stop threats faster and fix what matters most.


About the Role

As a Principal AI Engineer, you will set the company-wide technical direction for how Rapid7 builds, adapts, and serves its own models. You will own the strategy that decides which problems we solve with open-source models we fine-tune and post-train ourselves versus frontier models, and you will shape the platform, hiring, and investment that make that strategy work. You are the technical authority across teams and stay hands-on with the hardest problems, from training runs to inference performance. Specifically your focus will be to:

  • Define the multi-year architecture and technical roadmap for Rapid7's model, training, and inference platform across Detection and Response and Exposure and Remediation
  • Own model strategy at the company level: when to use frontier or open-source models, and when to fine-tune, distill, or post-train, with clear cost, quality, and risk trade-offs
  • Lead the design of fine-tuning and post-training systems, including LoRA and full fine-tuning, distillation, and preference or RL-based methods
  • Drive inference efficiency at scale, including batching, caching, quantization, speculative decoding, and parallelism, balancing quality, latency, and cost
  • Set the build-versus-buy and capacity strategy for GPU infrastructure, training and serving stacks, and cloud spend
  • Establish evals as the release gate for every AI system we ship, and set the benchmarks that define "good" for security models and agents
  • Set engineering standards for experimentation, reproducibility, model lifecycle management, and context engineering across teams
  • Lead design reviews and resolve the hardest cross-team technical trade-offs
  • Mentor Principal, Staff, and Senior engineers, influence hiring, and shape product and platform investment

The skills and qualities you’ll bring include:

  • 13+ years of software or ML engineering experience, including 3+ years optimizing and fine-tuning open-source LLMs in production
  • A track record of architecting AI systems used across multiple teams or products, with measurable impact on quality, latency, or cost
  • Open-source models: deep expertise with open-source LLMs and PyTorch
  • Fine-tuning and post-training: LoRA and full fine-tuning, distillation, and preference or RL-based methods
  • Training infrastructure: experience with distributed training (FSDP, DeepSpeed, or similar) on multi-GPU clusters
  • Inference optimization: deep knowledge of serving at scale with vLLM or SGLang, including batching, caching, and quantization
  • Evals: defining evaluation strategy and benchmarks for LLM and agent systems
  • Strong distributed systems and Python fundamentals
  • Takes accountability for organisation-wide technical outcomes, proactively addressing systemic risks and removing barriers to delivery while ensuring technical decisions align with strategic priorities
  • An influential communicator who can articulate complex architectural trade-offs, build consensus and influence technical and product decisions across the organisation
  • Builds alignment across Engineering, Product and other functions on technical direction, driving decisions that shape product and platform investments.
  • Anticipates evolving customer needs and shapes AI architecture and technical strategy to maximise customer value, making informed trade-offs between capability, performance, cost and scalability to guide product and platform investment
  • Thrive in ambiguity at the leading edge of AI, driving change and focusing forward as the technology and the threat landscape evolve
  • Recognition as an expert in AI, evidenced by publications, patents, open-source contributions or industry engagement
  • Embody our core values to foster a culture of excellence that drives meaningful impact and collective success

Preferred Skills and Experience include:

  • A strong history of organization-wide impact through technical leadership, mentoring, and shared platforms and standards
  • Security domain experience, such as detection engineering, SOC/MDR, or vulnerability management
  • Experience with GPU kernels or compilation tools (CUDA, Triton, TensorRT-LLM)
  • Experience with RL environments and reward design for agentic or tool-using models
  • Experience running AI workloads on AWS at scale, with a focus on cost efficiency
  • Ability to explain technical trade-offs to engineering, product, and leadership audiences
  • Publications, patents, or open-source contributions in AI

We know that the best ideas and solutions come from multi-dimensional teams. That’s because these teams reflect a variety of backgrounds and professional experiences. If you are excited about this role and feel your experience can make an impact, please don’t be shy - apply today.


About Rapid7

At Rapid7, our vision is to create a secure digital world for our customers, our industry, and our communities. We do this by harnessing our collective expertise and passion to challenge what’s possible and drive extraordinary impact. We’re building a dynamic and collaborative workplace where new ideas are welcome.


Protecting 11,500+ customers against bad actors and threats means we’re continuing to push the envelope just like we’ ve been doing for the past 20 years. If you ’re ready to solve some of the toughest challenges in cybersecurity, we’re ready to help you take command of your career. Join us.


Rapid7, Inc. is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. A candidate’s salary is determined by various factors including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, and certifications. We evaluate compensation decisions on a case-by-case basis, and it is not typical for an individual to be hired at the very top of the salary range.


The annual salary range for this role, depending on location, is:

United States: $221,000.00 - 299,000.00 USD Annual

Salary ranges may vary based on geographical location. This range does not include variable/incentive compensation, equity and benefits (where applicable/eligible).

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or any other status protected by applicable national, federal, state or local law.

raw.description:
Company Overview:

Jane Technologies is an MIT-founded eCommerce company in the cannabis industry experiencing rapid growth. We believe in cannabis's ability to bring well-being, health, and love to the world, and our mission is to bring confidence to the online cannabis shopping experience. Our platform connects consumers with local dispensaries and brands, creating a seamless shopping experience and delivering industry-leading insights to our retail, brand, and integration partners.
Dispensaries use Jane to sell cannabis products compliantly and efficiently. Brands plug into the platform to reach shoppers via personalized sponsored content. Shoppers engage with Jane’s online menus to make purchasing decisions via rich product content and verified reviews. These services come together to form a tightly integrated ecosystem - creating diversified revenue streams for Jane and a win-win-win equation for the industry.
Learn about our team, our culture, and if Jane is the right fit for you.
Check out our company at:
What You'll do:

Jane Technologies is looking for an Analytics Engineer to join our growing data team. In this role, you'll help build and maintain the data models, datasets, and business intelligence tools that support reporting and decision-making for our internal teams and external customers.
Day to day, you'll work with SQL, dbt, and BI tools to transform data into reliable, accessible insights. You'll collaborate with data engineers, data scientists, and product teams to understand business questions, develop analytics solutions, and improve the quality and usability of our data.
This is an opportunity to develop your analytics engineering skills, learn from experienced team members, and contribute to data-driven decision-making in the evolving cannabis industry.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain analytics-friendly datasets that are easily accessible to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with team members to gather business requirements and develop data models that support internal and external analytics products.
  • Write, maintain, and improve SQL queries and dbt models following established team standards and best practices.
  • Work alongside data engineers to support data schema development, data quality, and warehouse performance.
  • Build and update BI dashboards and reports in collaboration with data scientists and other team members, helping deliver actionable insights to cannabis dispensaries and brands across North America.
  • Test, document, and troubleshoot data models and reporting workflows to ensure accuracy, consistency, and reliability.
  • Support ongoing improvements to our analytics tools, processes, and data infrastructure.

Qualifications

  • 1–3 years of experience in data analytics, analytics engineering, business intelligence, or a related field.
  • Working knowledge of SQL, including writing queries, joining datasets, and building data transformations.
  • Experience with at least one BI or reporting tool, such as Looker, ThoughtSpot, Power BI, Hex, or similar.
  • Familiarity with dbt or an interest in learning modern analytics engineering tools and practices.
  • Understanding of data modelling concepts and an interest in building reliable, scalable datasets.
  • Exposure to Python and/or R for data analysis is a plus.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Our Benefits:
Great compensation package and equity
Remote friendly work environment with employees throughout the US and Canada
Health, Dental, Vision, 401k, Unlimited PTO, and home office stipend

raw.excerpt: Creative Strategist (Full-Time, Remote) MVR Digital is hiring a Creative Strategist to own the link between performance data and creative output for our luxury and premium DTC clients.
raw.description:
Creative Strategist (Full-Time, Remote)

MVR Digital is hiring a Creative Strategist to own the link between performance data and creative output for our luxury and premium DTC clients. This is not a brand-storytelling role. You'll read Meta and Google ad performance daily, form testable hypotheses about what's working and why, and write briefs precise enough that a designer or editor can execute without guessing.

About MVR Digital

MVR Digital is a performance marketing agency serving luxury and premium DTC and e-commerce brands, with roots in New York, Denver, and Canada. We were named one of Adweek's Fastest Growing Agencies. We operate fully remote and async-first, using Slack and ClickUp to run distributed teams across the US and Canada.

Our Values

  • Act Like an Owner
  • Clarity Over Complexity
  • Serve Clients' Best Interest
  • We Win Together, We Lose Together
  • Data-Informed, Human-Led

What you'll own

  • Performance-to-brief pipeline - Read Meta and Google ad performance data daily. Identify which hooks are fatiguing, which formats are holding attention, and which audiences are saturating. Translate those signals into structured creative briefs: segment, message, hook type, format, reference, and success metric.
  • Creative testing strategy - Build and prioritize a testing roadmap with media buyers. Form specific, falsifiable hypotheses rather than general concepts.
  • Brief management and execution oversight - Brief designers, video editors, copywriters, and UGC creators. Maintain a tagged creative asset library so winning concepts from past sprints can be found and iterated on, not rebuilt from scratch.
  • UGC scripting and trend iteration - Track UGC and short-form trends across TikTok and Instagram on a rolling basis and adapt winning formats to client brands and offers quickly, before they fatigue.This is a core function of the role, not a secondary skill. Candidates without recent, hands-on UGC scripting experience should not apply.
    • Iterate on existing UGC concepts based on performance data: tightening hooks, testing new openers, recutting pacing direction for editors.
    • Write UGC-style scripts that sound like real people talking, not ad copy. You should be able to nail hook, problem, proof, and CTA structure in a 15-30 second format.

What you need

  • 3+ years in creative strategy, performance marketing, or a closely related role (media buying, copywriting, or brand marketing with a strong performance bent).
  • Demonstrated experience writing structured creative briefs, not mood boards.
  • DTC or e-commerce experience strongly preferred.
  • Luxury or premium brand experience is a differentiator, not a requirement, but you should be able to speak to how creative instincts shift in a higher-consideration purchase environment.
  • Comfortable in a remote, fast-moving agency environment managing multiple client accounts and external creative partners simultaneously.
  • Strong written communication. You'll be working async with a distributed team, so clarity in writing carries real weight.
  • Hands-on UGC scriptwriting experience, ideally with a portfolio or examples of scripts that turned into produced ads.

title: Data Architect
description: We are looking for an experienced Data Architect to design and evolve data architectures supporting enterprise applications, data integration, and analytics.

raw.title: Data Architect
raw.excerpt: We are looking for an experienced Data Architect to design and evolve data architectures supporting enterprise applications, data integration, and analytics.
raw.description:
We are looking for an experienced Data Architect to design and evolve data architectures supporting enterprise applications, data integration, and analytics. The ideal candidate combines strong data architecture and modelling expertise with a solid understanding of databases, data integration patterns, and modern data platforms. Cloud experience is an advantage, but architectural expertise and practical design experience are the primary requirements.

Responsibilities

  • Design end-to-end data architectures covering data ingestion, integration, storage, processing, and consumption.
  • Define conceptual, logical, and physical data models for operational and analytical workloads.
  • Design data warehouses, data lakes, lakehouses, and data marts, selecting appropriate patterns based on business and technical requirements.
  • Define data integration approaches, including ETL/ELT, batch and streaming processing, APIs, and change data capture (CDC).
  • Establish architecture principles for data quality, governance, metadata, lineage, security, and access control.
  • Assess existing data landscapes and define target architectures, modernization strategies, and migration approaches.
  • Evaluate technology options and architectural trade-offs related to performance, scalability, reliability, maintainability, and cost.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders, solution architects, and engineering teams to translate requirements into implementable designs.
  • Produce architecture documentation, data models, integration specifications, and architecture decisions.
  • Guide engineering teams, review solution designs, and ensure architectural consistency throughout delivery.
  • 10+ years of experience in data engineering, database development, or software engineering, including 3+ years in data architecture or solution design.
  • Proven experience designing enterprise data solutions involving multiple systems, data sources, and consumers.
  • Strong understanding of data architecture principles, including operational versus analytical workloads, data lifecycle, consistency, and historization.
  • Advanced data modeling skills: relational modeling, normalization, dimensional modeling, star schemas, and slowly changing dimensions (SCD).
  • Strong SQL knowledge and experience with relational databases such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or Oracle, including database performance optimization.
  • Solid understanding of data warehousing, data lakes, lakehouse architectures, and data marts.
  • Experience designing data pipelines and integration solutions using ETL/ELT, APIs, messaging, and CDC.
  • Knowledge of data governance practices, including data quality, metadata management, lineage, data ownership, and security.
  • Ability to define and document architectural decisions, assess trade-offs, and communicate designs to technical and business stakeholders.
  • Experience guiding engineering teams and supporting the implementation of architectural solutions.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills, with proficiency in English.

Nice to have skills

  • Experience designing data solutions on AWS, using services such as Amazon S3, Redshift, Glue, Athena, Lambda, and Step Functions.
  • Familiarity with AWS data governance and security capabilities, including Lake Formation, IAM, and Glue Data Catalog.
  • Experience with generally applicable technologies such as Apache Spark, Kafka, Apache Iceberg, dbt, or Airflow.
  • Familiarity with Data Mesh, data products, or data virtualization.
  • Experience with enterprise data migrations, legacy modernization, or hybrid architectures.
  • Experience designing data solutions for AI/ML or advanced analytics.
  • Experience in regulated environments with demanding data security and compliance requirements.

You will work on complex enterprise data initiatives, collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, and contribute to architectural decisions across diverse technologies and industries.

People create momentum. Technology changes the world. We engineer the intelligence that makes it possible. We're Nagarro, a global AI-native engineering and transformation company. We build products and experiences that inspire, excite, and delight. Intelligence isn't something we adopt. It's something we engineer, starting with teams small enough that your ideas move, not wait. That's where you come in!

raw.description:
HRIS Manager

Position Location

Remote


Reports To

Vice President, Human Resources


Travel

Approximately 10-20%, based on business needs, system implementations, site support, and integration activity.


Citizenship / Clearance

U.S. citizenship required. Must be able to obtain and maintain a security clearance as business needs require.


Role Type

HRIS / People Systems management role; one direct report

Compensation

$150,000 - $170,000


Company Context

Headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, Falcata is a defense technology company with more than 50 years of experience providing technical services and solutions to U.S. Government customers. The company supports mission-critical capabilities across airborne sensors and ISR, electronic warfare, precision weapons, radar, air and missile defense, space, and intelligence and information systems.


As Falcata enters its next stage of rapid organic growth, acquisition activity, and private-equity-backed platform development, the People function must strengthen its systems, data, analytics, controls, and workforce technology infrastructure to support scale, integration, compliance, and better decision-making across an increasingly complex enterprise.


Position Summary

Falcata is seeking an experienced, hands-on HRIS Manager to lead the administration, optimization, governance, and continuous improvement of the company’s Human Resources Information Systems and related employee self-service applications. The role will serve as the functional leader for People systems, data integrity, reporting, system controls, and HR technology-enabled process improvement.


Reporting to the Vice President of Human Resources, this remote role will own day-to-day HRIS operations while also helping build the scalable People systems and workforce data infrastructure required for Falcata’s growth. The HRIS Manager will establish and maintain system standards, codes, controls, workflows, documentation, reporting, and user support; troubleshoot complex issues; coordinate changes with IT and vendors; and support integrations, upgrades, and acquired-company transitions.


The HRIS Manager will initially lead one direct report and will be expected to operate as a working manager—providing hands-on technical leadership while developing team capability, setting priorities, assigning work, and ensuring reliable service delivery across People systems and workforce data.


Key Responsibilities


HRIS Administration, Governance, and Team Leadership

  • Lead administration and maintenance of the HRIS and related employee and manager self-service applications, ensuring system availability, usability, data integrity, security, and appropriate controls.
  • Establish, maintain, and govern system codes, position structures, job codes, status codes, organizational hierarchies, workflows, tables, permissions, and other configuration elements required for accurate and consistent personnel transactions.
  • Develop and enforce standards and procedures for entering, updating, auditing, and maintaining workforce data across the employee lifecycle.
  • Perform regular data audits, reconciliations, and quality reviews; identify root causes of data issues and implement sustainable corrective actions.
  • Lead, coach, and develop the HRIS/People Systems team member, establish priorities and service expectations, and ensure clear accountability for system administration, data quality, reporting, and user support.

Systems Support, Troubleshooting, and Continuous Improvement

  • Serve as the functional leader and senior People systems resource for HR team members, managers, and employees, providing guidance and ensuring complex HRIS questions, transactions, and system issues are resolved effectively.
  • Troubleshoot HRIS problems and partner with IT, Payroll, Finance, Security, vendors, and other stakeholders to resolve defects, integration issues, access concerns, and process breakdowns.
  • Evaluate and recommend changes to screens, workflows, reports, interfaces, controls, and user experiences that improve accuracy, efficiency, service delivery, and manager self-sufficiency.
  • Lead testing, validation, implementation, and user-readiness activities for system releases, configuration changes, patches, upgrades, and new functionality; assign and oversee work performed by the HRIS team as appropriate.

Reporting, Analytics, and Workforce Insights

  • Develop, maintain, and automate recurring and ad hoc HR reports, dashboards, mass updates, and workforce analytics that support the CPO, HR leadership, business leaders, and enterprise decision-making.
  • Partner with HR leaders and business stakeholders to define workforce metrics, reporting standards, data definitions, and dashboard requirements across headcount, turnover, hiring, talent, compensation, performance, employee relations, compliance, and other People priorities.
  • Translate workforce data into clear, decision-ready insights and identify opportunities to improve data quality, reporting consistency, and organizational visibility.
  • Support workforce planning, organizational design, talent reviews, and other strategic People processes with reliable system data and analysis.

HR Technology Strategy and Process Enablement

  • Partner with the VP of HR, CPO, and HR leadership to help define the People technology roadmap and prioritize system enhancements, automation opportunities, integrations, and investments based on business value and scalability.
  • Map and improve HR processes to ensure technology enables efficient, standardized, compliant, and user-friendly workflows rather than automating inefficient practices.
  • Evaluate HR technology, tools, and vendor solutions; support requirements definition, demonstrations, selection, implementation, and ongoing vendor management as needed.
  • Maintain HRIS procedures, system documentation, configuration records, data dictionaries, process maps, controls, and user guidance to support continuity, audit readiness, and scalable operations.

Training, Adoption, and User Enablement

  • Develop and deliver training for HR staff, managers, employees, and other system users on HRIS functionality, self-service capabilities, new releases, revised processes, and data responsibilities.
  • Create practical user guides, job aids, FAQs, and communications that improve system adoption, reduce errors, and increase self-service capability.
  • Assess recurring user issues and transaction errors to identify opportunities for additional training, process clarification, system changes, or stronger controls.

M&A, Integration, Compliance, and Controls

  • Support HR technology and data workstreams across M&A diligence, Day 1 readiness, integration planning, and post-close execution in coordination with the CPO, HR leadership, Integration Management Office, IT, Finance, and other functional partners.
  • Assess acquired-company HR systems, data structures, interfaces, records, reporting, and process dependencies; support migration and integration into Falcata platforms while maintaining data integrity and continuity of operations.
  • Establish repeatable data-conversion, validation, system-integration, and cutover practices that enable Falcata to integrate acquired organizations efficiently and consistently.
  • Support audit readiness, data privacy, records retention, access governance, and compliance requirements applicable to HR systems and workforce data, including federal-contractor reporting and other regulatory obligations.
  • ·Partner with IT and Security to ensure HR systems and workforce data are managed in accordance with applicable cybersecurity, access-control, privacy, and business-continuity requirements.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Information Systems, Business, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related field with 8-10 years of relevant experience; or a Master’s degree with 6-8 years of relevant experience.
  • Extensive hands-on experience administering, configuring, supporting, and optimizing HRIS platforms and employee/manager self-service applications in a complex organization.
  • Prior people leadership, supervisory, or formal team-lead experience, with demonstrated ability to assign work, coach performance, develop capability, and maintain accountability in a technical HRIS environment.
  • Demonstrated expertise with HR data structures, position and job architecture, organizational hierarchies, workflows, security roles, reporting, mass updates, interfaces, and data-quality controls.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex system and data issues, performing root-cause analysis, and coordinating resolution across HR, IT, Payroll, Finance, vendors, and other stakeholders.
  • Strong reporting and analytical skills, including experience developing dashboards, recurring reports, data audits, workforce metrics, and decision-support analyses.
  • Experience leading or materially supporting HRIS implementations, upgrades, integrations, testing, data conversions, or major configuration changes.
  • Strong documentation, process design, training, communication, project-management, and stakeholder-management capabilities.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate as a working manager with strong technical depth, sound judgment, accountability for complex assignments, and the ability to lead and develop at least one HRIS/People Systems team member.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in defense, aerospace, government contracting, engineering, technology, advanced manufacturing, or another regulated technical environment.
  • Experience in a private equity-backed company or an organization scaling through organic growth and acquisitions.
  • Experience with Deltek Costpoint and/or comparable HRIS/ERP platforms, payroll integrations, benefits interfaces, learning/talent systems, and reporting or business-intelligence tools.
  • Experience supporting M&A HRIS diligence, data conversion, system consolidation, acquired-company integration, or other enterprise transformation initiatives.
  • Working knowledge of workforce reporting and federal-contractor compliance requirements, including OFCCP/AAP/EEO/VETS reporting and audit readiness.
  • Experience with workforce analytics, data visualization, dashboard development, and integration of HR data with Finance or enterprise reporting environments.
  • Relevant certification in HR technology, HRIS, data analytics, project management, or Human Resources preferred.

Employment Requirements

  • U.S. Citizenship Required: Yes.
  • Security Clearance Required: Must be able to obtain and maintain a security clearance as business needs require.
  • Work Arrangement: Remote, with travel to Falcata sites, leadership meetings, and system implementation activities as business needs require.
  • Travel: Approximately 10-20%, with additional travel during major system implementations and acquisition/integration activity.
  • Position Contingent upon Award of Contract: No.
  • Employment is contingent upon successful completion of background check and drug screening requirements.

Benefits and Equal Employment Opportunity

TSC offers a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package, including retirement programs, flexible work schedules, tuition reimbursement, paid leave, and other benefits subject to applicable plan terms and company policy. Specific benefit offerings should be reviewed and updated based on the final go-forward benefits and ownership-transition structure approved for the company.


TSC is committed to hiring and retaining a diverse workforce and is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class.

This contractor and subcontractor shall abide by the requirements of 41 CFR 60–1.4(a), 60–300.5(a) and 60–741.5(a). These regulations prohibit discrimination against qualified individuals based on their status as protected veterans or individuals with disabilities, and prohibit discrimination against all individuals based on their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or for inquiring about, discussing, or disclosing information about compensation. Moreover, these regulations require that covered prime contractors and subcontractors take affirmative action to employ and advance in employment individuals without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.
