raw.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Senior Customer Success Manager, Dedicated, you will be tasked with serving as a senior individual contributor on the Customer Success team. This level is for CSMs with deep expertise across our customers, products, and processes who consistently deliver strong outcomes across a complex portfolio and raise the bar for those around them.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Own post-sales relationships with a portfolio of our largest and most strategic customers, championing their needs and advocating for their success internally.
  • Lead and drive strategic business reviews with executive stakeholders, tailoring messaging to their priorities and using data to influence customer decisions.
  • Develop and execute strategic customer success plans aligned to customer and company goals, coordinating resources across multiple internal teams to deliver on them.
  • Oversee end-to-end lifecycle execution (onboarding, adoption, renewal) for strategic accounts.
  • Manage risk across your customer portfolio; drive escalations to resolution and follow through on action items.
  • Champion the voice of the customer, surfacing customer needs and feedback to Product and leadership so it informs planning.
  • Consistently deliver on KPIs and surface trends and risks to leadership.
  • Use AI as a core part of how you work. Proficiency with Claude is a requirement, as you will be expected to build and refine AI-assisted workflows for account research, executive briefing prep, data synthesis, risk analysis, and customer communications, and to share what works so the rest of the team levels up with you.
  • Partner with Sales on growth. Sales owns upsell, but you know your customers best: spot opportunities where additional products fit a customer’s goals, flag them to your AEs, and help the conversation along when it makes sense.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • At least 5 years of related experience and a Bachelor’s degree.
  • Proven experience as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent) managing Enterprise accounts (20,000 or more employees).
  • Demonstrated fluency with AI tools (Claude or equivalent) applied to real workflows.
  • Ability to synthesize complex, disparate information into actionable insights that drive significant business outcomes.
  • Strong project management and problem solving skills, with the ability to define, adjust, and track projects through tools, and present status, blockers, and adjustments to leadership.
  • Outstanding operational excellence and extreme attention to detail, with a focus on managing commitments and clarifying expectations among all parties; account data, renewal and risk tracking, executive-facing materials, follow-up commitments, and CRM hygiene are expected to be accurate.
  • Impeccable written and verbal communication skills, comfort presenting to executive-level audiences, and experience working with customers from diverse cultures.
  • Experience with Salesforce as a customer success tool is preferred.
  • Previous cybersecurity industry experience or demonstrated understanding of cybersecurity is preferred.
  • A track record of building something your team still uses after you built it, such as a playbook, a template, a process, or an automation, is preferred.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

Equity & Rewards

  • Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

Time Off & Wellbeing

  • Flexible time off
  • Paid company holidays and paid sick time
  • Gender-neutral parental leave
  • Grandparent leave

Insurance & Financial Security

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Life and disability insurance
  • Health and dependent care FSA
  • Voluntary benefits (hospital, accident, critical illness)
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • ARAG pre-paid legal
  • Nationwide pet insurance
  • Cancer Care program
  • Global business travel medical insurance

Work Perks & Flexibility

  • Home office allowance
  • Mobile phone reimbursement

Wellness & Lifestyle

  • Wellness coach
  • Wellness/gym reimbursement
  • Fertility coverage
  • Adoption & surrogacy reimbursement
